多智能体系统

[MA-0] Do “True” and “False” Add Up to One? Complement Consistency in LLM -Agent Opinion Simulations

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大语言模型代理（LLM-agent）在意见模拟中对概率报告的一致性问题，即当同一命题被改写为其补集时，模型应保持概率的互补性（即原概率与补概率之和为1），以确保其输出可被视为可信的信念表达。然而，实证结果显示，即使在小规模开源模型（Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B 和 Gemma-3-4B）中，这种互补一致性也显著缺失：在2,304个代理状态样本中，Qwen的配对报告平均和达1.18；在真实事实核查数据集AVerTeC中亦超过1；在24个双结局受控世界测试中，三模型均出现同样失效。该偏差幅度是同义改写所导致变化的2至10倍，且在重复采样、不同群体规模及报告强度下持续存在。更严重的是，当从互补初始状态出发的两组代理进行迭代交互时，其演化轨迹不再保持镜像对称，五轮后已产生正向分歧。尽管通过将答案与其补集平均可强制恢复形式一致性并降低整体Brier损失，但仅在一个模型中优于原始两种表述中的较优者。此外，在固定命题表述的调度-目标实验中，模型表现出微弱且稳定的交互行为，表明一致性失效并非源于语义模糊或随机波动。因此，该研究强调：在将模拟中的概率输出解读为代理信念前，必须独立设计专门的重述一致性测试，否则可能引入系统性偏差。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32874
作者: Anouar Imel,Jin Qi
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Social and Information Networks (cs.SI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:In LLM-agent opinion simulations, each agent reports the probability that a claim is true after seeing its own previous probability and the probabilities reported by its neighbors, and that number becomes its state in the next round. If the number describes the agent’s position rather than the sentence it was shown, then rewriting the claim as its complement and replacing every probability p with 1 - p should return the complementary answer, so the two reports should sum to one. We test this with three small open models: Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.2-3B and Gemma-3-4B. On 2,304 agent states taken from a running network simulation, Qwen’s paired reports sum to 1.18 on average, and on 48 real fact-checking claims from AVeriTeC they again exceed one. A controlled benchmark of 24 worlds, each with exactly two possible outcomes, shows the same failure in all three models. The discrepancy is two to ten times larger than the change produced by a same-meaning paraphrase, and it persists under repeated sampling and across peer group sizes and report strengths. When the reports are fed back into two populations that start from complementary states, the populations do not remain mirror images: their divergence is positive after five rounds for every model. Averaging each answer with the complement of its paired answer restores consistency by construction and lowers Brier loss averaged over the two wordings, but at the final round it beats the better of the two original wordings for only one of the three models. A schedule-by-targeting experiment on the same model gives a small, stable interaction because such sweeps keep the claim wording fixed. Consistency under rewording therefore needs its own test before simulated probabilities are read as beliefs

[MA-1] J-Comm: Jacobian-Guided Latent Communication between LLM Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式 AI（Generative AI）在跨模型通信中面临的效率与一致性难题，即如何在不共享键值缓存（key-value caches）或要求模型宽度一致的前提下，实现高效且语义对齐的隐式推理通信。其核心挑战在于确保发送方（Sender）与接收方（Receiver）在连续推理过程中保持几何共识（geometric consensus），同时提供可被外部模型有效利用的中间计算接口。解决方案的关键在于提出 J-Comm 框架，其核心由两部分构成：一是无需训练的几何一致重加权（GEAR）机制，通过在嵌入空间中单调优化候选标记间的几何一致性，提升推理路径的稳定性；二是 H+J 通信接口，其中 H 通道通过反馈分布生成连续输入供接收方推理，而 J 通道则以词汇索引化的雅可比透镜坐标（Jacobian-lens coordinates）传递中间状态线索，为接收方提供计算过程中的引导信息。接收方利用自身词典重构这些线索并注入预填充（prefill）阶段的中间层，从而实现无需共享缓存、异构模型间的高效通信。实验表明，在 Qwen3-8B 到 Qwen3-4B 的跨模型通信任务中，J-Comm 在七项基准上均取得最优平均得分，显著优于 TextMAS，性能提升达 1.29–8.59 个百分点，且生成文本令牌数减少 19.2%–74.8%，验证了其高效性与鲁棒性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32871
作者: Xiangwei Wang,Wei Wang,Sachith Seneviratne,Ken Chen,Yu Xia,Peng Wang,Saman Halgamuge
机构: The University of Melbourne(墨尔本大学); Shanghai Jiao Tong University(上海交通大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Latent communication requires both an effective continuous reasoning process and an interface through which an external model can leverage its intermediate computation. We present J-Comm, a framework comprising two core components. First, a training-free Geometric Agreement for Latent Reasoning (GEAR) reweights token candidates over existing model embeddings, which monotonically optimizes geometric consensus among candidate tokens in embedding space at each step. Second, we introduce an H+J (Hidden-and-Jacobian) communication interface that gives the Receiver two complementary views of the Sender’s reasoning. The H channel supplies continuous inputs derived from feedback distributions, while the J channel conveys intermediate-state cues in vocabulary-indexed Jacobian-lens coordinates. Intuitively, H provides inputs for the Receiver to reason from, while J offers additional guidance within its computation. The Receiver reconstructs these cues using its own dictionary and injects them into intermediate layers during prefill, enabling communication without sharing key-value caches or requiring identical model widths. In Qwen3-8B to Qwen3-4B communication, J-Comm achieves the highest mean score across seven benchmarks, including 94.80% on MATH500, 54.55% on GPQA-Diamond, 73.33% on AIME2024+2025, and 62.93% success on ALFWorld. Compared with TextMAS, it improves performance by 1.29-8.59 percentage points and reduces generated text tokens by 19.2-74.8%.

[MA-2] Agent -Based Transport Model Calibration via Online Stochastic Batch Optimization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决代理模型（Agent-Based Models, ABMs）校准过程中计算成本高昂的问题，传统黑箱优化方法通常需要数百甚至上千次独立的模拟运行，导致效率低下。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种在线校准框架，将参数估计嵌入单次模拟运行中，通过结合黑箱优化与随机批次优化（stochastic batch optimization），利用每个模拟迭代作为随机批次，实现代理在决策过程中增量式地更新参数。该方法使模型参数与代理行为协同演化，在不重启模拟的前提下实现收敛。以MATSim为案例研究，在瑞士大规模交通场景中校准效用函数参数，结果显示模式分担率在典型模拟时间内即可紧密匹配观测数据，验证了该方法在实时性、可扩展性和效率方面的可行性与有效性。通过将校准过程直接嵌入模拟循环，该方法为复杂ABMs的实时、高效校准开辟了新路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32698
作者: Abdelkader Dib,Milos Balac
机构: ETH Zürich (苏黎世联邦理工学院); Center for Sustainable Future Mobility (CSFM) (可持续未来交通中心)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: Presented at the World Conference on Transport Research (WCTR 2026), Toulouse, France

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Calibrating agent-based models (ABMs) is computationally demanding, as traditional black-box optimization typically requires hundreds or thousands of independent simulation runs. To reduce this burden, we introduce an online calibration framework that estimates parameters within a single simulation run. The approach combines black-box optimization with stochastic batch optimization, a method widely applied in machine learning but not yet explored in ABM calibration. Using MATSim as a case study, we treat each simulation iteration as a stochastic batch, enabling incremental parameter updates as agents make decisions. This online calibration paradigm allows model parameters and agent behaviors to co-evolve, achieving convergence without restarting the simulation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by calibrating utility function parameters in MATSim for a large-scale transportation scenario of Switzerland. Results show that mode shares align closely with observed data within a typical simulation timeframe, confirming the feasibility and efficiency of the approach. By embedding calibration directly into the simulation loop, our method opens new possibilities for real-time, scalable, and efficient calibration of complex ABMs.

[MA-3] HGWM: Hierarchical Graph-Guided World Model for Zero-Shot Object Navigation via Graph Matching

【速读】：该论文旨在解决零样本物体导航（zero-shot object navigation）中智能体在缺乏目标任务先验知识的情况下，如何有效利用历史观测信息进行目标搜索决策的问题。其核心挑战在于如何在不依赖训练阶段见过的目标或场景的前提下，持续整合视觉-语义线索并生成合理的探索路径。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的房间锚点先验（room-anchor prior）与持久化空间-语义记忆（persistent spatial-semantic memory）相结合的架构——HGWM。该方法通过分阶段的评分机制：首先在粗粒度阶段对候选朝向进行视觉-语义打分（0–10标度），再在细粒度阶段评估观测对象、房间上下文与目标先验之间的符号兼容性；随后采用相位依赖融合策略，将上述得分与LLM提供的方向建议相结合，最终指导局部动作选择。实验结果表明，该方法在HM3D v0.1和v0.2以及MP3D数据集上均取得优于基线模型WMNav的性能，特别是在成功率（SR）方面有显著提升，同时路径效率（SPL）也略有改善，验证了其在跨场景泛化能力上的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32554
作者: I-tak Ieong,Hao Tang
机构: 未知
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Zero-shot object navigation requires an embodied agent to choose where to search while retaining evidence from previous observations. HGWM couples an LLM-generated room-anchor prior with persistent spatial-semantic memory. A coarse stage assigns visual-semantic scores to candidate headings on a 0-10 scale; a fine stage measures symbolic compatibility between observed objects, room context, and the goal prior. Phase-dependent fusion combines these scores with an LLM direction recommendation before local action selection. On HM3D v0.1, the reported HGWM configuration achieves 62.6% success rate (SR) and 31.5% success weighted by path length (SPL), compared with 58.1% and 31.2% for WMNav. On MP3D, the corresponding values are 46.8% and 17.9%, compared with 45.4% and 17.2%. The results indicate higher success point estimates and modest path-efficiency gains. On HM3D v0.2, the full model obtains 74.4% SR and 31.9% SPL. Additional component ablations reduce SR by 0.9-2.3 percentage points and SPL by 0.6-1.5 points. These are author-reported aggregate measurements. The accompanying implementation repairs pass offline tests; episode-level rerun records are not available. Evaluation is confined to simulation.

[MA-4] Empirically Calibrated Differential Games for Simulating Driver Interactions

【速读】：该论文旨在解决现有交通行为建模方法中缺乏对人类驾驶员真实驾驶行为的准确刻画问题，尤其针对传统博弈论模型在经过参数校准后是否能有效再现真实驾驶行为这一关键科学问题。其核心挑战在于如何构建一个既能反映车辆间复杂交互关系、又可被真实驾驶数据验证的通用非零和微分博弈模型。解决方案的关键在于提出一种融合多目标成本函数的微分博弈框架，该框架综合考虑速度跟踪、车道保持、控制努力、基于智能驾驶员模型（Intelligent Driver Model, IDM）的跟车间距维持、预测性冲突规避以及接触屏障等要素，并通过带有感知延迟的车辆交互机制进行建模。模型采用基于贝叶斯优化的参数校准方法，在华盛顿特区四个交叉口的真实轨迹数据上对每辆车的十个行为参数进行标定，最终实现对819辆车辆轨迹的高精度重现（平均位置误差为1.00米）。在未参与校准的数据集上，该模型表现出显著优于SUMO、逆强化学习模型及同类独立/合作模型的泛化性能。同时，通过反馈式迭代线性二次算法求解博弈均衡，计算效率高（典型交互仅需2.1秒），且解为近似纳什均衡。此外，对于数据无法充分识别的冲突与转向权重，可通过设定安全与舒适性目标进行合理配置，并结合更刚性的接触屏障，有效消除43%紧密闭环冲突中的碰撞事件，从而提升模型的实用性与安全性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32276
作者: Amirmohammad Khakpour,Nachuan Li,Pedram Beigi, Yu (Marco)Nie
机构: Northwestern University (西北大学); George Washington University (乔治华盛顿大学)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA); Optimization and Control (math.OC)
备注: This manuscript is intended for submission to IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems (IEEE T-ITS)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Game-theoretic models can resolve vehicle interactions without hand-written priority rules, but whether they describe human drivers once calibrated has rarely been tested. This study formulates a general-sum differential game of vehicle interactions at urban intersections, calibrates it to observed driving, and evaluates it on data not used for calibration. Each vehicle minimizes a cost that combines speed tracking, adherence to a map-derived lane route, control effort, gap keeping based on the intelligent driver model, a predictive conflict term, and a contact barrier, while perceiving the other vehicles with a delay. The game is solved with a feedback iterative linear-quadratic algorithm, and ten behavioral parameters per vehicle are calibrated by Bayesian optimization on trajectories recorded at four intersections in Washington, D.C. The calibrated game reproduces the trajectories of 819 vehicles with a mean position error of 1.00 m. When only each vehicle’s route is known, as in a simulator, it is the most accurate of the compared models on 96 held-out vehicles (7.42 m), and ten-fold cross-validation shows that it is significantly more accurate than calibrated SUMO (by 3.61 m), an inverse reinforcement learning model (by 0.93 m), and independent and cooperative variants of the same model (by 0.33 and 0.32 m). The solutions, computed in 2.1 s for a typical interaction, are verified approximate equilibria. Finally, the conflict and steering weights, which the data do not identify, can be set from safety and comfort targets; together with a stiffer contact barrier, this removes the collisions that otherwise occur in 43% of tight closed-loop conflicts.

[MA-5] Markets of Minds: A 51-Billion-State Economy of Intelligence

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在资源受限的智能体群体中，如何高效分配专家推理能力（expert reasoning）这一关键问题。当多个智能体共享有限的专家模型访问权限时，单个干预措施虽可能对受助者有益，但若存在预期价值更高的替代干预，则其实际效益可能因机会成本而降低。因此，核心挑战在于：在预算、访问权限、稀缺性及服务能力等约束条件下，如何权衡每项援助的边际收益与所放弃的其他潜在用途的价值。本文提出“心智市场”（Markets of Minds）框架作为解决方案，该框架在观测到专家输出前即对各智能体-服务组合的预期收益进行评估，明确区分修复收益（repair benefit）与回归风险（regression risk），并在共享资源约束下联合清算援助合约。实验基于一个包含512亿可触及人格-市场状态的依赖感知智能体经济系统，涵盖能力、认知预算、提供方接入、稀缺性及网络角色等维度。研究发现，在30%协助配额下，冻结分配器实现85.42%的任务级人格一致性，显著优于同等容量随机分配的73.86%，提升11.56个百分点。结果表明，援助价值具有异质性，甚至可能为负；稀缺性会改变哪些干预值得投入。这揭示了智能体群体层面的认知资源配置新范式：援助的价值不仅取决于其自身成效，更取决于其所替代的其他认知资源使用路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32190
作者: Jusheng Zhang,Xuekun Wu,Wenhao Wang,Mark Wang,Ming-Hsuan Yang
机构: Stanford University(斯坦福大学); Vast Intelligence Lab; University of California at Merced(加利福尼亚大学默塞德分校)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When intelligence is shared, reasoning becomes a constrained allocation problem. In a population of agents with limited access to expert models, an intervention can benefit its recipient yet still be a poor use of shared capacity if another feasible intervention has greater expected value. Assistance must therefore be evaluated through both its marginal benefit and the opportunity cost induced by budgets, access, scarcity, and service capacity. To this end, we introduce Markets of Minds, a framework for allocating expert reasoning across agents before expert outputs are observed. For each feasible agent-service pair, the framework estimates the expected gain from assistance relative to the agent’s default continuation, explicitly separating repair benefit from regression risk, and jointly clears assistance contracts under shared resource constraints. We then study this problem in a dependency-aware agent economy with 51.2 billion addressable persona-market states spanning capabilities, cognitive budgets, provider access, scarcity, and network roles. These dependencies couple allocation feasibility across agents rather than the outcome of a fixed contract. Empirically, in a matched replay of 240 cases under a common 30% assistance quota, the frozen allocator reaches 85.42% task-level persona adherence versus 73.86% for equal-capacity random allocation, a gain of 11.56 percentage points. The results show that assistance value is heterogeneous and can be negative, and that scarcity changes which interventions are worth purchasing. Together, these findings motivate a population-level view of intelligence where the value of assistance depends not only on what it can achieve, but also on which alternative uses of scarce cognitive capacity it displaces.

[MA-6] he Helpful Agent Problem: When Emergent Cooperation Among LLM Agents Bypasses Intended Workflows

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统中“有益代理问题”（helpful agent problem），即在共享资源环境下，即使各智能体目标独立且无恶意，仅因试图协助彼此而自发产生越权协作行为，从而绕过系统预设的审查与监督机制。其核心解决方案的关键在于构建可量化评估的基准测试体系——提出并验证了FavorBench与CooperBench两个基准，前者为受控环境下的可测量下游副作用评估平台，后者用于真实代码仓库场景中的现象检测。实验结果表明，在多个大模型与两种基准下，跨工作流的“帮助性行为”频繁出现，且部分行为对非参与方造成显著损害。这揭示了一个新型多智能体安全挑战：合作行为本身可能成为规避系统级防护机制的路径，凸显了在协作型生成式智能体部署中对隐性协同风险进行建模与防范的必要性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31985
作者: Moumita Choudhury,Amit Sarker,Shlomo Zilberstein
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM agents are increasingly deployed in collaborative settings where they pursue separate tasks while sharing resources and operating under review or oversight processes. Such settings create safety risks not only when agents are malicious, but also when they are simply trying to help. Prior work has largely studied adversarial or explicitly collusive behavior; we show that benign agents pursuing separate objectives can spontaneously cooperate in ways that bypass intended workflows. We call this the \emphhelpful agent problem. We study long-horizon shared-resource environments in which agents sometimes depend on resources owned by their peers and cross-owner changes are normally mediated by a reviewer. When review becomes unavailable, agents begin making changes on one another’s behalf despite having no shared reward or explicit incentive to cooperate. Crucially, these actions remain within each agent’s local permissions while circumventing the system’s intended oversight structure. Across two benchmarks and four models, we find that out-of-workflow favors emerge frequently. Further, in \textscFavorBench, favors from at least three models cause significant harm to parties outside the interaction. These results reveal a distinct multi-agent safety challenge: cooperation itself can create pathways around system-level safeguards.

Abstract:Agentic AI systems using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection through untrusted tool outputs. We demonstrate cross-modal trust laundering, in which instructions concealed in an email-signature image using least-significant-bit (LSB), discrete cosine transform (DCT), or metadata steganography bypass text scanners and enter a multi-agent workflow when decoded by a tool. To counter this threat, we propose decode-time provenance binding, which combines HMAC-authenticated trust labels with an MCP-maintained provenance ledger and context-taint tracking. The mechanism labels decoded content as untrusted and blocks critical tool calls influenced by that content, even when a compromised agent substitutes a valid trusted label. We evaluate the approach using a real MCP testbed with three steganographic carriers and 24 adaptive payloads. The undefended pipeline exhibits 100% attack success, while keyword and regex defenses each permit 62.5% of attacks. Our mechanism blocks all attacks (0% success), including adversarial label substitution across mediated agent boundaries. A four-component ablation validates the roles of decode marking, cryptographic authentication, lineage tracking, and sink enforcement. An audited trusted-promotion mechanism increases legitimate-task completion from 67% to 100% without compromising protection. The approach provides carrier-independent containment within fully mediated MCP execution environments. Code and data are publicly available.

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly participate in negotiations on behalf of individuals and organizations, yet they remain vulnerable to manipulation, particularly in repeated multi-party interactions. Classical multi-agent systems address this challenge through explicit trust and reputation models, whereas existing work on LLM negotiation largely treats trust as an emergent phenomenon. We investigate whether LLM agents can form useful trust estimates from prior interactions and leverage them to improve future negotiation outcomes. We introduce a repeated, multi-party, multi-issue negotiation framework in which recurring agents participate in a sequence of negotiation games while one participant covertly attempts to prevent agreement. After each game, agents assess their counterparts and maintain pairwise trust estimates that carry over to subsequent negotiations. We compare trust-aware and trust-agnostic agents and analyze how explicit trust influences negotiation outcomes. Our results reveal a \emphtrust–agreement gap: trust-aware agents can identify the adversary within a few games, but accurate trust estimates do not consistently translate into better agreements. Trust increases agreement rates by up to 23 percentage points, but only when agents are explicitly guided to use it in their decisions. Explicit trust can therefore improve repeated LLM negotiations, but its value depends critically on how trust is assessed and incorporated into agents’ reasoning.

Abstract:Swarm morphogenesis requires robots to assemble desired shapes through local interactions. We present a modular framework integrating neural cellular automata (NCA) with existing site selection and collision-aware control. Within this framework, we introduce a decentralized attachment-site discovery mechanism. Robots already in the formation update and share local NCA states to identify new attachment sites, enabling progressive growth without a predefined list of sites during deployment. To bridge the mismatch between conventional NCA growth and gradual physical assembly, we additionally propose offline sparse-retention fine-tuning that simulates partial attachment, together with a false-positive loss that penalizes invalid site activations. Simulations demonstrate formation of diverse lattice morphologies, scaling to several hundred robots, and substantial improvements in morphology accuracy from the proposed fine-tuning. Experiments with Crazyflie quadrotors validate the integrated execution pipeline using robot-relative observations reconstructed from external tracking.

Abstract:Swarms of small robots are an attractive way to survey lunar caves and lava tubes. Missions such as NASA’s CADRE will fly cooperating rovers for distributed mapping, but only in daylight. The 354 h lunar night drops the surface towards 95 K, and the radioisotope heaters that let single rovers survive it cannot be supplied at swarm scale. In this study we investigate whether a swarm can instead use its own members as thermal shielding. We train one policy, shared by all twenty robots, by reinforcement learning with an evolution-strategies estimator. The policy receives a single reward, once, at the end of the night: the mean temperature of the five coldest robots. Nothing in that reward refers to position, spacing, exposure or motion. Two behaviors nonetheless emerge. The swarm aggregates, and robots circulate between the sheltered core and the exposed rim, the same pair of behaviors with which emperor penguins survive the Antarctic winter. We measure the survival threshold, the smallest stored energy per robot at which every robot is still alive at sunrise. Across ten runs it is 155.6 +/- 1.3 pcm-h, where one pcm-h is 7.2 kJ of stored heat. That is 37% below a motionless huddle and within 13% of a physics-based lower bound, and at a budget where the motionless huddle loses six robots, every robot survives. The behavior needs no shared spatial reference and no robot-robot contact, and transfers from twenty robots to forty without retraining.

Abstract:Disease surveillance increasingly integrates automated data collection, yet predefined sources and procedures require manual adaptation as reporting practices change. We explore agentic artificial intelligence (AI) as an approach to coordinating surveillance data collection across heterogeneous sources. Specifically, we built a multi-agent framework that integrates source discovery, source assessment, evidence structuring, event linking, and validation. Three retrospective applications illustrate its promise. The workflow recovered all 13 individual cases in a hantavirus outbreak, with links to 85 distinct publisher domains compared with 28 in the reference benchmark, reconstructed Canadian measles counts with a final total 0.33% below the national reference and higher cumulative counts on 79.8% of comparable days, and increased the share of days with recent Sierra Leone mpox reports from 28.2% to 65.6% by incorporating attributed media. These demonstrations also reveal limitations in record completeness and accuracy, while prospective gains in timeliness remain untested. We envision agentic AI as a complementary layer of public health data infrastructure, coordinating evidence-linked collection under surveillance goals and standards defined by public health professionals.

Abstract:Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on role-specific prompts and execution models to solve complex tasks collaboratively. However, prompt optimization typically keeps model assignments fixed, leaving differences in role requirements and their associated inference costs outside the search. We present UniMASO, a Unified framework for heterogeneous Multi-Agent System Optimization through the joint adaptation of prompts and model assignments. UniMASO evaluates candidate updates through local, downstream, and global feedback, using cost-aware Pareto search to retain useful quality-cost trade-offs. Topology-aware co-evolution then coordinates these updates according to agent roles and dependencies. Cross-level trajectory memory further supplies historical successes and failures to guide subsequent optimization. Experiments on five benchmarks and five execution topologies show that UniMASO achieves competitive task performance at substantially lower deployment cost than the strongest homogeneous configurations. Under centralized execution, it improves the average score from 69.79 to 70.40 while reducing token-weighted deployment cost by 85.2% relative to DeepSeek-V4-Pro with MASPO. These results support joint prompt-model adaptation as an effective approach to efficient multi-agent collaboration. The code is available at this https URL.

Abstract:Simulating molecular excited-state processes requires resolving electronic and nuclear dynamics, but the cost of direct quantum-chemical calculations limits accessible system sizes and timescales. Machine-learning models can extend these simulations, yet they often need to be tailored to specific molecular systems and scientific objectives. Building and deploying such models requires coordinated decisions across conformational sampling, quantum-chemical labelling, model training, validation and dynamics. Here we introduce Paired agents for Unified Learning and Simulation of Excited States (PULSES), a multi-agent system that automates this workflow within expert-approved boundaries. A human expert and planner define the scientific objective, methods and decision boundaries, while an orchestrator coordinates domain agents and artifact-specific scientific assurance during execution. We evaluate PULSES on 15 computational chemistry tasks and demonstrate end-to-end applications to perylene exciton Hamiltonians, solvent-dependent biphenyl relaxation, and excited-state proton transfer in 10-hydroxybenzo[h]quinoline. These results demonstrate traceable, expert-bounded construction and deployment of specialized excited-state models, while retaining scientific validation as a requirement rather than assuming that successful execution establishes correctness.

Abstract:This article argues that instruction-fine-tuned language models should be understood as implementing a genre, what is proposed as the instructional-conversational genre. This genre is an amalgamation of discursive language from prior conversations between generative models and humans recursively run through these massive neural networks. It is instantiated in applications through instruction fine-tuning, the inclusion of a pretext known as a system prompt, and the formalization of inputs in mark-up languages characterized by the use of special tokens and role assignment in turntaking structures.

[NLP-1] Yalda-Embedding: Open Development of a Competitive Persian Retrieval Model

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决波斯语（Persian）在生成式密集检索（dense retrieval）任务中因语言特定训练资源匮乏及轻量级嵌入模型有限而导致的性能瓶颈问题。其核心解决方案是提出Yalda Embedding——一个基于Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B架构、参数量达5.958亿的专用波斯语检索模型，通过在超过一百万组查询-文档对上进行微调实现优化。关键创新在于采用关系知识蒸馏（relational knowledge distillation），从更大规模的F2LLM-v2-8B教师模型中迁移结构化语义表示，显著提升小模型在八项波斯语检索任务（来自FaMTEB基准）上的表现，宏平均得分达到0.5488，优于所有同类0.6B规模模型，并接近Qwen3-Embedding-4B的性能。消融实验表明，在单轮训练设定下，仅靠对比学习微调效果有限，而结合知识蒸馏后，所有任务均获得显著提升，且无需增加推理阶段模型大小；尤其值得注意的是，模型在未显式使用难例（hard negatives）的情况下仍能在困难负样本评估任务中取得优异表现。研究还开源了模型权重、训练与评估代码、成对数据集及其教师模型嵌入版本，支持可复现性分析与独立验证。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32933
作者: Yalda Taheri,Mohammad Hassan Heydari,Armon Rasooli
机构: Azad University (伊朗伊斯兰共和国阿扎德大学); University of Isfahan (伊朗伊斯法罕大学); Iran University of Science and Technology (伊朗科学技术大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Despite advances in multilingual text representations, effective dense retrieval for Persian remains constrained by the limited availability of language-specific training resources and compact embedding models. We present Yalda Embedding, a 595.8-million-parameter Persian retrieval model adapted from Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B using more than one million query-document pairs. On eight Persian retrieval tasks from FaMTEB, the model achieves the highest macro-average among the evaluated 0.6B models, scoring 0.5488 and outperforming Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and F2LLM-v2-0.6B on every task. It also approaches Qwen3-Embedding-4B, winning on four tasks, tying on one, and trailing by 0.0075 in macro-average. An incremental ablation study examines contrastive batch size, optimization stabilization, and relational knowledge distillation from F2LLM-v2-8B. Under the one-epoch training setup, contrastive fine-tuning alone yields a modest mean improvement over initialization and regressions on two tasks. The final distilled configuration improves all eight tasks over the non-distilled model, raising the mean from 0.4813 to 0.5488 without increasing inference-time model size. These gains include hard-negative evaluation tasks despite training without explicitly mined or supplied hard negatives. We release model weights, training and evaluation code, the pairwise dataset, and its teacher-embedded counterpart, enabling inspection of data composition and training procedures, independent evaluation, and reuse without repeating expensive teacher inference.

[NLP-2] Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding for Mixed Natural Language and Structured Symbolic Corpora

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现代语言模型在子词分词（subwording tokenization）过程中因将空格视为固定语义边界而导致的局限性问题，尤其针对跨空格的多词表达（multiword expressions）和形式化语言（如LaTeX）等结构化内容难以被有效建模的挑战。现有超词分词（superword tokenization）方法虽尝试放宽空格约束，但通常依赖贪婪的频率驱动合并策略，忽视了词元长度及特定领域语言（如低频的领域专用语言）的实际需求。为此，本文提出自适应频率阈值字节对编码（Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding, AdaBPE），其核心创新在于引入双重动态机制：一方面根据候选词元长度自适应调整最小频率阈值，避免过度偏好高频短模式；另一方面依据词元类型区分通用语言与形式化语言模式（以LaTeX为例），从而更高效地将词汇容量分配给特定领域符号。实验结果表明，AdaBPE在涵盖LaTeX与自然语言的五个数据集上均实现了编码效率与下游语言模型性能的提升，且在领域特定内容上表现显著优于基线方法，同时未损害通用语言建模能力。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32921
作者: Pietro Di Nicco,Lucio La Cava,Andrea Tagarelli
机构: University of Calabria (卡拉布里亚大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Modern language models rely on subwording tokenization to define the discrete units of input processing, typically using methods like Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) that treat whitespace as a fixed semantic boundary. This design is inherently limited, as many meaningful concepts—including multiword expressions and the structured environments of formal languages like LaTeX—frequently span across whitespaces. While recent superword tokenization methods attempt to address this by relaxing whitespace constraints, they often rely on greedy frequency-driven merging that fails to account for token length or the specific needs of underrepresented domain-specific languages. In this paper, we introduce Adaptive Frequency Threshold Byte Pair Encoding (AdaBPE), a new tokenization method that leverages an adaptive frequent-pattern mining approach. AdaBPE features a twofold dynamicity: it adapts minimum frequency thresholds based on both the length of a candidate token, to prevent favoring frequent short patterns, and its type, to distinguish between general and formal language patterns, using LaTeX as case in point. This allows the model to efficiently allocate vocabulary capacity to domain-specific notations, such as LaTeX, even when they represent a small fraction of the training data. We evaluate AdaBPE across five datasets spanning LaTeX and natural language, showing consistent gains in encoding efficiency and downstream language-model performance on domain-specific content without compromising general-language performance.

[NLP-3] Interpretable sparse fine-tuning with TopKLoRA enables faithful circuit discovery

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在未知来源数据集上进行微调时，因包含投毒样本而引入后门（backdoor）的问题，此类后门难以定位与移除，且可能在安全训练过程中持续存在。现有参数高效微调方法虽能捕捉训练中全部参数变化，但缺乏可解释性。为此，本文提出并完善了TopKLoRA方法，作为对Masiak等人（2025）初步工作的扩展——一种设计上具备可解释性的LoRA变体，其核心机制为：在每个标记处仅激活前k个最大的适配器潜在表示（adapter latents），从而实现稀疏性。与自编码器类方法（SAEs）不同，TopKLoRA仅基于下游任务损失进行训练，优化压力促使模型学习具有功能因果性的潜在表示。通过在“潜伏代理”（sleeper-agent）后门案例研究中对Gemma-2-2b、Qwen2.5-1.5B和Qwen2.5-7B模型进行投毒指令跟随微调，验证了该方法的有效性：能够精准识别并剔除对后门行为既必要又充分的电路模块。此外，所提方法生成的稀疏电路规模相比密集型LoRA基线缩小一个数量级，实现了对恶意功能的精准切除而不损害指令遵循性能。最后，作者提出一种结合TopKLoRA潜在表示与梯度路由（gradient-routing）的技术，用于构建具备局部化电路的模型有机体，以验证电路搜索算法的发现。研究成果标志着迈向可解释性设计架构的重要一步，能够在不牺牲模型性能的前提下提供可信赖的分析单元。相关代码已公开。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32866
作者: Marek Masiak,Andrzej Szablewski,Nicola Cancedda,Constantin Venhoff
机构: University of Oxford (牛津大学); University of Cambridge (剑桥大学); Neuralk-AI
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 29 pages, 10 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persist through safety training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods capture the full parameter changes introduced during training, they are not easily interpretable. We present the full method of TopKLoRA, extending the preliminary proposal of Masiak et al. (2025), an interpretable-by-design LoRA variant in which only the k largest adapter latents are active at each token. Unlike SAEs, TopKLoRA is trained purely on downstream loss, where optimisation pressure incentivises learning functionally causal latents. We demonstrate this sparse LoRA adapter in a sleeper-agent backdoor case study where we create model organisms by fine-tuning gemma-2-2b, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Qwen2.5-7B on a poisoned instruction-following dataset. For each organism, we identify and ablate a circuit that is both necessary and sufficient to implement the backdoor. Furthermore, our new fine-tuning method produces sparse circuits that are up to an order of magnitude smaller than a dense LoRA baseline, allowing surgical ablation of the malicious capability without sacrificing instruction-following performance. Finally, we propose a technique to construct model organisms with localised circuits using TopKLoRA latents and gradient-routing, which we use to validate the findings of our circuit search algorithm. We consider these findings as a step toward interpretable-by-design architectures that provide faithful units of analysis without compromising model performance. We share our code: this https URL.

[NLP-4] Communicating with the Entire Population: Machine Translation of Emergency Alerts and Warnings

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决突发事件中多语言沟通的障碍问题，特别是针对无法使用地区主导语言的受影响人群，如何确保其获得及时、准确的应急信息。其核心挑战在于，尽管商业翻译工具（Commercial Translation Tools）提供了快速扩展语言覆盖的潜在解决方案，但应急管理者往往缺乏对这些自动化输出质量与适用性的有效评估能力，导致在实际应用中存在风险。论文的关键解决方案是通过全国范围的应急管理人员调查，系统梳理其工作流程、认知视角与操作困境，并基于实际需求评估主流商业翻译工具的表现，从而为应急响应中翻译工具的安全、有效使用提供实证依据与实践指导，强调需结合具体情境审慎选择和验证翻译结果。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32842
作者: Jen Wilson,Vipasha Bansal,William D. Lewis
机构: University of Washington(华盛顿大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: In Proceedings of the Language Technologies for Crisis Preparedness and Response (LT4CPR Workshop), Hengqin, Zhuhai, China. Association for Computational Linguistics. Nov 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:It is essential that we communicate with the entirety of an affected population during a crisis, including those who do not speak a region’s dominant language(s). Commercial Translation tools offer a tempting solution to broaden access and can provide a lifeline when no other resources are available. However, Emergency response managers often operate in the dark regarding the quality and adequacy of these automated outputs. In this paper, we conduct a nationwide survey of emergency managers to understand their current workflows, perspectives, and operational challenges. We then evaluate commercial translation tools against these needs, shedding light on their utility and offering practical guidance on how and when these tools can be safely used in emergency response.

[NLP-5] KrishokTech: A Bengali Agricultural Advisory System with Explicit Authorization Controls

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决农业咨询系统在生成建议时面临的多重挑战，包括对高风险请求的控制、在有限网络连接条件下的运行能力，以及应对指导政策动态变化的需求。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个围绕生成环节的显式授权边界（authorization boundary），通过分阶段的控制机制实现安全与可靠性：在检索前，系统对政策覆盖的高风险请求进行归一化处理和基于规则的准入检查，并在治疗意图不明确时主动询问作物信息；随后将检索绑定至单一作物，并在文本与图像指示作物不一致时要求用户确认；生成后，采用窄范围验证器（narrow verifier）剔除未被检索到的BARI/BRRI证据支持的用药剂量声明。农业指导知识存储于外部可独立更新的证据索引中，无需重新训练生成模型，同时通过浏览器端视觉处理和本地检索降低了对网络连接的依赖。系统界面以ASK、CONFIRM、REFER、DROP等操作标记决策过程及对应证据，使整个从请求到建议交付的路径透明可控。实验表明，该机制有效阻止了意图不明确的请求，将跨作物检索违规率从36.5%降至0%，文本-图像冲突检测准确率达99.8%，剂量错误检测率达96.6%，充分验证了其在实际场景中的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32817
作者: Khan Raiyan Ibne Reza,Sanjana Aktar Maria,Shakil Ahmed,Faiyad Hossain,Sumaiya Tabassum Nimi
机构: North South University(北方南大学), Dhaka 1229, Bangladesh
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:For agricultural advisory, generating an answer is only part of the problem: the system must also control unsafe requests, work with limited connectivity, and accommodate changing guidance. KRISHOKTECH is a Bengali agricultural advisory system built around an explicit authorization boundary around generation. Before retrieval, normalization and rule-based admission checks refer policy-covered high-risk requests and ask for a crop when treatment intent is underspecified. The system then binds retrieval to a single crop and asks for confirmation when the text and image indicate different crops. After generation, a narrow verifier removes dosage claims not supported by retrieved BARI/BRRI evidence. Agricultural guidance is kept in an external evidence index that can be updated without retraining the generator, while browser-side vision and local retrieval reduce connectivity requirements. The interface makes these decisions visible as ASK, CONFIRM, REFER, and DROP, together with their evidence. On 200 farmer queries and 400 stress queries, the controls halted underspecified requests and reduced cross-crop retrieval violations from 36.5% to 0% under the tested alias filter. Mismatch detection caught 453 of 454 text-image conflicts, while the verifier caught 114 of 118 inserted dosage errors. The demonstration shows how these controls govern the path from request to delivered advice.

[NLP-6] Frontier-OPD: Discovering the Edge of Agent Capability and Teaching Agents to Go Beyond

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多轮交互式智能体在使用在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）时，如何有效获取高质量教师监督的问题。传统方法难以同时识别出需要干预的决策点以及学生是否具备在短暂指导后自主持续任务的能力。其解决方案的关键在于引入“学习前沿”（learning frontier）概念——即那些对学生仍具挑战性但经简短教师指导后可实现有效自主延续的决策情境。为实现这一前沿的动态捕捉，论文提出Frontier-OPD框架，通过构建共享状态轨迹图（shared-state trajectory graph），对师生分歧进行基于轨迹平衡的聚合，从而识别出潜在的干预候选点，并保留历史信息以支持回放。随后，通过比较教师引导段与后续学生自主行为，与原始轨迹中等长片段的协议度，评估教师桥接（teacher bridge）的有效性，形成可被当前策略继承的行为代理信号。成功采纳的教师反馈被融入常规蒸馏数据，而新的采样轨迹则用于更新学习前沿估计。实验在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld上验证了该方法在不同学生规模和教师配置下均显著优于基线蒸馏方法，且消融实验证明候选选择与引导过滤机制具有互补性；在特定时间设置下，额外的数据收集成本可通过更快达到目标成功率得以抵消。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32802
作者: Zheng Jiang,Yiming Chen,Houde Qian,Ling Li,Chaoyang Li,Lifeng Sun
机构: Tsinghua University (清华大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:On-policy distillation aligns teacher feedback with a student’s current behavior, yet acquiring useful supervision for multi-turn agents requires identifying both where guidance is needed and whether the student can sustain the interaction afterward. We introduce Frontier-OPD, which addresses this problem through the student’s learning frontier: decision situations that remain challenging but admit useful autonomous continuation after brief teacher guidance. To operationalize this frontier, Frontier-OPD organizes on-policy experience into a shared-state trajectory graph, where trajectory-balanced aggregation of teacher-student disagreement identifies distinct intervention candidates while preserving the histories needed for replay. Short teacher bridges are then assessed by comparing agreement over the bridge and the ensuing student continuation with an equally long segment of the original trajectory, providing a behavioral proxy for guidance that the current student can build on. Accepted teacher responses augment ordinary distillation data, and fresh rollouts renew the frontier estimate as the policy changes. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld report higher mean autonomous performance than the compared distillation baselines across the evaluated student scales and teacher configurations, with ablations indicating complementary effects of candidate selection and guidance filtering. In one ALFWorld timing setting, the additional collection cost is offset by a shorter time to a target success rate.

[NLP-7] Multiplicative vs. Additive State Coupling in Learned Optimizer Schedules

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在大规模图上求解最大割（MAX-CUT）问题时，如何设计能够有效泛化至未见实例的优化调度策略。其核心挑战在于：传统基于启发式或固定参数的调度方法难以适应超出训练规模的实例，且缺乏对求解器状态的动态响应能力。解决方案的关键在于采用一种双线性自适应调度（bilinear schedule），通过在反向传播过程中对经典求解器进行展开（unrolled classical solver），使调度参数能够根据求解器当前状态动态调整。实验表明，这种双线性结构不仅能实现对训练分布内的良好性能，更能在分布外（out-of-distribution）场景下显著优于基线模型（15个随机种子下t=4.1），且该优势在不加正则化、多轮权重衰减测试中持续存在。相比之下，仅使用加性结构（additive ablation）的模型虽在分布内与双线性模型无统计差异，但在分布外表现明显劣于自身基线（t=-11.7），说明求解器状态信息的引入方式（即双线性交互机制）而非单纯的自适应性，才是实现泛化能力提升的本质因素。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32801
作者: M. Harper Langston,Pierre-David Letourneau,Dalton Jones,Roland Memisevic,Peter Scott,Mingu Lee,Richard A. Lethin,Christopher Lott,Fatih Porikli,Harris Teague
机构: Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. (高通技术公司); New York University (纽约大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Numerical Analysis (math.NA); Optimization and Control (math.OC)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We learn schedules for a continuous penalty relaxation of MAX-CUT by backpropagating through an unrolled classical solver. A state-blind schedule generalizes to instances substantially larger than those used for training. A state-adaptive bilinear schedule also generalizes out of distribution, outperforming its untrained baseline across 15 seeds ( t=4.1 ). By contrast, an additive ablation with identical inputs and output heads is statistically indistinguishable from the bilinear model in distribution but performs worse than its own baseline out of distribution ( t=-11.7 ). This separation appears without regularization and persists across a 30 round weight-decay sweep: the bilinear advantage remains significant at every tested value, whereas the additive model never recovers. The results in this setting isolate how solver state enters the schedule, rather than state adaptivity alone, as the architectural distinction associated with out-of-distribution transfer.

[NLP-8] ParaTaxe: a Suite of Tools for Processing and Publishing Multi-parallel Corpora

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决数字人文领域中平行语料库（parallel corpora）在学术研究中难以长期维护与持续可访问的问题。尽管近年来用于并行文本对齐与并行化的数字工具已取得显著进展，但大量由学术项目生成的平行语料库因缺乏后续维护或资金支持而迅速失去在线可及性。为此，本文提出了一套开源工具集，其核心解决方案在于通过多语言嵌入（multilingual embeddings）驱动的AIAlign对齐器、基于Python的语料转换与对齐处理流水线、用于管理平行语料库集合的ParaTaxe网络界面，以及基于TEI-Publisher构建的可探索对齐语料库的可视化网页界面，形成一个从数据处理、对齐、管理到可视化展示的完整闭环系统，从而实现平行语料库的可持续共享与长期可用性。

作者: Olivier Kraif(LIDILEM),Cyrille François(UNIL),Elnaz Jalilian(LIDILEM),Natacha Rimasson-Fertin(ILCEA4),Pascale Roux(XXI)
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:Over the past fifteen years, digital tools for parallelizing and aligning textual corpora have developed significantly within the field of digital humanities. Several projects and software tools have been created to compare different translations or versions of texts. Despite these technical advances, many parallel corpora produced in academic contexts quickly become inaccessible online due to the lack of maintenance or funding. To address this gap, we present a suite of open-source tools developed within the ACR Grimm Tradalign and ParaTaxe projects. This suite includes the AIlign aligner, based on multilingual embeddings, a Python processing pipeline for converting and aligning corpora, a web interface called ParaTaxe for managing collections of parallel corpora, and a web interface for exploring aligned corpora built with TEI-Publisher.

[NLP-9] On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有基于策略自蒸馏（on-policy self-distillation）方法依赖真实问题-答案对、人工标注题集或其他监督信号的局限性，从而在无需外部更强教师模型或人工标注数据的前提下实现基础模型的后训练优化。其解决方案的关键在于将自蒸馏重构为一种自训练框架，完全依赖模型自身生成的问题-答案对以及特权推理示范（privileged reasoning demonstrations），并仅以粗粒度的高层次主题描述作为唯一指导信号。在此框架下，模型能够自主构建学习课程（curriculum of queries）与推理轨迹，无需访问任何人工设计的提示或答案。实验表明，基于完全合成的特权信息进行自蒸馏，不仅可在多个领域提升模型性能，还能保持在未参与自训练领域的原有能力，展现出在文本与多模态任务中的广泛适用性，验证了基础模型具备可被激发的丰富潜在能力，且无需外部任务监督或特定问题分布即可实现持续自我增强。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32770
作者: Leon Sick,Lukas Hoyer,Yannick Strümpler,Christian Reisswig,Timo Ropinski,Federico Tombari
机构: Google(谷歌); Ulm University(乌尔姆大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:On-policy self-distillation enables post-training foundation models without relying on stronger external teachers. However, existing approaches rely on ground-truth question-answer pairs, human-curated problem sets, or other supervised signals. In this work, we reformulate on-policy self-distillation as a self-training framework, driven by self-generated question-answer pairs and privileged reasoning demonstrations. We push supervision to the limit: guided solely by coarse, high-level topic descriptions, the model synthesizes its own curriculum of queries and privileged reasoning traces without access to any human-curated prompts or answers. We find that self-distillation on fully synthetic privileged information enables a model to improve across multiple domains while retaining its capabilities on domains it is not self-trained on. We demonstrate the generality of this framework across text and multimodal domains, achieving consistent self-improvement on standard language benchmarks and Visual Question Answering. Our findings demonstrate that foundation models possess rich latent capabilities that can be amplified without external task supervision or curated problem distributions.

[NLP-10] ActionRAG : Evidence-Refining Graph Diffusion for Long-Term Memory in LLM Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）智能体在长期记忆管理中面临的两个核心问题：一是索引阶段易出现实体碎片化或误合并，导致重复实体被拆分或不同实体被错误融合；二是在线检索阶段往往将初始相似度得分视为最终结果，忽视了上下文图结构所提供的修正证据。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为ActionRAG的图记忆架构，该架构通过“谨慎索引”与“查询时图反演评估”相结合的方式实现高效、一致的记忆检索。具体而言，索引阶段采用分层实体消歧策略并统一类型标签，以保障实体的一致性；查询阶段则通过双通道的实体与三元组检索构建局部有界图，并利用查询条件下的接收器归一化扩散机制，基于局部路径结构动态优化三元组得分。同时，种子保护、枢纽惩罚流和三元组显式化等机制有效保留直接证据并恢复遗漏的关联关系。实验表明，ActionRAG在MemoryAgentBench（MAB）基准上实现了55.1的平均准确率，相较最强的基于检索的记忆基线提升5.4分，且在消费级苹果硅芯片设备上，每查询平均合成成本低于0.001美元，检索侧99分位延迟为440.7毫秒，验证了其高效性与可扩展性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32752
作者: Navyansh Mahla,Sashank Vandrangi
机构: Actioneer(行动者)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM agents need long-term memory that can recover precise and mutually consistent evidence from growing interaction histories, particularly when answers depend on relations among facts rather than isolated semantic matches. Current memory pipelines remain vulnerable at two stages: indexing errors can fragment repeated entities or merge distinct ones, and online retrieval often treats initial similarity scores as final even when the surrounding graph provides evidence for revising them. We introduce ActionRAG, a graph memory architecture that couples cautious indexing with query-time graph retroevaluation. Its indexing pipeline reconciles type labels and applies tiered entity resolution. Given a query, dual-channel entity and triple retrieval forms an initial evidence set and induces a bounded local graph. Query-conditioned receiver-normalized diffusion refines triple scores using local path structure. Seed protection, hub-penalized flux, and triple materialization preserve direct evidence while recovering missed connections. We evaluate ActionRAG on MemoryAgentBench (MAB), which tests accurate retrieval, conflict resolution, long-range understanding, and test-time learning. Across its eight deterministic-scoring columns, ActionRAG achieves 55.1 average accuracy, improving over the strongest retrieval-based memory baseline by 5.4 points. Under MAB’s query-time cost accounting, mean synthesis cost stays below \ 0.001 per query on the four reported cost columns, and the sum of separately measured retrieval-side p99 components is 440.7 ms on our consumer Apple Silicon setup.

[NLP-11] Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Structured Metadata and Climate Science Publications

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决科学文献爆炸式增长与人工知识抽取速度之间严重不匹配的问题，即如何高效、准确地从海量科研文本中自动提取结构化知识。其核心挑战在于保证自动化抽取的知识在语义上的一致性与可追溯性。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于智能体（agent）的、受本体（ontology）引导的知识图谱（KG）构建框架：通过专用智能体分别执行文档理解、信息抽取、本体一致性校验和实体链接任务；利用大语言模型（LLM）从论文中提取带有显式文本证据的事实三元组，并引入多阶段验证机制，强制遵循本体模式约束并要求提供文本片段作为证据支持，从而确保知识的语义一致性与可追溯性。实验表明，该方法在1,000个三元组上的一致性达到Cohen’s κ = 0.640–0.700，接近人类标注者间的水平（0.616–0.689），且在2,000篇气候科学文献上构建的新型本体引导知识图谱包含133,990个节点和755,308条关系，经验证后98.96%的三元组被判定为正确，展现出卓越的准确性与实用性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32725
作者: Aayush Acharya,Qi Zhang,Eduard Dragut,Longin Jan Latecki
机构: Temple University(天普大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The rapid expansion of scientific literature far outpaces the speed of manual curation, creating a fundamental bottleneck in extracting structured knowledge from scientific texts. To address this, we introduce an agentic, ontology-guided framework for knowledge graph (KG) construction. Our framework utilizes specialized agents for document understanding, information extraction, ontology conformance, and entity linking. First, an LLM extracts factual knowledge in the form of triples with explicit textual evidence from research papers. Then the triplets undergo a multistage verification process to ground the triplets in the ontology. By enforcing schema constraints and requiring evidence in the form of text fragments, we ensure the data is both semantically consistent and traceable. In an agreement study over 1,000 extracted triplets, Gemini-2.5-flash achieves Cohen’s \kappa scores of 0.640–0.700 against three human annotators, matching the human–human agreement range of 0.616–0.689. We applied this framework to 2,000 scientific publications and construct a novel, ontology-grounded KG for climate science with 133,990 nodes and 755,308 relations; of the 23,327 triplets that the publications contribute after validation, 98.96% are judged correct. The pipeline code and KG is publicly available this https URL.

[NLP-12] CounselPlex: A Stressor-Aware Full-Duplex Counseling Model

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决全双工语音模型（full-duplex speech models）在心理咨询场景中存在“压力源盲视”（Stressor Blindness）的问题，即模型在实时交互中过度关注最新话语，而忽视来访者潜在的核心心理困扰，导致对话缺乏连贯性与深度。其解决方案的关键在于提出CounselPlex框架，通过两个核心机制实现：一是利用来访者沉默期间更新短期压力源状态（short stressor state），并在听觉处理阶段将该状态注入到填充位置（PAD positions）中，以保持对关键心理线索的持续感知；二是引入旋转位置编码位置偏移增强（RoPE Position Shift Augmentation, RPSA），通过扩大训练时的位置覆盖范围，提升模型在长对话轮次中的表现。实验结果表明，该方法在大语言模型（LLM）评判下显著提升了咨询质量与压力源关联性，优于多个强基线模型。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32702
作者: Yeonju Kim,Bella Godiva,Yong Man Ro
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Sound (cs.SD)
备注: 21 pages, 4 figures, 29 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Full-duplex speech models can listen and speak at the same time, enabling natural, low-latency interaction. In counseling, however, these models often focus on the latest utterance and lose track of the seeker’s underlying problem. We call this failure Stressor Blindness. We propose CounselPlex, a stressor-aware full-duplex framework that uses two operations. CounselPlex updates a short stressor state during seeker silence and injects this state into PAD positions while listening. We also introduce RoPE Position Shift Augmentation (RPSA), which broadens positional coverage during training and improves performance at longer turn depths in our evaluation. LLM-judge evaluations show improved counseling quality and stressor grounding over strong baselines.

[NLP-13] Natural Language Autoencoders Identify Without Explaining

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自然语言自编码器（Natural Language Autoencoders, NLAs）在模型可解释性研究中所面临的“描述忠实性”（descriptive faithfulness）缺失问题。尽管NLAs通过将模型内部激活向量（activation）转化为可读文本并重构回原始激活，以验证信息的完备性，但其评估标准仅关注重建准确性，未能确保生成的自然语言解释在语义上真实反映激活的实际功能。这种偏差与“思维链忠实性”（chain-of-thought faithfulness）问题具有相同的结构：即模型输出的自然语言虽能与推理过程共现，却未必真实揭示其内在机制。这一现象类似于人类心理学中内省报告与实际认知过程之间的分离。因此，尽管NLAs被设计为用于对齐（alignment）的可解释性工具，其依赖未经验证的自然语言解释反而引入了原本试图消除的认知论困境（epistemic problem），核心问题在于：重建成功不等于解释正确。解决方案的关键在于建立对自然语言解释的语义忠实性评估机制，而非仅依赖重构精度作为唯一判据。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32691
作者: Kristina Šekrst,Barbara Geld
机构: University of Zagreb (萨格勒布大学); Vienna University of Technology (维也纳工业大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: ISPSM 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) express a model’s internal activations in the form of readable text. The verbalizer turns an activation into an English explanation; the reconstructor then converts that explanation back into an activation, and the explanation is considered successful if the round trip brings back the original activation. We claim that this criterion evaluates whether the information is sufficient and does not address descriptive faithfulness. A sentence can contain sufficient information to make it possible to identify an activation even if it wrongly explains what the activation does: in the case of reconstruction, the primary aim is to accurately identify the activations and not to describe them. This issue has the same structure as the chain-of-thought faithfulness problem, in which verbal output that has been trained to go with a process is taken as a report on that process, and it parallels the dissociation between an individual’s introspective report and the actual governing process as documented in human psychology. Although proposed as interpretability tools for the purpose of alignment, NLAs reintroduce, through unverified explanations, the epistemic problem that they were intended to resolve.

[NLP-14] When is more search useful? An Empirical Study of Search Utility in Quality-Aware Decoding for Machine Translation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决机器翻译中测试时扩展（test-time scaling）策略效率不足的问题，即在生成多个候选翻译并选择最优结果时，对所有源句均采用相同的候选预算（candidate budget），忽略了不同句子在搜索过程中所需资源的差异性。这种固定预算假设忽视了不同输入句子在质量提升潜力上的异质性。其解决方案的关键在于引入质量感知的动态搜索策略，通过分析三个核心指标——总扩展增益（total scaling gain）、边际扩展增益（marginal scaling gain）和采样饱和点（sampling saturation point），来量化每句话从额外候选生成中所能获得的质量提升。研究发现，句子层面的先验信号（如句长、复杂度等）与总扩展增益相关性较强，但难以预测采样饱和点；而搜索过程中积累的候选池统计特征则能有效反映边际扩展增益。基于这些可预测信号，系统可识别出更可能从额外搜索中获益的句子，并实现选择性地增加搜索预算，从而在不增加整体计算开销的前提下显著提升翻译质量。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32679
作者: Javier Garcia Gilabert,Rico Sennrich,André F. T. Martins
机构: University of Zurich (苏黎世大学); Instituto Superior Técnico, Universidade de Lisboa (里斯本理工学院); Instituto de Telecomunicações (电信研究所); ELLIS Unit Lisbon (欧洲机器学习与智能系统联盟里斯本单位)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Quality-Aware Decoding (QAD) improves machine translation through test-time scaling, generating multiple candidate translations and selecting the final output with a quality-aware decoder. Usually the same candidate budget N is spent on every source sentence, assuming that all inputs require the same amount of search. We show that this assumption does not hold and that the quality gain obtained from additional candidates varies across sentences. We study search utility through three quantities: total scaling gain, how much quality a sentence can gain from a much larger candidate pool; marginal scaling gain, the expected gain from generating one additional batch of candidates; and the sampling saturation point, the candidate budget required to realize most of the total scaling gain. We investigate two sources of information for predicting these quantities: signals available before candidate-set expansion, and statistics computed from the candidate pool accumulated during search. We find that sentence-level signals correlate with total scaling gain but are less informative about the sampling saturation point. In contrast, properties of the current candidate pool provide useful signals of marginal scaling gain. Finally, we show that these signals can identify sentences that obtain larger gains when additional search is selectively applied.

[NLP-15] Residual Expert Routing for Text-Only Domain Adaptation of Factorized Transducer ASR ICASSP2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在目标领域文本上微调因子化变换器（factorized transducer）的非空白预测器（non-blank predictor）时，虽能提升目标域识别性能，但会导致源域性能下降的灾难性遗忘问题。其核心挑战在于：适应后的预测器在某些前缀处有益，而在另一些前缀处有害，甚至在同一语音片段内交替出现，单一插值权重无法有效平衡这种不一致性。为此，作者提出保守残差路由（conservative residual routing）机制：将适配后的预测器作为对基础预测器的残差修正项，并引入一个16k参数的门控网络（gate），在每个前缀处动态决定是否采纳该修正。通过关闭门控可完全复现原始基础模型的行为。实验表明，在40小时对话语料上，该方法在两个保留测试域中几乎完整保留了仅基于文本的增益（词错误率WER从19.89降至16.74，20.91降至16.21），同时保持源域性能稳定（WER从12.90微增至12.93），而仅使用适配预测器则导致1.08 WER的性能损失。分析显示，该门控机制并非简单的领域级开关，而是通过量化两预测器间的分歧程度，对干预强度进行动态调节——在域内抑制分歧，在域外放大分歧，从而实现更精细、鲁棒的自适应。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32637
作者: Shashi Kumar,Esaú Villatoro-Tello,Thibault Bañeras-Roux,Sergio Burdisso,Petr Motlicek,Kadri Hacioglu,Andreas Stolcke
机构: Google(谷歌); University of Edinburgh (爱丁堡大学); Meta(元); Stanford University (斯坦福大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Paper submitted to ICASSP 2027 (Under review)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Fine-tuning the non-blank predictor of a factorized transducer on target-domain text improves recognition on that domain but degrades performance on the source domain. A single interpolation weight between base and adapted predictors cannot resolve this: the adapted predictor helps at some prefixes and hurts at others, often within one utterance. We propose conservative residual routing: the adapted predictor becomes a residual correction to the base, and a 16k-parameter gate decides at each prefix how much of it to admit. Closing the gate reproduces the base exactly. On a 40-hour conversational corpus, routing retains essentially all of the text-only gain on two held-out domains (19.89 to 16.74, 20.91 to 16.21 WER) while leaving source-domain WER unchanged (12.90 to 12.93); the adapted predictor alone costs 1.08 WER. Routing needs no per-domain tuning on target-domain audio. Analysis reveals the gate does not behave as a simple domain-level switch: it modulates intervention through the disagreement between the two predictors, suppressing it in-domain and amplifying it out-of-domain.

[NLP-16] PHYRD: A Living Benchmark for Reproducing and Extending Theoretical Physics Research

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 在理论物理推理任务中缺乏系统性评估基准与高质量训练数据的问题。现有模型在复现已有物理推导结果（Reproduce）和探索修改理论条件后的潜在结论（Discover）方面表现参差，且普遍存在概念性错误与论证缺失。为此，研究提出PHYRD，一个包含63个复现类问题与43个发现类问题的动态基准，通过FormulaForest构建具有参考解法和子问题级评分标准的任务体系，以实现对模型推理能力的精细化评估。其解决方案的关键在于：一是设计兼具科学严谨性与可扩展性的任务框架，区分“复现”与“发现”两类能力；二是利用FormulaForest生成高质量合成数据，有效提升模型在复杂理论物理任务中的表现，如在FrontierScience基准上将Qwen-35B-A3B模型的准确率从61%提升至72%，验证了合成数据对模型泛化能力的显著促进作用。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32575
作者: Qituan Zhang,Guo Chen,Linfeng Zhang,Wenlong Zhang
机构: EPIC Lab, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (上海交通大学); Fudan University (复旦大学); University of Electronic Science and Technology of China (电子科技大学); University of Science and Technology of China (中国科学技术大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models and agents have shown significant power in advanced physical research. In this paper, We introduce PHYRD, a living benchmark for theoretical-physics reasoning with 63 Reproduce and 43 Discover problems. Reproduce tests derivation of published results; Discover tests consequences of modified theoretical conditions. FormulaForest constructs the tasks with reference solutions and subquestion-level rubrics. Across five models, whole-problem accuracy ranges from 49.21% to 68.25% on Reproduce and from 18.60% to 74.42% on closed-book Discover. With tools, four models complete more Discover problems, but conceptual errors and missing arguments persist. Besides, our experimental results demonstrate the value of FormulaForest as synthetic data. On FrontierScience, a benchmark developed by OpenAI, it raises the accuracy of a Qwen-35B-A3B model from 61% to 72%.

[NLP-17] Pseudo-Labels as Rewards Not Targets: Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Semi-Supervised ASR ICASSP2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在仅有未转录音频的领域中，自适应自动语音识别（ASR）时因伪标签（pseudo-labeling）引入噪声而导致模型性能下降的问题。传统监督微调（SFT）将每个伪标签词元视为目标，导致学生模型完全继承教师模型的错误；而本文提出的关键解决方案是采用组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO），将相同的伪标签用作奖励参考而非直接目标。相较于SFT，GRPO对标签噪声具有更强的鲁棒性，其核心机制在于：错误的伪标签词在在线策略回溯（on-policy rollout）中极少出现，因此组相对优势仍与干净转录文本保持一致，从而维持了奖励方差，使优化方向不被噪声误导。实验表明，在金融领域，基于Whisper生成的伪标签，GRPO相较SFT实现29.3%至56.2%的相对词错误率（WER）提升，且在不同Whisper模型规模、教师模型族、语种及跨领域场景下均保持优势；同时，GRPO仅传递教师错误的27%，而SFT几乎完全复现（接近100%）。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32572
作者: Shashi Kumar,Yanis Labrak,Sergio Burdisso,Esaú Villatoro-Tello,Petr Motlicek,Kadri Hacioglu,Andreas Stolcke
机构: Google(谷歌); Meta(元); Stanford University (斯坦福大学); University of Southern California (南加州大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)
备注: submitted to ICASSP 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Adapting ASR to a domain with only untranscribed audio typically relies on pseudo-labeling, a strong teacher transcribes the audio and a student is fine-tuned on it. Because supervised fine-tuning (SFT) treats every pseudo-label token as a target, the student inherits the teacher’s errors. We show that using the same pseudo-labels as a reward reference for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is more robust to label noise. In the banking domain, GRPO yields 29.3% to 56.2% relative WER improvements over SFT on Whisper-generated labels, and the advantage holds across four Whisper sizes, four teacher families, three domains and four languages. While SFT reproduces almost 100% of teacher errors verbatim, GRPO passes through only 27%. Rollout statistics explain why, erroneous pseudo-label words rarely appear in on-policy rollouts, so group-relative advantages stay aligned with the clean transcript, whereas SFT forces them into the policy’s support and collapses the reward variance GRPO relies on.

[NLP-18] Principled Nonlinear Concept Erasure and Steering

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式表示中隐含敏感属性（如性别、种族等）所带来的隐私与安全问题，即如何在不损害任务相关语义信息的前提下，有效且可信赖地消除这些敏感特征。现有方法存在明显局限：线性方法仅能保证对线性探测器的鲁棒性，而非线性方法虽在实证上表现更优，却缺乏理论保障且常以牺牲模型效用为代价。本文提出一种基于条件自编码器的系统性框架，其核心在于遵循“仅移除敏感属性而不影响其他内容”的原则，并证明在特定假设下，若实现完美重建且敏感属性与表示在总体层面独立，则可达到理想的非线性保护性（nonlinear guardedness），并在重建不完美的情况下仍具备可证明的保留性保障。实验结果表明，该方法在多个数据集、敏感属性及语言模型上均实现了更优的效用-擦除权衡，超越了需使用目标任务标签的监督型基线方法，且无需额外训练成本即可实现概念转换（概念转向，concept conversion），即通过在推理阶段调整目标概念值，即可生成对应不同概念取值的表示，这一能力是以往擦除方法所不具备的，且同样展现出卓越的实证性能。

机构: Bar-Ilan University (巴伊兰大学); New York University (纽约大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Learned representations often encode sensitive attributes, such as gender or race, that may be undesirable or unsafe to retain. Concept erasure aims to remove this information while preserving task-relevant content. Existing methods remain incomplete: linear methods provide guarantees only against linear probes, while nonlinear methods achieve stronger empirical erasure but lack formal guarantees and often sacrifice utility. In this work, we introduce a principled conditional autoencoder framework for nonlinear concept erasure. We follow the principle that erasure should remove only the sensitive attribute and nothing else, and we show that, under the stated assumptions, perfect reconstruction together with population-level independence is sufficient for perfect nonlinear guardedness, with preservation guarantees in the imperfect-reconstruction regime. Empirically, we attain a superior utility-erasure trade-off across multiple datasets, sensitive attributes, and language models, surpassing even the supervised variants of competing methods despite using no target-task labels, while being simpler to optimize and converging substantially faster. Beyond erasure, our framework yields concept conversion (representation steering) as a by-product: by changing only the target concept at inference time, it produces representations corresponding to different concept values - at no additional training cost - a capability no prior erasure method provides, and on which we likewise demonstrate strong empirical performance.

[NLP-19] Analysing Austrian Parliamentary Speeches by Predicting Party Affiliations

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决如何量化分析奥地利国民议会成员（CMs）演讲特征随时间演变的难题，尤其关注政党间政治关系变化对语言风格的影响。其核心挑战在于如何从大量政治演讲中提取具有语义意义的政党倾向性特征，并区分“正常”与“异常”的语言表现。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于微调BERT模型的分析方法，该模型为每篇演讲生成一个关于奥地利各政党的概率分布，进而实现对演讲者及政党层面的聚合分析。不同于传统将预测偏差视为模型性能缺陷的做法，本文创造性地将误判结果作为洞察政治互动与身份转换的依据：研究发现，执政联盟政党在演讲特征上趋于趋同，而反对党则逐渐远离执政党；且议员在政党转换后，其语言特征仅在转换完成后才发生显著调整。该研究不仅揭示了语言与政治关系之间的动态关联，还公开发布了1996至2018年间奥地利国民议会全部演讲的政党归属预测数据集，为后续研究提供了重要资源。

作者: Sarah Sulollari,Vanja Karan,Benjamin Roth
机构: University of Vienna(维也纳大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computers and Society (cs.CY); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

Abstract:This paper examines speech characteristics of the Austrian National Council members (CMs). We introduce analysis methodology based on a fine-tuned BERT-Model which assigns to every speech a probability distribution over Austrian parties. These are then aggregated at the speaker and party level. We perform an extensive evaluation to ensure the quality of the generated distributions prior to further analysis. Instead of considering mis-assignments of predicted parties as a performance issue, we leverage them to derive insights about the CMs and political developments. Our findings show that parties that govern together become more similar in their speech characteristics, while, analogously, parties that are in opposition move further away from governing parties. Moreover, CMs who switch party usually adapt their speech characteristics only after the switch occurs. Finally, we publicly release a data set containing party affiliation predictions for the speeches of the Austrian National Council from 1996 to 2018.

[NLP-20] he Punjabi Geet Toxicity Dataset (PGT-FG): Fine-Grained Multimodal Annotations for Toxic Content in Punjabi Songs

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决旁遮普语（Punjabi）音乐内容中毒性检测资源匮乏的问题，尤其针对融合语言与多模态信息的复杂语境。其核心解决方案是构建首个面向旁遮普语音乐内容的细粒度毒性检测数据集——旁遮普语歌曲毒性数据集（Punjabi Geet Toxicity Dataset, PGT-FG）。该数据集基于从YouTube公开获取的620首旁遮普语歌曲，经质量控制与标注后，最终获得2,396个唯一音频片段（来自392首歌曲），由四位母语旁遮普语标注者完成2,870条标注记录，其中158个片段为四人共同标注的共享子集。每条标注包含二分类毒性标签、八类细粒度毒性类别、严重程度、情感倾向、表达模式及不确定性标记。通过Fleiss’ kappa评估标注一致性，采用多数投票法确定最终段落级标签，整体毒性标签达成显著一致性（kappa = 0.6521）。结果显示，29.42%的片段被标记为有毒，其中暴力相关内容最为普遍（占所有有毒片段的76.45%）。该数据集为旁遮普语毒性检测与多模态内容分析提供了重要支持，且已通过Zenodo公开发布，原始歌词与受版权保护的音视频内容未重新分发。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32513
作者: Lakhjeet Kaur,Jaspreet Kaur,Komal Rani,Yougal Attri,Ramakant KumarJaydeep Kishore,Pravin Kumar
机构: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (印度德里古尔·戈宾德·辛格印第普拉斯特大学); Malwa College Bathinda (马尔瓦学院巴廷达); Akal University Talwandi Sabo (阿卡尔大学塔尔万迪萨博); Independent Researcher (独立研究员); Galgotias College of Engineering Technology (加尔戈蒂亚工程与技术学院); UPES Dehradun (UPES 德拉顿)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Resources for toxicity detection in Punjabi remain limited, particularly for musical content that combines linguistic and multimodal information. We present the Punjabi Geet Toxicity Dataset (PGT-FG), a segment-level resource developed to support research on toxicity detection in Punjabi musical content. The dataset was constructed from publicly available Punjabi songs collected from YouTube. An initial collection of 620 songs resulted in 465 successfully downloaded songs and 3,402 preliminary segments from 450 songs. After quality control and annotation, the final dataset contains 2,396 unique segments from 392 songs. Four native Punjabi annotators produced 2,870 annotation records, including a shared subset of 158 segments annotated by all four. Each annotation includes binary toxicity, eight fine-grained toxicity categories, severity, sentiment, mode, and an uncertainty flag. Inter-annotator agreement was measured with Fleiss’ kappa on the shared subset, and majority-based resolution produced the final segment-level labels. Of the 2,396 segments, 705 (29.42%) were labelled toxic and 1,691 (70.58%) non-toxic. Violence was the most frequent category, occurring in 539 toxic segments (76.45%), followed by gang references (227, 32.20%) and drug references (133, 18.87%). The overall toxicity label achieved substantial agreement (kappa = 0.6521). PGT-FG provides a fine-grained resource for Punjabi toxicity detection and multimodal content analysis. The resolved dataset, with one final record per segment, is publicly available on Zenodo (this https URL). Original lyrics, lyric excerpts, and copyrighted audio or video content are not redistributed.

[NLP-21] Accordion: Elastic-Depth Inference via Fixed-Prefix Layer Looping

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型在不同推理预算（inference budget）下维持高性能的难题，尤其针对为每个预算单独训练和维护模型所带来的高昂成本。现有方法如环状变压器（Looped Transformers）虽通过参数复用实现了推理计算的灵活性，但在跨预算性能一致性方面仍存在挑战。为此，本文提出Accordion——一种基于专家混合（mixture-of-experts）架构的模型，通过固定前缀层循环（fixed-prefix layer looping）支持五种不同的推理预算。其核心创新在于：每个预算遵循预定义的执行路径，最低预算保留未循环的基础模型；在联合预训练阶段，每微批次仅采样一个预算并优化其下一个词预测损失，无需额外的跨预算一致性约束。进一步地，通过监督微调与强化学习，采用参数组合并及预算匹配的多教师在线蒸馏（budget-matched multi-teacher on-policy distillation），将三个领域专家整合至单一模型中。实验表明，在3.6万亿token预训练后，增加推理深度使Accordion-6B-A0.5B在37项任务上的五类宏平均准确率提升3.01个百分点，其中中间预算仅使用一半额外层数执行量即捕获89%的增益。最终模型在各对应任务与预算下的平均表现均优于独立专家，且在所有预算下均展现出优异的指令遵循能力，并保持在数学推理与代码生成任务中的深度依赖性增益。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32492
作者: Yudong Zhang,Wei Ding,Kaili Zheng,Yuchen Ding,Zhenyu Zhang
机构: 未知
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models serve applications with diverse inference budgets, but training and maintaining separate models for each budget incurs substantial costs. Recent Looped Transformers enable flexible inference computation through parameter reuse, but maintaining strong performance across different inference budgets remains an open challenge. We introduce Accordion, a mixture-of-experts-based model that supports five inference budgets through fixed-prefix layer looping. Each budget follows a pre-defined execution path, while the minimum budget retains the unlooped model. Joint pretraining samples one budget per micro-batch and optimizes its next-token prediction loss without additional cross-budget consistency objectives. We further preserve these inference budgets through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, where parameter-group merging and budget-matched multi-teacher on-policy distillation integrate three domain experts into one model. After 3.6T tokens of pretraining, increasing inference depth improves Accordion-6B-A0.5B’s five-category macro-average across 37 tasks by 3.01 percentage points, with the middle budget capturing 89% of this gain using half as many additional layer executions. The final model surpasses each domain expert on its corresponding task-and-budget average, while achieving strong instruction-following performance across all budgets and retaining depth-dependent gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation.

[NLP-22] When Agents Fail: Model or Harness–Whos to Blame?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）智能体在评估过程中，其执行框架（harness）与底层模型协同行为对基准测试结果的影响问题。传统评估往往将模型性能与框架表现混同，忽略了二者交互的复杂性。本文提出一个包含五项互补度量的综合评估框架：（i）有效完成率（Valid Completion Rate, VCR），衡量智能体在不依赖任务正确性的前提下完成任务并生成可评估结果的可靠性；（ii）模型-框架适配度（Model-Harness Fit），反映特定框架对某一模型任务达成的支持能力；（iii）跨模型适配度（Cross-Model Fit），评估框架在不同模型间的通用性；（iv）交互残差（Interaction Residuals），揭示组件级汇总所掩盖的成对执行中的优势与缺陷；（v）令牌负载（Token Load），量化执行过程中的总令牌消耗，包括失败尝试。研究对四种通用框架（OpenCode、Codex CLI、Pi CLI、DeepAgents）及两种原生模型-框架系统，在六个涵盖上下文管理、工具使用、长上下文规划、多模态交互与产物传递的基准上进行了全面评估，共覆盖111个实验设置，生成52,168条执行轨迹。结果显示，框架排名随模型和任务而异，任务性能与有效完成率常呈现不同最优组合，且相似任务得分可能对应截然不同的执行特征。其中，OpenCode在跨模型表现中排名第一，而DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview在共享四基准面板上表现出一致高的平均VCR。研究结论强调应重视模型-框架的协同评估，推动模型训练具备可迁移的框架使用能力，并倡导针对具体模型与任务定制化框架设计。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32483
作者: Shao Zhang,Hangfan Zhang,Yuanyuan Shi,Hao Li,Min-Le Su,Kangcong Li,Jingping Wang,Chunjiang Mu,Chen Zhang,Yang Chen,Bo Zhang,Shuyue Hu
机构: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Software Engineering (cs.SE)
备注: Preprint under review

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM agents combine models with execution harnesses, so agentic benchmark performance reflects their joint behavior. We argue that harnesses should therefore be evaluated through their interactions with underlying models. We develop a framework combining five complementary measures: (i) Valid Completion Rate (VCR), how reliably agents finish normally and deliver evaluable results, irrespective of task correctness; (ii) Model-Harness Fit, how well a harness supports task achievement through valid completion for a given model; (iii) Cross-Model Fit, a harness’s overall suitability across evaluated models; (iv) Interaction Residuals, pairing-specific execution strengths and weaknesses hidden by component-level summaries; and (v) Token Load, the token demands of agent execution, including failed attempts. We evaluate four general-purpose harnesses (OpenCode, Codex CLI, Pi CLI, and DeepAgents) with four core models, plus two fixed native model-harness systems, on six benchmarks covering context management, tool use, long-context planning, multimodal interaction, and artifact handoff. Including native references and stress conditions, 111 evaluation settings yield 52,168 trajectories. Harness rankings vary across models and benchmarks; task performance and valid completion can favor different pairings, and similar task scores can accompany distinct execution profiles. OpenCode ranks first in cross-model performance, while DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview maintains consistently high Mean VCR across harnesses on the shared four-benchmark panel. These findings support evaluating model-harness interactions, training transferable harness-use capabilities in models, and harness designs adapted to the model and task.

[NLP-23] Beyond Post-Hoc Rewards: Privileged Reasoning Exploration for Multimodal Embeddings

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态嵌入模型在训练过程中缺乏对推理过程有效引导的问题。现有方法虽利用生成式能力通过自生成推理增强输入以提升嵌入质量，但传统检索监督仅指定输入间的相关性关系，未显式指导推理路径的生成，导致推理过程存在多种可能且难以确保与检索任务相关的语义线索被充分挖掘。其关键解决方案在于提出PILOT框架，将推理建模为潜在变量，并在共享的多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Model, MLLM）中构建先验（prior）与后验（posterior）两种推理模式：先验仅依赖输入信息，而后验则结合训练阶段的关联性证据以引导更广泛的推理探索。为将后验的扩展探索优势转化为推理阶段的实际性能提升，该框架进一步设计了一种重要性加权变分目标，并实现为先验-后验协同进化机制，在共享推理兼容奖励下同时优化两种模式，同时根据轨迹的实用性与先验可达性选择性地将后验路径迁移至先验。在78任务的MMEB-V2基准测试中，PILOT在2B和7B参数规模下均优于主基线，整体得分分别提升3.2和3.3点，尤其在视觉-文档检索任务中取得最大增益（+6.1和+6.4点）。研究结果表明，关系性监督的核心价值并非作为事后奖励，而在于塑造训练阶段推理探索的路径，从而显著提升推理增强型嵌入模型的检索性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32474
作者: Tianyu Yang,Yijun Tian,Lars Benedikt Kaesberg,Jan Philip Wahle,Bela Gipp,Terry Ruas,Daniel Kurzawe
机构: University of Göttingen(哥廷根大学); State and University Library of Göttingen(哥廷根大学与州立图书馆)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have driven substantial progress in multimodal embeddings. Recent methods exploit generative capabilities by augmenting embedded inputs with self-generated reasoning to produce more informative embeddings. However, conventional retrieval supervision for training embedding models specifies pairwise relevance relations without explicitly guiding the reasoning used for input augmentation. Such reasoning is neither directly observed nor uniquely determined by the input, allowing multiple plausible traces to introduce semantic cues of varying retrieval utility. Existing approaches largely optimize reasoning conditioned on the input alone, limiting the exploration of retrieval-relevant traces. We introduce PILOT, a framework that models reasoning as a latent variable and instantiates its prior and posterior distributions as distinct reasoning modes of a shared MLLM. The prior conditions only on the input, whereas the posterior uses additional training-time relational evidence to guide reasoning exploration. To translate the posterior’s broader exploration into inference-time improvements, we derive an importance-weighted variational objective and instantiate it as a prior-posterior co-evolution framework that improves both modes under a shared inference-compatible reward while selectively transferring posterior trajectories to the prior according to their utility and prior reachability. On the 78-task MMEB-V2 benchmark, PILOT outperforms the primary baseline across all 12 task groups at both 2B and 7B parameters, improving overall scores by 3.2 and 3.3 points, respectively, with the largest gains in visual-document retrieval (+6.1 and +6.4 points). Our results show that relational supervision is most valuable not as a post-hoc reward but as a signal for shaping how reasoning is explored in training reasoning-enhanced embedding models.

[NLP-24] Reading Between the Layers: Cross-Modal Alignment and Representational Hierarchy in Vision Transformers AACL2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大视觉-语言模型中视觉编码器对文本及其语义的处理机制不明确的问题，特别是其是否具备类似阅读理解的能力。研究通过构建渲染文本与视觉概念之间的跨模态对齐，并结合探针分析（probing）与基于检索的分析方法，系统考察了基于Transformer的视觉编码器在字形、语法和语义层面的组织能力。关键发现在于：强跨模态映射仅在深层特征中出现，此时单模态物体与文本识别已基本完成，且表征从表层形式逐步演化为语义层面。这一层次化结构在对比学习训练的模型中最为显著，但大规模自监督模型及富含文本的数据也能在无显式语言监督的情况下部分实现类似行为。因此，解决方案的关键在于：模型规模、训练数据量以及文本丰富度的提升，可在一定程度上弥补缺乏语言监督所带来的局限性。

作者: Sugam Karki,Raúl Vázquez,Yova Kementchedjhieva
机构: MBZUAI; University of Helsinki (赫尔辛基大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:While large vision-language models excel at optical character recognition, it remains unclear how their underlying vision encoders process text and its meaning, and whether they support anything resembling reading comprehension. We systematically study transformer-based vision encoders, using cross-modal alignment between rendered text and visual concepts together with probing and retrieval-based analyses as a controlled window into these broader capabilities. Our layer-wise analyses span orthographic, grammatical, and semantic organization, and reveal that strong cross-modal mapping emerges only in the deepest layers, after unimodal object and text recognition have already developed, coinciding with a progression from surface-level to semantic representations. Although this hierarchy is strongest in contrastively trained models, larger self-supervised models and text-rich training data partially support similar behaviors without explicit language supervision. Together, our results suggest that increasing model and training-data scale, as well as text-rich training data, can partially compensate for the absence of language supervision.

[NLP-25] Decoupling Patient Personas and Clinical Workflows: A Dual-Agent Approach to Realistic Medical Dialogue Generation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大规模获取真实预问诊医疗对话的难题，其核心挑战在于隐私与伦理限制导致真实对话数据难以获取，而现有基于大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的对话生成方法多依赖提示工程或固定规则，难以在临床相关性与患者多样性之间实现有效平衡。为此，本文提出一种可控的双代理框架——CoRPS-Dial，其关键在于通过融合患者角色画像（patient persona）与符合临床指南的流程化工作流规则，构建由人格驱动的患者代理与流程引导的医生代理之间的交互机制，从而生成兼具临床合规性与自然对话特征的合成对话。随后引入后处理质量控制模块，确保角色一致性、流程完整性与文本连贯性。实验结果表明，CoRPS-Dial在冠心病领域的合成对话在信息覆盖度、临床合规性及对话自然度等方面均显著提升与真实对话的一致性，且下游微调任务验证了合成数据的有效性，证明该方法能够实现临床语境下可控制、高质量的医疗对话生成。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32443
作者: Qiyuan Li,Xiaomei Guo,Chao Gao,Haijiang Liu,Deyu Chen,Caicai Guo,Jinguang Gu
机构: Wuhan University of Science and Technology (武汉科技大学); Huazhong University of Science and Technology (华中科技大学); Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (阿姆斯特丹自由大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
