点击查看摘要

Abstract:Pre-consultation medical dialogues are essential for collecting comprehensive patient information, but are costly to obtain at scale due to privacy and ethical constraints. Existing LLM-based synthesis methods often rely on prompt engineering or rigid rules, limiting their ability to balance clinical relevance with realistic patient diversity. We propose CoRPS-Dial, a controllable dual-agent framework for pre-consultation medical dialogue synthesis that integrates patient personas with guideline-aligned clinical workflow rules. CoRPS-Dial generates dialogues through interactions between a persona-driven patient agent and a process-guided doctor agent, followed by post-hoc quality control for role consistency, workflow completeness, and textual consistency. Experiments on coronary heart disease demonstrate that CoRPS-Dial improves alignment between synthetic and real dialogues in information coverage, clinical compliance, and dialogue naturalness. Downstream fine-tuning experiments further confirm the utility of the generated synthetic data for medical dialogue tasks. These results highlight the effectiveness of CoRPS-Dial for clinically grounded and controllable medical dialogue synthesis.

[NLP-26] SCI-AGENT -EXAM: Benchmarking Agents on Scientific Research Tasks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前大型语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）代理在支持科学工作流时，其跨多样化科研活动的能力难以系统评估的问题。现有基准测试通常仅聚焦于特定科学能力或任务类型，无法全面刻画科学代理在真实研究流程中的优势与短板。为此，本文提出SCI-AGENT-EXAM，一个以工作流为导向的基准测试，包含11个科学领域中120项由专家精心设计的任务，涵盖7类基于科学工作流任务分类体系（Scientific Workflow Task Taxonomy, SWTT）的研究任务类型。每项任务均要求生成可执行产物（如代码和脚本）与文本产物（如报告与解释）。为评估异构输出，研究设计了一种混合评估协议：对可执行产物采用确定性程序化验证，对文本产物则使用经校准且由专家验证的生成式AI（Generative AI）评判模型进行评估。此外，研究还分析了执行轨迹中的进展过程与解法稳定性，以揭示代理达成最终结果的动态路径。实验对比10个前沿LLM代理发现存在显著性能差距：GPT-6 Astra取得最高综合得分80.9，但仅有26.0%的运行达到0.95的成功阈值；进一步分析揭示不同任务类型间的能力分布差异显著，且在执行效率与稳定性方面表现出强烈异质性。解决方案的关键在于构建覆盖多领域、多任务类型的综合性工作流基准，并结合程序化验证与可信的生成式评估机制，实现对科学代理能力的多维度、精细化评估。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32441
作者: Tianyun Zhong,Wei Wang,Jialin Li,Jianhong Tu,Liyao Li,Chuqiao Kuang,Tianshi Zheng,Songchi Zhou,Weiqi Zhai,Qile Jin,Jiajia Li,Jiasheng Zheng,Boxi Cao,Yaojie Lu,Hongyu Lin,Shiwei Ye,Bing Zhao,Hu Wei,Lin Qu,Xianpei Han
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of supporting scientific workflows, but their capabilities across diverse research activities remain difficult to assess systematically. Existing benchmarks often focus on selected scientific capabilities or task types, limiting a comprehensive characterization of scientific agents’ strengths and weaknesses in realistic research workflows. We introduce SCI-AGENT-EXAM, a workflow-oriented benchmark comprising 120 expert-curated tasks across 11 scientific fields and 7 research task types defined by the Scientific Workflow Task Taxonomy (SWTT). Each task requires both executable artifacts (e.g., code and scripts) and textual artifacts (e.g., reports and explanations). To evaluate the heterogeneous task outputs, we develop a hybrid evaluation protocol combining deterministic programmatic verification for executable artifacts with a calibrated, expert-validated LLM-based judge for textual artifacts. Beyond outcome assessment, we analyze progress and solution stability along execution trajectories to characterize how agents reach their final results. Experiments with 10 frontier LLM agents reveal substantial performance gaps: GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest overall score of 80.9, yet only 26.0% of its runs exceed the 0.95 success threshold. Further analyses uncover distinct capability profiles across scientific task types and substantial variation in execution efficiency and stability. Our code and data are available at this https URL.

[NLP-27] Profile-Driven User Simulation via Reinforcement Learning with Hierarchical Rewards for Task-Oriented Dialogues

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决高价值场景（如金融营销）中任务导向对话（Task-Oriented Dialogue, TOD）系统构建所面临的领域特定对话数据稀缺问题，该问题受隐私法规、标注成本及专家人力需求的制约。现有用户模拟方法在通用领域对话场景下表现有限，主要存在两大缺陷：一是对领域内业务流程与合规约束建模不足，二是未能充分捕捉语音交互中口语化、自然语言表达的特征。为此，本文提出ProfileSim——一种面向金融营销外呼场景的基于用户画像驱动的用户模拟框架。其核心创新在于联合建模用户画像（人口统计学特征与大五人格特质）与业务画像（从真实通话日志中逆向工程提取的意图），实现对模拟行为的细粒度控制。模型在真实语音对话数据上进行微调，并通过分层奖励机制的组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization, GRPO）进一步精炼。结合集成标准操作流程（Standard Operating Procedure, SOP）约束与检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）的客服代理，ProfileSim在生成对话数据中表现出最优的口语自然度、最强的用户画像一致性以及对长尾意图的最低代理评分，同时生成语句更短且业务合规性相当。生成的数据可有效支持意图识别模型训练、代理评估及快速冷启动部署。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32435
作者: Juan Li,Fangshu Chang,Xinyi Jiang,Ling Huang,Yunzhang Chen
机构: Bairong Inc.
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Building Task-Oriented Dialogue (TOD) systems for high-value scenarios such as financial marketing requires large volumes of domain-specific dialogue data, which privacy regulations, annotation costs, and the need for expert labor make hard to obtain. User simulation offers a remedy, but existing methods target general-domain dialogue and exhibit two key limitations: insufficient modeling of domain-specific business processes and compliance constraints, and inadequate capture of the colloquial, spoken-language character of voice interactions. We propose ProfileSim, a profile-driven user simulation framework for financial marketing outbound calls. It jointly models user profiles—demographics and Big Five personality traits—and business profiles—intents reverse-engineered from real call logs—enabling fine-grained control over simulated behavior. The base model is fine-tuned on real voice dialogue data and refined by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with hierarchical rewards at the dialogue and utterance levels. Paired with a customer service agent integrating Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) constraints and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), ProfileSim achieves the highest colloquial naturalness, the strongest user profile adherence and the lowest agent score on long-tail intents among all evaluated user generators, while producing substantially shorter user utterances at comparable business compliance. The generated dialogue data is designed to support intent recognition training, agent evaluation, and rapid cold-start deployment.

[NLP-28] Cycle-of-Thought: Self-Evaluative Iterative Reasoning for Table Visual Question Answering in Document Images

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决视觉语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）在处理结构化内容（如表格）时存在的推理不一致问题，尤其是由空间错位和逻辑幻觉导致的错误。现有方法多依赖于架构改造或代价高昂的监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning, SFT），受限于大规模专家标注数据集和高算力需求，难以普及。为此，本文提出一种无需训练、仅在推理阶段执行的自修正框架——Self-RefineVQA，其核心在于模拟人类审校行为，使单一VLM通过迭代式“生成—批判—修正”的闭环反馈机制，在提示词引导下对自身推理过程进行重评估与修正。该方法不需额外标注数据或模型更新，显著提升了小模型（如2B–7B参数量级）在单语及跨语言表格问答任务中的表现，使其性能逼近远大于自身的大型模型。实验表明，尽管推理开销呈线性增长，但该框架在数据效率和总成本方面具有显著优势，有效规避了微调所需的人工标注瓶颈，为实现高效、可扩展的视觉-语言模型表结构推理提供了可行路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32423
作者: Somraj Gautam,Gaurav Harit
机构: IIT Jodhpur(印度理工学院焦德普尔分校); Rajasthan(拉贾斯坦邦), India(印度)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly improved Visual Question Answering (VQA) performance, yet their reasoning over structured content such as tables remains inconsistent, often plagued by spatial misalignment and logical hallucinations. Existing approaches for improving table VQA typically rely on architectural modifications or expensive supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which impose high barriers to entry due to the need for large-scale, expert-annotated datasets and significant computational resources. In this work, we propose Self-RefineVQA, a training-free, inference-time self-correction framework that improves table VQA performance without additional labeled data or model updates. Inspired by human revision behavior, our method enables a single VLM to iteratively act as a generator, critic, and refiner, forming a closed self-feedback loop that corrects common reasoning errors through prompt-guided re-evaluation. Experiments on tabular VQA benchmarks demonstrate that Self-RefineVQA yields consistent accuracy gains in monolingual and cross-lingual understanding, with a particularly significant boost for small models, enabling lightweight models (e.g., 2B-7B parameters) to rival the performance of significantly larger counterparts. Furthermore, we provide a comparative complexity analysis demonstrating that while inference cost increases linearly, our framework offers superior data efficiency and a lower cumulative cost by eliminating the prohibitive annotation bottleneck of human labeling required for fine-tuning. Our results highlight the potential of prompt-based self-improvement as a scalable, accessible paradigm for reliable table reasoning in VLMs.

[NLP-29] Can LLM Annotators Match Human Consistency? Benchmarking Human Agreement and Optimizing Multi-Agent with Contrastive Knowledge EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前基于大语言模型（LLM）的标注技术在实际应用中与真实标注流程脱节的问题。现有基准测试普遍采用单标签数据集，无法反映真实场景中多标注者对边界案例存在合理分歧的现象，且难以适应复杂、动态演进的任务指南，导致现有单智能体或工作流式标注系统缺乏足够的灵活性与鲁棒性。为弥合这一差距，论文提出ANT-A基准，这是一个涵盖7个跨领域、跨模态的真实世界多标注者基准，每个实例包含5个独立的人工标注及任务特定的详细指南，并引入基于Fleiss kappa的分布感知评估方法，以衡量模型标注结果与人类标注分布的一致性。其核心解决方案是ANT-OR多智能体标注框架，通过从正负反馈中提炼对比决策规则，动态优化提示（prompt），从而提升标注一致性。实验表明，ANT-OR在agree@=2准确率上比最强基线提升4.5个百分点，并在Fleiss kappa指标上与人类标注分布的对齐度仅相差2点，显著优于现有方法。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32415
作者: Xiaopeng Ke,Zhixin Wang,Xuebo Liu,Xinyu Ma,Xing Zheng,Bowen Song,Weiqiang Wang,Min Zhang
机构: ANT Group(蚂蚁集团); Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen)(哈尔滨工业大学（深圳)）
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings

点击查看摘要

Abstract:LLM-based annotation has advanced rapidly, yet existing benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world practice. Actual annotation often involves lengthy, task-specific guidelines, and different annotators may produce divergent but reasonable judgments, especially on boundary cases, where single-labeled dataset fail to reflect this disagreement. This gap also limits existing single-agent and workflow-based annotation systems, which often lack adaptability to complex, evolving guidelines. To bridge this gap, we introduce ANT-A Benchmark, a real-world multi-annotator benchmark spanning 7 datasets across domains and modalities, with task-specific guidelines and 5 independent human labels per instance. ANT-A enables a distribution-aware evaluation, using Fleiss kappa to assess how closely model annotations align with human labeling distributions. We further propose ANT-OR, a multi-agent annotation framework that refines prompts by distilling contrastive decision rules from positive and negative feedback. Experiments show that ANT-OR improves agreement@=2 accuracy by 4.5 points over the strongest baseline and achieves the highest alignment with human annotator distributions as measured by Fleiss kappa within 2 points. Code and benchmark are available at this https URL.

[NLP-30] A Broader Look into MLLM s Retrieval Heads

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态大语言模型（Multimodal Large Language Models, MLLMs）在长输入中定位相关证据的能力如何随输入模态扩展的问题。现有研究将这一能力归因于“检索头”（retrieval heads），即一组稀疏的注意力头，负责将上下文信息传递至输出。然而，先前分析局限于有限模态与模型，且未深入探讨如何有效利用检索头提升模型性能。本文以音视频输入作为新增模态，构建了语义一致但呈现方式不同的成对输入（语音或屏幕显示），在保持证据内容不变的前提下，发现检索头在新模态下依然保持稀疏性，并在不同模态间高度共享。跨18个语言、视觉-语言及全模态检查点的实验表明，全模态模型基本保留其基础模型的检索头结构；移除这些共享头会导致几乎完全丧失音视频检索能力。尽管跨模态共享的检索头不足全部注意力头的2%，但其缺失仍显著损害文档理解、空间感知和视觉数学能力。基于此，论文提出将检索头作为可优化目标，通过引入排序目标（ranking objective）对检索头的注意力进行训练，使Qwen3-VL-8B在MMDocIR上的页面召回率@1提升6.03点，并在三个模型族中均改善了文档检索表现。因此，功能性的注意力头不仅可作为解析多模态模型内部机制的“透镜”，也可成为提升模型性能的有效优化对象。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32411
作者: Jia Wang,Yuqing Li,Jiangnan Li,Zheng Lin,Mo Yu
机构: Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences(中国科学院信息工程研究所); School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences(中国科学院大学网络空间安全学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: work in progress

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Locating relevant evidence in long inputs is a core capability of Multimodal Large Language Models. Prior studies attribute this capability to retrieval heads, a sparse set of attention heads that transfer information from the context to the output. However, these analyses are confined to a limited set of modalities and the corresponding models. Moreover, how retrieval heads can be leveraged to enhance the model calls for further exploration. In this paper, we ask whether this mechanism expands together with the input modalities of the model. Taking audio-visual input as a newly added modality, we construct paired inputs in which the same answer is either spoken or shown on screen. With the evidence content fixed, retrieval heads remain sparse in the new modality and are shared to a large extent across modalities. Across 18 language, vision-language, and omni-modal checkpoints, omni-modal models largely preserve the retrieval heads of their backbones. Ablating these heads eliminates nearly all audio-visual retrieval. The heads shared across modalities make up fewer than 2% of all heads, yet ablating them also degrades document understanding, spatial perception, and visual mathematics. Building on these findings, we turn retrieval heads into a target of optimization by training their attention with a ranking objective. This raises the page Recall@1 of Qwen3-VL-8B on MMDocIR by 6.03 points and improves document retrieval across three model families. Functional attention heads can thus serve both as a lens on multimodal models and as a target for improving them.

[NLP-31] Acoustic and Lexical Signals for Native Language Identification of Language Learners

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决第二语言学习者母语（L1）识别问题，传统方法主要依赖语音的声学特征，而对语音转录文本中蕴含的母语痕迹关注较少。本文提出一种结合语音信号与对应转录文本的多模态研究范式，通过对比基于WavLM的音频L1分类器与基于零样本GPT-4o的文本分类器在CEFR平衡评估集上的表现，探究不同语言熟练度水平下两类模型的性能差异。其解决方案的关键在于：利用多模态信息互补性——音频模型在初级（A1）水平表现更优，而文本模型在中级至高级（A2–C1）水平凭借完整转录文本展现出更强判别能力；同时发现文本分类准确率随熟练度提升而显著上升，而声学模型性能相对稳定；此外，文本模型对输入长度敏感，受限于短文本时性能大幅下降，而音频模型对输入长度不敏感，具备更强的鲁棒性。研究揭示了语音与文本表征在母语识别中的差异化优势及其与学习者熟练度和数据量的关系，为多模态语言分析提供了重要实证依据。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32382
作者: Ahmet Yavuz Uluslu,Mengjie Qian,Kate Knill,Mark Gales
机构: ALTA Institute, Department of Engineering, University of Cambridge (ALTA 研究所，工程系，剑桥大学); Department of Computational Linguistics, University of Zurich (计算语言学系，苏黎世大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Accepted for publication at NLP4CALL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Spoken native language (L1) identification for second language learners has traditionally relied on acoustic attributes of speech. Comparatively little attention has been paid to analysing speech transcripts for L1 traces. In this paper, we present a study of L1 identification using both speech and corresponding transcripts from a spoken learner English corpus. We compare a WavLM-based audio L1 classifier with a zero-shot GPT-4o classifier operating on transcripts and analyse their predictions across proficiency levels using a CEFR-balanced evaluation set. Our experiments show that the audio classifier outperforms the transcript-based approach overall when full transcripts are available, although their relative strengths vary with learner proficiency. Audio performs better at A1, whereas text performs better from A2 to C1 with full transcripts. Transcript-based accuracy generally increases with proficiency, while acoustic performance remains comparatively stable. Restricting transcript length substantially reduces text-based accuracy, whereas audio is less sensitive to input length and performs relatively well with limited input. These findings provide insights into L1 identification from acoustic and textual representations of learner speech and how performance varies with proficiency and the amount of available language material.

[NLP-32] Why Full-Duplex Speech Models Collapse in Long Conversations

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决全双工语音模型（full-duplex speech models）在长时间连续对话中面临的上下文窗口耗尽与对话质量退化问题。尽管这些模型具备同时听与说的能力，适合自然、开放式的对话场景，但因其每帧生成一个词元（token），即使在倾听时也持续消耗上下文空间，导致在数十分钟的长对话中迅速耗尽上下文容量。现有基准测试仅评估单轮或少量对话回合，无法揭示长期对话中的系统性失效问题。为此，作者提出全双工长时程基准测试（Full-Duplex Long-Horizon Benchmark, FD-LHB），对五种近期全双工模型进行长时重放对话和与大语言模型（LLM）实时交互的评估。结果表明，所有模型最终均出现性能退化或上下文耗尽。其中，保留完整历史的模型虽未达上下文上限，却仍发生语义退化；采用滑动窗口机制的模型则陷入重复、沉默及无意义输出。研究进一步诊断出两个关键机制：无意义输出与沉默源于“初始化锚点驱逐”（Initialization-Anchor Eviction），即滑动窗口丢弃首个键值（KV）条目；而重复现象则受模型自身近期输出的反馈强化。基于此诊断，提出两项无需重新训练的简单改进策略：初始化锚点固定（Initialization-Anchor Pinning, IAP）以保留初始键值条目，以及全双工重复惩罚（Duplex Repetition Penalty, DRP）以抑制自我重复并防止长期沉默。二者协同作用，在不重新训练的前提下，显著缓解长达一小时的重放对话中的对话崩溃现象，并支持实时运行。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32349
作者: Yeonju Kim,Bella Godiva,Se Jin Park,Yong Man Ro
机构: KAIST(韩国科学技术院); Kyung Hee University(庆熙大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Sound (cs.SD)
备注: Preprint. 31 pages, 16 figures, 18 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Full-duplex speech models listen and speak at the same time, which makes them promising for natural, open-ended conversation. But can they sustain a coherent conversation for tens of minutes? Because they generate a token every frame, even while listening, they exhaust their context windows within minutes. Yet existing benchmarks evaluate only single turns or a few conversational rounds, too short to expose the long-horizon problem. We introduce the Full-Duplex Long-Horizon Benchmark (FD-LHB), which tests five recent full-duplex models on long replayed conversations and in live conversation with an LLM partner. Every evaluated model eventually either degrades or exhausts its context. Models that keep the full history often degrade before their context runs out, while sliding-window models still fall into repetition, silence, and gibberish. For sliding-window models, we identify two contributing mechanisms. Gibberish and silence are linked to Initialization-Anchor Eviction, where the sliding window discards the first KV entry. Repetition is also reinforced by the model’s own recent outputs. Guided by this diagnosis, we apply two simple fixes: Initialization-Anchor Pinning (IAP) keeps that first entry, and Duplex Repetition Penalty (DRP) discourages echoing while guarding against prolonged silence. Together, they support the diagnosis and, without retraining, substantially reduce conversational collapse in replays of up to an hour while running in real time.

[NLP-33] Beyond Final Outcomes: Quantifying Claim-Level Information Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Interaction

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）驱动的多智能体系统在协作过程中，信息交互的动态演化机制被忽视的问题。传统多智能体评估仅关注最终任务结果，而忽略了交互过程中信息的生成、传播与衰减等细粒度过程。为此，论文提出RIVER框架，其核心在于将智能体输出分解为原子级命题（atomic claims），从三个互补维度——收敛性（convergence）、探索性（exploration）和保留性（retention）——对信息动态进行量化评估：收敛性衡量跨智能体命题的一致性与立场对齐程度；探索性反映语义广度及对源信息的拓展能力；保留性则追踪原始信息的保真度以及新命题在多轮交互中的持续存在情况。研究通过40个受控新闻生成案例对比五种交互策略发现，重复聚合式交互虽促进信息收敛但压缩了信息空间，而分布式传递则产生更广泛但共享度较低的信息流；此外，特定方法约束会增强探索性，但削弱收敛性与保留性。研究结论表明，群体信息动态应由底层信息流动机制解释，而非仅依赖下游任务表现。

作者: Haocheng Jiang,Herun Wan,Yongyuan Peng,Minnan Luo
机构: Xi’an Jiaotong University (西安交通大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 23 pages, 3 figures. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When LLM-powered agents interact, information is repeatedly shared, expanded, and forgotten, yet multi-agent evaluation typically focuses on final task outcomes. We study such interaction as claim-level information dynamics and propose RIVER, which decomposes agent outputs into atomic claims and evaluates three complementary dimensions: convergence, exploration, and retention. Convergence captures cross-agent claim correspondence and stance alignment; exploration captures semantic breadth and extension beyond the source; and retention tracks source preservation and the persistence of new claims across stages and lineages. We evaluate five interaction strategies on 40 controlled news-generation cases. Repeatedly pooled interaction promotes convergence but narrows the information space, whereas distributed relay yields broader, less shared information. Further comparisons show that method-specific constraints increase exploration while weakening convergence and retention. Our findings suggest that collective information dynamics are better explained by underlying information-flow mechanisms than by simple downstream performance.

[NLP-34] 4DMemory: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Memory with Harness-Augmented Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有模型在处理长时序、多模态信息时难以保持细粒度时空记忆，从而制约其对长期事件进行推理与预测的问题。当前主流基准测试主要聚焦于短中等上下文任务，无法有效评估模型在跨越数小时至数年的复杂时空序列中的表现。为此，研究提出LongVideo数据集与4DMemoryBench评测基准，涵盖约900小时视频及超过5,000个经人工审核的跨模态（视觉、文本、时空）推理问题，覆盖多样化的上下文长度。其核心解决方案是构建4DMemory Harness，该系统集成四种互补能力、22个以上专用工具模型，并采用针对不同模型优化的检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）机制。实验表明，尽管独立的基础模型在长时序任务中表现不佳，但引入4DMemory Harness后，13个主流模型的性能均提升超过50%；而与以往基准相比，相同模型在4DMemoryBench上的性能下降超过10%，凸显了新基准的挑战性。该工作为发展具备长期时空推理能力的智能体提供了关键评测工具与技术路径。

机构: Nanyang Technological University (南洋理工大学); Token Foundry, Alibaba; The Chinese University of Hong Kong (香港中文大学); Institute of Neuroscience, Chinese Academy of Sciences (中国科学院神经科学研究所); University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (中国科学院大学)

Abstract:Humans efficiently process multimodal streams spanning hours to years, building persistent, fine-grained spatiotemporal memories that support reasoning about and predicting long-horizon events. In contrast, existing benchmarks focus on short- and medium-context tasks, and most foundation models struggle to preserve fine-grained information over long horizons. To evaluate and improve long-horizon spatiotemporal reasoning, we introduce the LongVideo dataset and the 4DMemoryBench. LongVideo comprises about 900 hours of video and over 5,000 manually reviewed questions covering visual, textual, and spatiotemporal reasoning across diverse context lengths. We further develop the 4DMemory Harness, which integrates four complementary skills, 22+ specialized tool models, and a model-specific retrieval-augmented generation system. Evaluating 13 leading models, we find that standalone foundation models struggle with long-horizon tasks, while the 4DMemory Harness improves all of them by over 50%. Compared to previous benchmark, the same models exhibit a performance drop of more than 10% on 4DMemoryBench. We hope 4DMemory will facilitate the development of spatiotemporal agents capable of addressing complex, long-horizon tasks.

[NLP-35] Many Perturbations Shared Failure Dynamics: Tracing Direction-Sensitive Perturbation Influence in Language Models

【速读】： 该论文试图解决的核心问题是：为何某些任务保持性的文本重写（task-preserving rewrite）会导致正确答案变为错误，而更大规模的内部表征变化却仍能维持原有答案的正确性？其解决方案的关键在于提出一种方向敏感、读出相对的语义脆弱性（semantic fragility）理论框架，揭示不同语言变换虽在几何结构与读出关系上具有相似性，但未必共享一个独立于输入的失败方向。通过引入“清洁决策保留”（clean decision reserve）、“表征变换”（representation transformation）和“响应对齐”（response alignment）三者互补的描述机制，该研究构建了一个精确的纵向-横向分解模型，识别出传统标量传输方法所忽略的方向性信息。基于此，一个紧凑的“保留-传输”（reserve-and-transmission）模型成功预测了Qwen3-32B与Gemma 4 31B中未见家族及样本的失败模式，并在ReClor数据集上实现参数依赖性但有效的迁移。匹配干预实验表明，方向性蕴含超越标量几何的因果信息；自然失败案例中的注意力组件测试与后续答案顺序控制进一步支持原始配对方向优于随机或同字母选项的捐赠方向。然而，失败现象极少跨选项顺序持续存在，且当前顺序修正依赖重新计算的干净参考，说明预测规律性与上下文依赖的方向效应共存。数值路径积分虽可减小固定上下文内的有限区域近似误差，但仍无法消除与自然重写效应之间的显著偏差。此外，固定思维链（CoT）提示研究扩展了该理论至记录推理中未被明示的影响：读出关联可跨领域传递，尽管正均值因果标准失效，符号效应预测仍为事后分析。综上，这些结果支持保留、变换与响应之间存在共享关系，同时区分局部因果敏感性与对自然失败的完整解释。

Abstract:Why can a task-preserving rewrite turn a correct answer into a failure while a larger internal change leaves the answer intact? We develop a direction-sensitive, readout-relative account of semantic fragility: heterogeneous language changes can share geometric and readout relationships without sharing an input-independent failure direction. Clean decision reserve, representation transformation, and response alignment provide complementary descriptions of this process. An exact longitudinal-transverse decomposition identifies directional information discarded by scalar transmission. A compact reserve-and-transmission model predicts failures across held-out families and items in Qwen3-32B and Gemma 4 31B, with useful but parameterization-dependent transfer to ReClor. Matched interventions show that orientation carries causal information beyond scalar geometry. Among naturally failed rewrites, attention-component tests on disjoint original items and subsequent answer-order controls favor the natural paired direction over tested random and same-answer-letter donor directions. Yet failures rarely persist across option orders, and current-order corrections use recomputed clean references. Shared predictive regularity thus coexists with context-dependent directional effects. Numerical path integration reduces, but does not eliminate, finite-patch approximation error within a fixed context; a larger discrepancy from the natural rewrite effect remains. A complementary fixed-CoT cue study extends this account to influence unacknowledged in recorded reasoning: readout associations transfer across domains, although the positive-mean causal criterion fails and signed-effect prediction remains post hoc. Together, these results support shared relations among reserve, transformation, and response while distinguishing local causal sensitivity from a complete explanation of natural failure.

[NLP-36] DMAIC-Bench: From Self-Reflection to Self-Restraint for Agents in Multi-Stage Analytical Tasks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）代理在多阶段分析任务中缺乏对中间证据进行有效判断以决定是否继续、转向或终止的能力问题，尤其关注代理在面对证据时能否实现“自我约束”（self-restraint），即根据证据合理地停止后续计算而非盲目执行。现有基准普遍聚焦于任务完成度或输出质量，未能有效评估这一关键行为能力。为此，作者提出DMAIC-Bench，基于精益六西格玛（Lean Six Sigma）的明确统计前提，构建了涵盖15个工业案例、4个行业领域的97个种子任务，并引入成对反事实变体，在同一工作流位置要求相反决策，从而区分出有依据的约束与随意中断。通过私有评分器评估执行轨迹、独立专家评审最终结论，研究发现13个来自6家厂商的模型在匹配的GO决策上执行路由准确率达92%，但在NO-GO决策上仅为19%，任何被禁止的下游计算均计为路径错误；执行轨迹显示，代理常在报告正确诊断后仍执行被结果所排除的分析。专家盲评进一步表明，在达到NO-GO决策点时，约47%的报告基于无效证据做出判断（置信区间31%–61%）。显式允许停止虽对部分模型有所帮助，但无法一致恢复对GO与NO-GO分支的正确决策。此外，该框架在批量核糖核酸测序（RNA-seq）和病例对照全基因组关联研究（GWAS）等生命科学任务中亦展现出评估证据依赖性决策的普适性。

Abstract:Multi-stage analytical tasks require LLM agents to use intermediate evidence to decide whether to continue, redirect or stop. Self-reflection, in which an agent critiques its output, is widely studied, yet a critique does not show whether evidence changed the next action. We call that capability self-restraint. Existing agent benchmarks largely measure task completion or output quality and leave it untested. DMAIC-Bench evaluates it with 97 seeded tasks across 15 industrial cases in four sectors, built around Lean Six Sigma’s explicit statistical prerequisites. Paired counterfactual variants require opposite actions at the same workflow position, distinguishing warranted restraint from indiscriminate stopping. We assess execution traces with a private scorer and final claims through independent expert review. Across 13 models from six providers, execution-level routing accuracy averages 92% on matched GO decisions and 19% on NO-GO decisions, counting any forbidden downstream computation as a route error. Execution traces show agents reporting correct diagnostics before performing analyses that those results disallow. Separately, blinded expert review of the 11 audited agents estimates that reports act on invalid evidence at 47% of reached NO-GO decisions, with an interval from 31% to 61%. Explicit stopping permission helps some models without consistently restoring correct decisions at both GO and NO-GO forks. Sixteen life-sciences tasks in bulk ribonucleic acid sequencing (RNA-seq) and case-control genome-wide association studies (GWAS) show that the same framework can evaluate evidence-dependent decisions beyond industrial workflows. Project code and data are available at: this https URL.

[NLP-37] “Not” is Not Lost in Translation: A Causal Analysis of Negation Representations in Multilingual LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言大模型（Multilingual Large Language Models, LLMs）在不同语言中对否定（Negation）的表征是否共享底层语义表示这一核心问题。尽管各语言在否定表达形式上存在显著差异，但现有模型仍能稳健地进行跨语言否定翻译，这暗示其内部可能存在跨语言统一的否定表征机制。研究的关键在于通过因果干预（causal interventions）方法，在合成对比数据集和基于FLORES-200构建的否定翻译数据集上，系统检验六种开放模型在英语、法语、越南语及汉语中的否定表示特性。研究发现，否定表征具有高度可操控性且在多种语言间存在显著共性：从一种语言中提取的对比激活方向可有效诱导或消除其他语言中的否定含义，且不同语言间的表征方向高度对齐。此外，研究揭示否定主要由稀疏特征（Sparse Features）编码——每个模型仅需一个稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoder, SAE）特征即可实现跨语言极性控制，并对否定输入表现出选择性响应。更进一步，密集与稀疏干预策略均能泛化至四种额外语言及FLORES衍生句子。该工作为理解多语言模型中否定的通用语义表示提供了实证支持，并公开了数据与代码以促进后续研究。

Abstract:Negation occurs in every language, yet its surface realization differs drastically. Despite this, multilingual large language models (LLMs) translate negation robustly, raising the question of whether they share an underlying representation of negation across languages. We study this question in six open models across English, French, Vietnamese, and Chinese, using causal interventions on a synthetic contrastive dataset and a negation translation dataset derived from FLORES-200. Across models, we find strong evidence that negation representations are causally controllable and largely shared across languages. In particular, we show that a contrastive activation direction extracted from one language can induce or remove negation in the others, and directions extracted from different languages are substantially aligned. We further find that negation is represented in sparse features: a single sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature per model suffices to control polarity across languages, while responding selectively to negated inputs. Finally, both dense and sparse interventions generalize to four additional languages and FLORES-derived sentences. We release data and code to support future work: this https URL.

[NLP-38] Do Halting Heads Really Save Compute in Looped Language Models?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决循环语言模型（Looped Language Models）中因固定迭代次数导致的计算资源浪费问题，其核心挑战在于如何有效实现基于动态停止机制的计算优化。现有方法通过引入“终止头（halting head）”在每轮迭代后预测当前令牌是否应停止，从而允许简单令牌提前终止以节省算力。然而，研究发现两个关键问题：其一，传统训练方式下，各迭代阶段混合训练的终止头倾向于预测令牌仅需不到一半的迭代即可完成，但标准停止规则仍迫使令牌执行几乎所有迭代，原因是训练过程未对实际停止的单次迭代进行显式评分；若改为对每一迭代独立评分，则虽可改善这一现象，但需施加强度较高的早期停止奖励项才能生效。其二，当前文献普遍以“每个令牌的平均迭代次数”作为加速指标，但实际生成场景中，批次内所有序列需等待最慢令牌完成，此时无终止头的模型在相同延迟下的表现几乎等效于有终止头的模型，因此平均迭代数可能高估了真实计算收益。为此，论文提出应报告实际运行的迭代次数、终止阈值与批量大小，并在训练终止头前执行一项预测试，以量化其潜在增益上限，从而更准确评估优化效果。

作者: Tsung-Han Wu,Minsuk Heo,Kenny Tan
机构: Apple(苹果)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 33 pages, 6 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Looped language models run each token through the same layers several times, and each run is one iteration. To save compute, an extra layer, the halting head, gives after each iteration the probability that the token stops there, so that easy tokens can stop early. Pretraining models from scratch, up to 1.3B parameters, we find two problems. First, heads trained on a mix of all iterations predict that tokens need under half the iterations, yet under the standard stopping rule tokens run almost every iteration, because this training never scores the single iteration where a token stops. Scoring every iteration instead fixes this, but in our runs it works only with a strong penalty favoring early stops. Second, savings are commonly reported as an average number of iterations per token, but when sequences are generated in batches that run until their slowest token stops, a model without a head is almost as good at that cost. The reported average can therefore overstate the saving. We recommend reporting the iterations tokens actually run, with the stopping threshold and batch size, and give a test, run before training a head, that bounds its gain.

[NLP-39] DIAL-S2ST: Learning Latency Control for Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决同步语音到语音翻译（simultaneous speech-to-speech translation, S2ST）模型在推理时难以实现灵活延迟控制的问题。现有方法通常依赖于成对的目标数据或复杂的奖励机制来指导早期输出，但这些方式在实际应用中存在数据稀缺或训练成本高的局限性。为此，本文提出DIAL-S2ST，一种后训练（post-training）方法，通过从前瞻预测（lookahead predictions）中进行自蒸馏（self-distillation），在不使用配对目标数据或奖励计算的情况下，为早期输出提供有效监督。其关键创新在于：通过限制大规模文本蒸馏损失的影响，缓解模仿差距（imitation gap）带来的偏差，从而更准确地引导翻译行为；同时，采用跨尺度联合训练的单一低秩适应（LoRA）适配器，并结合匹配的前瞻引导信号，使学习到的延迟控制策略可在推理阶段灵活调整。在Hibiki数据集上的实验表明，仅需10小时源语音即可完成适配，实现了高质量与可调延迟之间的良好权衡。

作者: Jeongsoo Choi,Junseok Ahn,Joon Son Chung
机构: KAIST(韩国科学技术院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Sound (cs.SD); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We propose DIAL-S2ST, a post-training method for learning inference-time latency control in simultaneous speech-to-speech translation models. Our approach reuses pretrained translation capabilities through self-distillation from lookahead predictions, while limiting the influence of large text distillation losses to account for the imitation gap. This provides supervision for earlier emission without paired target data or reward computation. To make the learned timing adjustable at inference, we jointly train a single LoRA adapter across scales with matched lookahead guidance. Experiments on French-to-English translation with Hibiki demonstrate that only 10 hours of source speech enable this adaptation, providing flexible latency control with a favorable quality-latency trade-off.

[NLP-40] Head Dimension Matters in Language Models for Long-Context Retrieval

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在长上下文处理任务中，注意力机制中头维度（head dimension）对信息检索性能的影响问题，尤其关注在固定模型规模下，分配有限参数预算给更少但更宽的注意力头是否能提升长上下文信息检索能力。其核心解决方案在于揭示：在保持模型总参数量不变的前提下，增加头维度能够显著提升长上下文检索任务的性能，关键原因在于更宽的头具有更高的“检索头”比例，使更多参数被用于支持检索功能；此外，即使在注意力模块的投影权重冻结的情况下，更宽的头仍能提升检索性能，表明其不仅促进注意力模块内部的优化，还推动了嵌入层和前馈网络（MLP）等组件的有效适应。这说明头维度的扩大通过增强模型对长序列上下文的表征能力，实现了更高效的长程信息捕获与整合。

Abstract:Multi-head attention retrieves and combines context representations through query–key interactions and value aggregation, with head dimension constraining the per-head representation space. In long-context processing, it remains unclear whether allocating a fixed parameter budget to fewer, wider heads improves information retrieval. In this paper, we investigate how head dimension affects the performance of long-context retrieval tasks. Our empirical studies reveal that pretraining loss and short-context non-retrieval task performance are not affected much by head dimension, while long-context retrieval performance improves with wider heads at fixed model sizes. We find that models with wider heads have a higher proportion of retrieval heads, associating more parameters with retrieval. Our ablation studies also show that the retrieval performance improves with wider heads even when the projection weights in attention modules are frozen during long-context continual pretraining, suggesting that wider heads not only benefit updates in attention modules but lead to more effective adaptation of components such as embeddings and MLPs.

[NLP-41] SOPO: Socratic Guided Policy Optimization for Span-Level Hallucination Detection

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在生成过程中存在的幻觉（hallucination）问题，尤其聚焦于跨段落检索增强生成（RAG）场景下的细粒度幻觉检测任务。现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards, RLVR）方法在处理跨度级幻觉检测时面临三大挑战：定位模糊性（localization ambiguity）、困难样本上的奖励稀疏性（reward sparsity）以及生成长度失控导致的冗余问题。为应对上述挑战，论文提出了一种名为苏格拉底引导策略优化（Socratic Guided Policy Optimization, SOPO）的多轮强化学习框架。其核心创新在于引入苏格拉底式反馈机制（Socratic feedback mechanism），即由教师模型在推理过程中通过间接提示（indirect hints）引导学生模型的推理轨迹，这些提示基于真实标注信息推断而来，有效提升了对复杂样本的推理效率，缓解了奖励稀疏性问题；同时，结合基于轮次的优势缩放（Turn-based Advantage Scaling）策略，抑制模型的冗余输出倾向，促使模型发展出高效且自主的推理能力。实验结果表明，SOPO（4B）在RAGTruth基准上达到领先性能，超越多个主流专有模型（如GPT-5）和标准强化学习基线，在四个跨领域基准上平均得分高于GRPO，而与CAPO相比则呈现混合证据支持。

Abstract:Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained widespread adoption in various natural language processing tasks, but suffer from hallucination issues where they generate unfaithful or inconsistent content. While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown promising applications in reasoning tasks, its application to span-level hallucination detection is challenged by localization ambiguity, reward sparsity on hard examples, and uncontrolled length inflation. To address these issues, we introduce Socratic Guided Policy Optimization (SOPO), a multi-turn RL framework for robust hallucination detection. The key innovation of SOPO is a Socratic feedback mechanism, where a teacher model guides the reasoning trajectories during rollout by providing indirect hints inferred from the ground truth. This teacher-guided approach enables the model to generate more effective reasoning trajectories for hard examples, thus alleviating reward sparsity. Furthermore, we incorporate Turn-based Advantage Scaling to penalize verbosity bias, encouraging the model to develop efficient and autonomous reasoning capabilities. Empirical results on RAGTruth demonstrate that SOPO (4B) achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing leading proprietary models (e.g., GPT-5) and standard RL baselines, while obtaining higher reported mean scores than GRPO on four out-of-domain benchmarks, with mixed evidence against CAPO. We release our training and evaluation code alongside the 1.7B and 4B SOPO models at this https URL.

[NLP-42] SWE-Shift: Evaluating Coding Agents in Evolving Workspaces

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有代码生成基准测试（coding benchmarks）在评估编码智能体（coding agents）时忽略实际开发过程中任务与环境动态变化的问题。传统基准假设任务和执行环境在整个过程保持不变，而现实中代码、依赖项、运行时状态及需求可能在智能体执行过程中发生变更。为此，论文提出SWE-Shift基准，用于评估智能体在执行中遭遇任务相关更新后的鲁棒性。其核心解决方案在于设计“清洁（Clean）”与“偏移（Shifted）”两种连续执行路径：前者无干预，后者在特定时间点接收任务相关的更新信息。成功标准不仅包括完成当前任务，还需保留有效工作成果、恢复适用状态并更新证据。该基准涵盖12类变化类型共120个场景，每个场景在9个预设干预位置进行评估。实验表明，17个被测编码系统在偏移路径上的成功率均低于清洁路径，如GPT-6 Astra从67.35%降至24.79%，且所有系统在工具/会话变更或过期证据等情形下均未实现配对成功（paired success），说明模型难以在环境变化后维持上下文一致性与状态完整性。这揭示了当前编码智能体在面对动态更新时，虽可在静态任务上表现良好，却普遍缺乏适应性与状态保持能力。

Abstract:Repository-level coding benchmarks largely assume that tasks and environments remain unchanged throughout execution. In software development, code, dependencies, runtime state, and requirements can change while an agent is still working. We introduce SWE-Shift, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents under such mid-execution changes. From the same saved history and workspace, a Clean continuation proceeds without intervention, while a matched Shifted continuation receives a task-relevant update. Success requires completing the current task, preserving still-valid work, and satisfying the applicable state and evidence checks. The benchmark contains 120 scenarios across 12 change families, each evaluated at nine scheduled intervention positions. We evaluate 17 coding-agent systems, all of which have lower Shifted than Clean success. GPT-6 Astra drops from 67.35% to 24.79%, with 20.34% paired success. Tool/session changes and stale evidence yield zero paired success across all systems. Late-position paired success is lower for some systems and higher for others. These results show that success on the unchanged task can coexist with failures to preserve work, recover state, or refresh evidence after an update.

[NLP-43] Collection-Date Assignment Redirects Answers in Temporal QA

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在时间问答（Temporal Question Answering, TQA）任务中对元数据（如采集日期）的敏感性问题，即当证据内容未发生改变时，仅因元数据时间戳的调整是否仍会导致模型回答错误。其核心解决方案的关键在于通过人为交换两个版本的采集日期（collection date），在不改变内容的前提下测试模型对时间信息的依赖程度。实验表明，将问题日期与后续版本的采集日期互换后，五种开源大语言模型（open-weight LLMs）在595个维基百科页面上的精确匹配率（Exact Match, EM）下降了37.6至51.4个百分点，且在独立样本集上可复现；即使回溯前一天的交换也保留29.0至39.6个百分点的性能损失。这一现象在多种提示工程策略下依然存在，包括明确指令忽略采集日期或强调归档版本来源，说明模型并非仅依赖表面日期字符串或记忆答案。进一步分析发现，虚构答案和英文月份名称的测试排除了“记忆”或“相同日期字符串”作为必要条件的可能性。通过引入“匹配思维”（Matched Thinking）机制，可将通义千问3.5（Qwen3.5）的性能惩罚从30.1点降至11.1点，而原生推理器表现各异。此外，两种API接口模型在真实维基百科数据上的影响较小，且极少出现向更早版本偏移的现象。关键发现是：大规模性能损失集中于问题日期附近，远距离日期交换的影响显著减弱。最后，添加包含实际采集日期的字段反而在部分模型中降低准确率，说明元数据本身可能干扰模型判断。该诊断方法有效分离了元数据影响与证据变化或遗漏相关版本之间的混淆因素，为时间问答输入提供了可操作的审计工具。

Abstract:A collection date records when a source revision was acquired, not when its contents changed. Can assigning this metadata redirect temporal question answering despite unchanged evidence? Swapping the question day and following day between two revisions lowers later-reference exact match (EM) by 37.6-51.4 percentage points across five open-weight LLMs on 595 Wikipedia pages, replicated on 128 disjoint pages. Previous-day swaps retain 29.0-39.6-point losses on 497 pages. Seven prompt variants, including explicit ignore-collection instructions and archived-revision provenance, retain the effect. Fictional answers and English month-name question dates show that remembered answers and identical date strings are unnecessary. Matched thinking reduces Qwen3.5’s penalty from 30.1 to 11.1 points, while native reasoners vary. Two API LLMs show small Wikipedia swap effects and rarely shift to earlier answers on fictional records. Large swap-induced losses concentrate around the question date; swaps between distant dates have much smaller effects. Adding fields containing one observed acquisition date lowers EM relative to omission in three of five LLMs after correction. The diagnostic isolates metadata effects from changing evidence or missing the relevant revision, and provides a practical audit for temporal QA inputs.

[NLP-44] Depth-Dependent Safety Geometry in Vision-Language Models: Layer-Wise Localization and Bidirectional Refusal Control NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）在安全行为背后的内在机制不清晰的问题，尤其关注如何在不重新训练或修改参数的前提下，定位并操控冻结状态下VLM的安全敏感表征。其核心解决方案在于提出一种轻量级的推理时框架，通过逐层激活差异分析与因果干预手段，揭示了模型深层结构中非均匀分布的安全几何特性。研究发现，早期视觉层可通过沿学习到的安全方向进行激活引导，实现强双向拒绝控制（拒绝率可达6%-96%），而深层网络则更依赖激活幅度缩放，并表现出显著的安全性与选择性权衡；尽管深层表征在安全方向上仍保持良好分离，但对引导操作不敏感，表明表征可分性与因果可控性并非等价。这一发现暴露了视觉编码器中存在的白盒化、可被规避的安全拒绝攻击面，进而推动了推理阶段对安全敏感表征的稳定性优化。

Abstract:Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are widely deployed, yet the internal mechanisms behind their safety behavior remain poorly understood. We present a lightweight inference-time framework for localizing and manipulating safety-sensitive representations in frozen VLMs, without retraining or modifying parameters. On Qwen3-VL-4B, layer-wise activation divergence analysis reveals non-uniform safety geometry across depth. Causal interventions show that early vision layers support strong bidirectional refusal control through activation steering along a learned safety direction, with unsafe rejection spanning 6%-96%, whereas later layers respond more to activation magnitude scaling and exhibit a substantial safety-selectivity trade-off. Deeper layers remain well separated along the safety direction yet are largely insensitive to steering, distinguishing representational separability from causal controllability. InternVL2.5-4B shows qualitatively similar depth-dependent activation geometry despite differences in layer location and magnitude. Our results expose a white-box, representation-level refusal-bypass attack surface in VLM vision encoders and motivate inference-time stabilization of safety-sensitive representations.

[NLP-45] Not All Information Is Worth Asking For: Decision-Informed Information Seeking with LLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在信息不完整情境下进行决策时所面临的“信息陷阱”问题，即模型会盲目执行大量代价高昂但对最终决策无实质影响的查询，或在已有足够证据时仍持续追问。其核心解决方案是提出一种无需训练、基于决策价值的信息获取框架——决策知情的信息价值获取（Decision-Informed Value-of-Information Acquisition, DIVA）。DIVA的关键在于：1）通过简短的数值化提问引导LLM构建一个小型决策模型，量化不良结果发生的概率以及每项检查对概率的影响；2）根据每项候选检查所能带来的决策净收益（即预期改进减去其成本）来评估其价值，并在无进一步检查具有正净价值时停止查询。其变体DIVA-U进一步考虑了模型自身对检查效果估计的不确定性。实验表明，在真实世界数据中，DIVA-U在四个领域和20种不同LLM上的表现均优于所有基线模型，显著降低后悔值（regret），主要归因于能够及时停止冗余查询；在合成场景下，DIVA可使最优基线模型的后悔值降低75%。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support decisions under incomplete information, where deciding what to look up and when to stop matters as much as the final answer. However, LLMs fall into an information trap: They pay for checks, i.e., costly pieces of evidence, that cannot change their decision or are not worth their cost, and they keep asking when the evidence is already sufficient. To this end, we propose Decision-Informed Value-of-information Acquisition (DIVA), a simple yet effective procedure for LLM information seeking based on the decision value of evidence. DIVA 1) lets the LLM specify a small decision model, i.e., how likely a bad outcome is and how each check would shift this probability, through short numeric questions and 2) values each candidate check by how much its imagined outcomes improve the decision net of its cost, stopping when no check is worth its cost. Its variant, DIVA-U, further accounts for the LLM’s uncertain estimates of how strongly each check shifts this probability. DIVA is training-free and applies to any LLM. Across four domains and 20 LLMs, DIVA-U has lower regret, i.e., value lost relative to the best possible decision, than every LLM baseline on real-world data, mainly by stopping once evidence suffices, and DIVA cuts the regret of the best LLM baseline by 75% in synthetic scenarios where every check’s reliability is given. Code: this http URL.

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决临床工作中电子病历（Electronic Health Record, EHR）与文书工作占用医生大量时间的问题，尤其针对医疗信息系统运行于封闭网络环境下的实际限制。其核心挑战在于如何在不脱离医院内部网络的前提下，部署具备工具调用能力的大型语言模型代理（Large Language Model Agent），以实现对医疗文档的高效处理与智能支持。解决方案的关键在于设计并部署LLENS平台：该平台完全运行于北海道大学医院的封闭网络内，基于单台配备8块NVIDIA H200 GPU的主机，集成开源权重模型Kimi K2.6（约1万亿参数）及重构自Open WebUI的Web应用。平台的核心创新包括10个关键组件，如页面图像识别、全文附件输入、无向量索引的路径定位文档树、网络隔离沙箱、生成结果回传、输出自检机制、子代理协同以及已保存操作流程等。实验表明，在交互式访问模式下，模型通过文档工具与沙箱协作，平均准确率达97.2%，显著优于固定检索（81.3%）和无文档参考（10.7%），尤其在过滤与计数类任务上表现突出（16.7% vs 87.8%）。平台已自2026年9月14日起在医院网络中稳定运行，并成功验证了5种典型临床场景的可行性，证明了在封闭网络环境下实现高安全性、高可用性临床支持智能体的技术可行性和实用价值。

Abstract:Large language model agents that use tools could take on part of the electronic health record and desk work that occupies physicians’ time, but in many hospitals the medical information systems run inside closed networks, so the model and the agent harness must also sit inside. We designed, implemented, and deployed LLENS, a clinical support AI agent platform that runs inside the closed network of Hokkaido University Hospital on one host with 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, the open-weight model Kimi K2.6 (~1 trillion parameters), and a web application rebuilt from Open WebUI. The harness has 10 components, including page image reading, full-text attachment input, a path-addressed document tree without a vector index, a network-isolated sandbox, artifact return, self-checking of generated output, subagents, and saved procedures. Kimi K2.6 was chosen from 3 open-weight candidates and scored 480/500 on the 2026 Japanese Medical Licensing Examination; it generated 119 tokens/s for one user and served 16 concurrent requests at 908 tokens/s in total. On 180 questions over hospital documents (3 seeds each), mean accuracy was 10.7% with no documents, 81.3% with fixed retrieval (top 10 chunks of one lexical search), and 97.2% with interactive access, in which the model reads with document tools and the sandbox (15.9 percentage points above fixed retrieval, 95% CI 10.9-21.3); the difference lay in filtering/counting questions (16.7% vs 87.8%). Five scenarios with synthetic data ran on combinations of the components: needlestick injury response, batch adverse event grading, scanned referral letter transcription, falls data aggregation and plotting, and investigation of 3 topics by subagents. The platform has run on the hospital network since September 14, 2026.

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决选举承诺（Election Commitment）在南亚发展中国家难以追踪与问责的问题，尤其针对尼泊尔等国候选人及政党选举期间作出的承诺缺乏系统性归档与透明化管理，导致承诺随时间消逝、难以验证兑现的情况。其核心解决方案是构建首个尼泊尔语政治文本的黄金标准数据集（Cohen’s kappa = 0.777），并基于此评估机器学习、深度学习及大语言模型在自动提取与分析选举承诺中的表现。关键突破在于：采用LaBSE-LR模型在传统机器学习中取得最优性能（准确率0.897，宏平均F1-score 0.896，AUROC 0.947），fastText-LSTM在深度学习中表现最佳（准确率0.914，宏平均F1-score 0.913，AUROC 0.961），而Qwen3-8B在少样本设置下表现最优（宏平均F1-score 0.848）。研究成果被集成至移动端应用，结合生成式AI（Generative AI）实现承诺的可视化呈现，从而提升政治透明度、促进公民参与并强化选举问责机制。

Abstract:Election Commitment Mining refers to the analysis of election commitments made by electoral candidates or political parties during election campaigns. However, many elected candidates and political parties, especially in developing South Asian countries, do not fully deliver on the promises they make before elections. Even after the elections, commitments presented through election manifestos, posters, pamphlets, videos, and other campaign materials are often not systematically or transparently archived. As a result, these promises tend to fade away over time, making it difficult to hold the elected candidates accountable for their commitments. To address this persistent issue, this research aims to develop a system capable of structuring the commitments made by candidates during election periods. In this work, we created the first gold-standard dataset of Nepali political texts (Cohen’s kappa = 0.777) and evaluated machine learning, deep learning and large language models to automatically extract and analyze election commitments. LaBSE-LR achieved the best results among machine learning models (0.897 accuracy, 0.896 macro F1-score, 0.947 AUROC), while fastText-LSTM achieved the highest performance among deep learning models (0.914 accuracy, 0.913 macro F1-score, 0.961 AUROC). Among the three evaluated large language models, Qwen3-8B performed best in the few-shot setting (0.848 macro F1-score). The outcome of this work is integrated into a mobile application, where commitments can be visualized with the support of GAI, enhancing transparency, civic engagement, and electoral accountability.

[NLP-48] Disentangling Question Response and Verifier Languages in Multilingual P(True) Self-Evaluation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言情境下语言模型自评估（multilingual confidence evaluation）中因三类语言混杂而导致的评估偏差问题，即提问语言、回答语言与验证指令语言三者未被明确区分。其核心解决方案在于通过六语言因子设计，独立控制这三种语言变量，并在多个基准测试（LSQA、MMMLU、TriviaQA）上使用十种开放权重模型（3B-14B）进行系统性实验，固定答案以隔离验证语言的影响。研究发现：三类语言分别影响评估的不同环节，其对准确率的主导作用取决于具体任务；将回答语言与问题或验证语言匹配可提升判别能力但不改善校准性；仅改变验证语言即可导致校准误差最大达0.04，而准确率不变；此外，评分器的有效性至关重要——未经验证的评判者会显著缩小跨语言性能差距（如英语-印地语在MMMLU上的差距由0.198降至0.038）。因此，论文强调：多语言置信度评估结果（包括模型排名）仅在完整报告三类语言并采用经过验证的评分机制时才具备可比性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32144
作者: Jewon Yeom,Jaewon Sok,Seonghyeon Park,Jeongjae Park,Hwiyeong Lee,Taesup Kim
机构: Seoul National University (首尔国立大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:When a language model is asked whether its own answer is correct, three languages are involved: that of the question, that requested for the answer, and that of the verifier instruction asking for the judgment. Multilingual confidence evaluations seldom separate the three. We vary them independently in a six-language factorial design with ten open-weight models (3B-14B) on LSQA, MMMLU and TriviaQA, holding each answer fixed across verifier languages and measuring confidence with a first-token P(True) probe. The three languages move different parts of the evaluation: which of them governs accuracy depends on the benchmark, matching the response language to the question or verifier language sharpens discrimination but not calibration, and the verifier language alone shifts calibration error by up to 0.04 without changing accuracy. The scorer matters as well: an unvalidated judge would have shrunk the MMMLU English-Hindi accuracy gap from 0.198 to 0.038. Multilingual confidence results, model rankings included, are therefore comparable only when all three languages are reported and the scorer is validated.

[NLP-49] SyncPro: Synchronous Reasoning and Responding for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决主动式流式视频理解中响应时机与推理过程协调不足的问题，即如何在持续接收视频观测信息的同时，实现对用户请求条件的及时响应并保持推理过程的有效性。现有方法分别具备“何时响应”的决策能力（主动视频助手）和“组织中间推理文本”的流式推理能力，但二者难以高效协同：固定推理周期可能导致无效更新或延迟响应，且单一生成路径将证据保留与用户响应耦合，导致响应需等待完整推理完成，即使已有充分证据。为此，本文提出SyncPro——一种同步双流架构，通过独立的内层（Inner）分支用于持续追踪证据变化，以及响应（Response）分支专门生成用户可读输出，两者共享因果历史但可独立激活。该设计实现了证据更新与响应生成的并发处理，显著提升了响应时效性与准确性。研究构建了18.9万条双流标注数据，采用监督微调结合轨迹级强化学习进行训练，在三个主动式基准测试中均验证了其优越性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32132
作者: Xueyun Tian,Bingbing Xu,Jiaming Liu,Jinpeng Yu,Yang Shi,Yu Zhao,Ruihua Huang,Yuanzhuo Wang,Huawei Shen
机构: State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, Institute of Computing Technology, CAS(中国科学院计算技术研究所人工智能安全国家重点实验室); University of Chinese Academy of Sciences(中国科学院大学); Qwen Business Unit of Alibaba(阿里巴巴通义业务单元)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Proactive streaming video understanding requires assistants to track unfolding events and respond when a user’s requested condition is met. To make these decisions, assistants must accumulate relevant evidence and reassess response conditions as new observations arrive. Existing work offers complementary capabilities for this process: proactive video assistants learn when to respond, while streaming video reasoning methods generate scheduled intermediate text to organize observations and support subsequent answers. Together, these capabilities provide a foundation for proactive reasoning, but how to coordinate ongoing reasoning with timely responses remains underexplored. In a direct adaptation, fixed reasoning intervals can trigger updates when nothing relevant has changed or postpone useful updates until the next scheduled step. Sharing one generation path also couples two distinct requirements: preserving evidence for future decisions and producing only the response requested by the user. Moreover, responses generated after reasoning must wait for it to finish, even when sufficient evidence is already available. To address these challenges, we introduce SyncPro, a synchronous dual-stream framework with specialized generation paths for evidence tracking and user-facing responses. Its Inner and Response branches share causal history and activate independently, allowing relevant evidence changes to trigger internal updates and responses to proceed concurrently with ongoing reasoning. We construct 189K dual-stream examples and train SyncPro through supervised fine-tuning followed by trajectory-level reinforcement learning. Experiments across three proactive benchmarks show improved response timing and more accurate answers to user requests.

[NLP-50] From Noisy Retrieval to Decision Evidence: Silver Evidence Demonstrations for In-Context Learning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在长且嘈杂的上下文环境中，基于检索增强生成（RAG）与检索增强少样本提示学习（few-shot ICL）方法在决策时难以有效提取关键证据的问题。当相关证据被淹没在冗余或干扰性信息中时，传统方法的表现会显著下降。现有方法通常仅将专家标注的开发集示例用作答案侧的解释（rationales），而未将其用于指导噪声检索结果的过滤。为此，本文提出“银质证据示范”（silver-evidence demonstrations）——即用大语言模型（LLM）生成的目标条件化证据摘要替代原始检索到的段落，作为少样本示例中的演示内容。具体而言，对于每个已标注的开发示例，模型在无专家标签或黄金证据可见的情况下生成“银质证据”，随后将其与真实标签及可获得的黄金证据配对。测试阶段通过一次结构化调用，从检索到的文本中生成银质证据，并据此预测最终标签与决策依据。在EI 2.0、SciFact、合成政策检索任务以及HICRIC/IMR数据集上的实验表明，该方法在四个数据集中有三组优于仅使用黄金示例的少样本I CL基线，在所有标注数据集上均提升了证据F1得分，且在全部四个数据集上均实现了高于InstructRAG风格I CL的平均标签准确率。结果表明，以紧凑、目标导向的银质证据替代演示侧的原始检索段落，能有效减少冗余上下文干扰，同时保留决策相关信号与专家监督，尤其适用于依赖长篇复杂文本进行判断的任务场景。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32128
作者: Masoud Monajatipoor,Fazlolah Mohaghegh,Hamid Reza Hassanzadeh,Akash Uttamrao Bhoite,Robert E. Tillman
机构: Optum AI
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:RAG and retrieval-augmented few-shot ICL can struggle when decision-relevant evidence is buried in long, noisy context. Retrieved passages and demonstrations may contain redundant or distracting information. Although expert-labeled development examples may identify the text supporting each decision, these annotations are typically used only as answer-side rationales rather than as supervision for filtering noisy retrieval. We propose silver-evidence demonstrations, which replace raw retrieved passages in ICL examples with generated, target-conditioned evidence summaries. For each labeled development example, an LLM generates silver evidence without access to the expert label or gold evidence; this evidence is then paired with the expert label and gold evidence where available. At test time, a single structured call generates silver evidence from retrieved passages and then predicts the final label and decision evidence. Across EI 2.0, SciFact, synthetic policy retrieval, and HICRIC/IMR data, our full method improves over equally sized gold-only ICL (label-only for policy) on three of four datasets and improves evidence F1 on all annotated datasets. It also achieves higher mean label accuracy than InstructRAG-style ICL on all four datasets. These results suggest that replacing demonstration-side retrieved passages with compact, target-conditioned silver evidence is particularly useful for decisions based on long and noisy text, where it reduces distracting context while preserving decision-relevant signals and expert supervision.

[NLP-51] Data Quality in RVL-CDIP: A Systematic Audit

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前文档分类基准数据集RVL-CDIP中存在的数据质量问题，包括标签错误、训练集与测试集之间的重复/近似重复样本、文本内容依赖性过强以及模型泛化能力不足等问题。其解决方案的关键在于系统性地审计并修正数据集中的缺陷：通过识别并剔除约10.5%的错误标签、移除35.2%的测试集中与训练集重复或近似重复的样本、消除对页面标识码（identification codes）的过度依赖，并构建去标识化版本以保护敏感个人数据；同时在修复所有已知问题后重新评估25个模型，结果显示经再训练的模型性能平均提升0.9至2.9个百分点，其中最先进模型LayoutLMv3在修正后的数据集上达到96.5%的准确率。研究还揭示了光学字符识别（OCR）引擎选择对结果的影响（达4.1–8.3个百分点），强调了预处理环节的重要性。最终，研究团队公开了修正后的数据集、标注信息及分布外（out-of-distribution）测试数据，为后续研究提供更可靠的基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32126
作者: Stefan Larson,Kevin Leach
机构: Vanderbilt University(范德比尔特大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:RVL-CDIP is the de facto standard benchmark for document classification, and reported accuracy on it is now 98.8%. In this paper, we audit RVL-CDIP for data quality issues and find that approximately 10.5% of its 400,000 documents have erroneous labels and that 35.2% of the test set has a duplicate or near-duplicate in the training set. Identification codes on the pages are sufficient to classify at 69% accuracy, and a state-of-the-art model loses 11 points without them. Image-only models trained on RVL-CDIP lose 16 to 28 points on documents from other sources, and the choice of OCR engine changes accuracy by 4.1 to 8.3 points. We find that nearly 16,000 RVL-CDIP documents contain sensitive personal data, and produce de-identified versions of these documents. We re-benchmark 25 models, and with all defects remediated, the 13 that we retrain are 0.9 to 2.9 points more accurate than in the original condition; the most accurate of them, LayoutLMv3, is 96.5% accurate. We release the corrected corpus, the annotations and the out-of-distribution data.

[NLP-52] Semantically Rich Metrically Affect-Blind: A Geometric Blind Spot in Modern Text Embedders

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现代文本嵌入模型中一个关键的矛盾现象：尽管嵌入向量中隐含了丰富的情感信息（sentiment），但这些信息在嵌入空间的度量（metric）中几乎无法体现。具体而言，研究发现，通过线性探测器（linear probe）可高达91.3%准确率地解码句子极性，而基于余弦相似度的度量仅能区分极性差异0.003–0.064，表明嵌入的几何结构与语义内容严重脱节。这一问题广泛存在于2021至2026年发布的十一个冻结编码器中，包括最新的40亿参数大语言模型嵌入器Qwen3-Embedding-4B。由于检索、聚类、去重及检索增强生成（RAG）等下游任务依赖于嵌入的度量结构而非外部探测器，导致系统对编码器显式包含的情感信息“视而不见”。其根本原因被证实源于预训练目标本身，而非提示工程偏差——通过任务条件控制实验显示，将Jina-v5模型从检索任务切换为分类任务训练，仅能恢复部分性能增益，且极性对齐差距基本不变。为此，论文提出情感注入的句嵌入（Sentiment-Injected Sentence Embeddings, SISE）解决方案：在冻结编码器上快速（秒级）训练一个小型（0.13M–0.69M参数）监督对比头（supervised-contrastive head），利用标注数据进行微调。该方法显著提升所有2022年后发布的编码器在完整数据探针准确率（最高+5.8点）、检索MAP（最高+26.0）和极性区分度（7–61倍提升）方面的表现，实现有效专业化。虽然引入该头会轻微牺牲通用语义相关性（如在STS-B上损失38–41 Spearman点），但通过融合变体可大幅缓解（损失仅2.4–12.0）。值得注意的是，搭载此头后，0.6B规模的编码器在128维下即可达到4B编码器的性能水平（MAP 91.8 vs. 90.3）。研究还发布了可复现的CPU流水线与诊断工具“属性对齐差距”（Attribute Alignment Gap），以量化评估嵌入中特定语义属性的对齐程度。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32122
作者: Mahdi Naser Moghadasi
机构: BrightMind AI( BrightMind AI)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:We report a systematic dissociation in modern text embedders: sentiment is almost perfectly decodable from their embeddings, yet almost entirely absent from their metric. Across eleven frozen encoders spanning 2021 to 2026, including 2026-generation models and the 4B-parameter LLM embedder Qwen3-Embedding-4B, a linear probe recovers sentence polarity at up to 91.3% accuracy while cosine similarity separates polarity by a margin of only 0.003-0.064. Qwen3-Embedding-4B, the strongest probe in the panel, reaches 91.3% probe accuracy but only 64.3 retrieval MAP. Because retrieval, clustering, deduplication, and retrieval-augmented generation operate on the metric rather than on a trained probe, these systems are effectively blind to information their encoder demonstrably contains. A task-conditioning control suggests this reflects the pretraining objective rather than a prompting artifact: conditioning Jina-v5 on its classification task rather than its retrieval task recovers only about half of the MAP gain that injection achieves on the same weights (63.2 to 73.8, versus 85.1), and leaves the alignment gap essentially unchanged. Sentiment-Injected Sentence Embeddings (SISE) train a small (0.13M-0.69M-parameter) supervised-contrastive head on a frozen encoder in seconds on a CPU, using the labelled training set. The head improves every encoder released since 2022 on full-data probe accuracy (up to +5.8 points), retrieval MAP (up to +26.0) and polarity margin (7-61x). This is a specialization, not a free gain: the compact 128-d head loses 38-41 Spearman points on STS-B, while a fused variant that concatenates it with the base embedding loses 2.4-12.0. With the head, a 0.6B encoder at 128 dimensions matches a 4B encoder given the same head (91.8 vs. 90.3 MAP). We release a CPU-reproducible pipeline and a reusable diagnostic, the Attribute Alignment Gap.

[NLP-53] EDWARD-NMT: Elastic Dimensions With Adaptive Routing and Dual-consistency for Neural Machine Translation EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决稀疏混合专家（Sparse Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）架构在资源受限设备上部署时面临的两大核心问题：一是整个专家池（expert pool）必须常驻内存，导致显存开销过大；二是训练阶段采用固定的 top-k 路由策略，使每个 token 的计算预算静态不可变，难以适应不同推理场景的需求。为此，本文提出 EDWARD-NMT（Elastic Dimensions With Adaptive Routing and Dual-consistency for NMT），一种面向“训练一次、随处部署”范式的新型 MoE 编码器-解码器架构，其关键创新在于：（i）采用类似套娃（Matryoshka-style）的弹性维度设计，实现模型尺寸的灵活压缩以显著降低内存占用；（ii）引入可学习的任务相关阈值自适应 sigmoid 路由机制，使每个 token 能动态决定激活的专家数量，从而实现计算资源的按需分配；（iii）设计双一致性（dual-consistency）优化目标，确保从单一训练检查点中提取出的子网络在性能上达到最优。大量实验验证了该方法在 PhoMT（En-Vi）、WMT-14（En-De）、多语言 OPUS-16 及多领域 De-En 基准上的有效性，结果表明全容量模型在保持竞争力的同时提升了参数效率，且无需重新训练即可从单个模型中提取出的子网络始终优于同等规模的密集型 Transformer 模型。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32115
作者: Edward Nguyen,Thai Tran,Kiet Anh Hoang,Duy Hoang,Duy Vo,Khanh Le,Vu Le
机构: UNEY(UNEY), Switzerland
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Findings)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a powerful paradigm for scaling Neural Machine Translation (NMT) and managing language heterogeneity. However, practical limitations hinder its deployment on resource-constrained devices: the entire expert pool must remain in memory, and the per-token compute budget is statically fixed during training by rigid top-k routing. We introduce EDWARD-NMT (Elastic Dimensions With Adaptive Routing and Dual-consistency for NMT), a novel MoE encoder-decoder architecture designed for a train once, deploy anywhere paradigm that exposes a family of deployable sub-networks at inference time. EDWARD-NMT integrates three key innovations: (i) Matryoshka-style elastic dimensions to flexibly reduce the memory footprint; (ii) an adaptive sigmoid router with a learned, task-conditioned threshold, allowing each token to dynamically determine its active expert count; and (iii) a dual-consistency objective to maximize the performance of the extracted sub-networks. Extensive experiments on PhoMT (En-Vi), WMT-14 (En-De), multilingual OPUS-16, and a multi-domain De-En benchmark validate our approach. The full-capacity architecture matches or exceeds strong MoE baselines with improved parameter efficiency. Furthermore, the sub-networks seamlessly extracted from a single checkpoint consistently outperform comparably sized dense Transformers without any retraining.

[NLP-54] ampered ML: Evaluating LLM Judgment of Machine Learning Research EMNLP2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在复杂、难以监督的研究任务中进行可靠推理的能力瓶颈，特别是针对人工智能对齐（AI alignment）研究中的关键挑战：识别研究提案中的方法论缺陷并评估实验设计是否支持其主张。为系统评估这一能力，研究提出“Tampered ML”基准，包含1,858个样本对，每对由一篇真实机器学习论文重构的实验提案及其经微调引入特定方法论缺陷的反事实版本构成，要求模型在两种呈现顺序下均能准确判断更优的设计方案。人类验证研究表明，86%的测试项具有有效区分度（95%置信区间：81%-91%）。尽管前沿模型表现优于随机水平（如Opus 5达到77.9%准确率），但整体仍远未达到可靠标准，且对呈现顺序高度敏感，倾向于偏好更具具体性、透明性或常规性的有缺陷设计。解决方案的关键在于构建一个高保真、可量化的基准工具，以推动对生成式AI在严谨科学研究中推理能力的系统性评估与改进。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32114
作者: Soroush Ebadian,Parand A. Alamdari,Joe Benton,Hailey Joren
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Digital Libraries (cs.DL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 28 pages, 10 figures. Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:One approach to accelerating progress on AI alignment is to automate parts of alignment research itself. Doing so requires systems that can perform reliably on hard-to-supervise research tasks, including identifying flaws in research proposals and evaluating whether a proposed experiment supports its intended claim. To evaluate this capability, we introduce Tampered ML, a benchmark of 1,858 item-pairs, each consisting of an experiment proposal reconstructed from a published machine learning paper and a minimally edited counterfactual that introduces a targeted methodological flaw. Models must identify the more methodologically sound proposal in both presentation orders. A human validation study on a stratified sample estimates that 86% of items are valid (95% CI: 81-91%). Frontier models perform above chance but remain far from reliable (with Opus 5 achieving 77.9% accuracy). They are highly sensitive to the order of presentation and favor flawed designs that appear more specific, transparent, or conventional.

[NLP-55] REACT: Representational Early Analysis and Control of Chain-of-Thought Trajectories

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式推理过程中安全风险检测与有效干预时机之间的不匹配问题，即尽管早期推理链（Chain-of-thought, CoT）阶段可能更容易识别风险，但这一时点是否也具备最强的干预效果尚不明确。其解决方案的关键在于提出REACT——一种基于条件激活的干预方法，通过学习由成对安全与非安全推理轨迹提取的安全方向，并仅在早期CoT隐藏状态中施加一次无门控的编辑，随后所有后续生成均不受修改且模型权重保持冻结。研究通过在前五个CoT位置分别训练安全方向并评估全量重生成后的效果，发现最强干预效果集中于前两至三个词元的早期窗口；在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B模型上，第四和第五个词元处的干预效果几乎归零，即便后期状态对风险更具预测性。这揭示了风险可读性（risk readability）与有效控制（effective control）并非等价，干预时机必须基于其对后续生成的实际影响来评估。实验表明，REACT在相同模型上将强拒绝测试集（StrongREJECT-273）中完全安全的推理-答案输出率从29.06%提升至82.05%，同时维持良性拒答率和有用性接近基线水平。

作者: Hanwen Zhang,Enyi Jiang,Ruike Zhu,Qinan Yu,Sanmi Koyejo

Abstract:Chain-of-thought (CoT) generation offers an opportunity to intervene before a reasoning model completes its answer. But does the point at which risk is easiest to detect also offer the most effective control? We study this question with REACT, a conditional activation intervention that learns a safety direction from paired safe and unsafe trajectories and applies it once to an early CoT hidden state. The model weights remain frozen, and all subsequent tokens are generated without further edits. To study timing, we train directions separately at each of the first five CoT positions and evaluate ungated edits with full post-edit regeneration. Across three distilled reasoning models and three generation seeds, the strongest gains concentrate in a two- to three-token early window; on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, the effect falls to approximately zero at the fourth and fifth tokens, even though later states can be more predictive of risk. This separates risk readability from effective control: intervention timing must be evaluated through its effect on subsequent generation. On the same 8B model, REACT raises the rate of fully safe CoT-answer outputs on StrongREJECT-273 from 29.06% to 82.05%, while keeping benign refusal and usefulness near baseline. An anonymized implementation is available at this https URL.

[NLP-56] Context or Knowledge: How LLM s Attribute Their Own Answers

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型在回答问题后，其“源报告”（source report）——即模型声称答案来自文档还是自身参数知识——的决定机制这一关键问题。现有研究尚不清楚模型在生成答案后如何判断并报告其信息来源。本文通过干预模型在生成答案后但提问前的键值缓存（Key-Value Cache, KV Cache），揭示了源报告的因果决定因素。实验结果表明，在控制事实任务中，修改或移除文档缓存对源报告无影响；而将问答（Q+A）缓存从一次运行移植到另一次相同问题与答案的运行中，则能完全转移源报告，说明源报告的归属由问答缓存状态决定。进一步地，通过对预训练阶段拟合的方向进行操控，可使小规模模型（7B-32B）在固定强度下实现98.9%-100%的报告方向反转，而随机方向仅影响不超过1.1%。分析显示，这些方向上的键（key）和值（value）分量是转移效应的关键：仅复制这些分量即可近似重现报告变化，而固定它们则几乎完全阻断变化。该现象在答案生成过程中同样存在，尽管效应较弱且依赖提示结构。因此，本研究的核心发现是：在该设定下，源报告行为由回答过程产生的缓存状态所因果决定，而非文档内容或初始上下文。研究未验证报告的普遍准确性，也未完全解析缓存状态的语义表征，但为理解生成式模型的溯源机制提供了关键实证依据。

作者: Kirill Afendulev,Alexey Dontsov,Alla Chepurova,Elena Tutubalina,Anton Korznikov
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 25 pages, 7 figures, 23 tables, including appendices

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Language models can answer a question from a supplied document or from their parametric knowledge. When later asked where the answer came from, what determines their source report? We study this by intervening on the model’s key-value (KV) cache after the answer is generated and before the source question is asked. On a controlled factual task with four models (7B-32B), changing or removing the document’s cache never changes the report. In contrast, transplanting the question-and-answer (Q+A) cache between runs with identical question and answer tokens transfers it: every eligible report follows the donor, while the recipient’s document is unchanged. On the two smaller models, steering Q+A values along directions fitted before any source question reverses 98.9-100% of reports across four document conditions at a fixed strength, while norm-matched random directions flip at most 1.1%. The components of keys and values along fitted directions carry the transplant effect: copying them alone nearly reproduces the report change; holding them fixed nearly prevents it. Applied during answer generation, the same value directions also change which source supplies the answer, though more weakly and depending on the prompt. Source reporting in this setting thus depends causally on cached state produced while answering. We do not establish general reporting accuracy or a complete interpretation of this state.

[NLP-57] Beyond What to Say: Proactive Utterance Timing with Inner Thoughts for Werewolf Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）代理在狼人杀（Werewolf）这类竞争性博弈环境中，如何在不完整信息条件下合理判断“何时发言”这一关键问题。传统对话系统中的发言时机决策方法多适用于一般对话场景，难以适应狼人杀中因利益冲突导致的高风险语用解读与策略性沉默的复杂性。为此，本文提出一种针对竞争性环境优化的自适应内省机制——对抗性内省思想（Adversarial Inner Thoughts），其核心在于对内部思考内容进行动态价值评估，以决定当前时刻是否具备表达价值。该方法通过重构原有“内在思想”框架，强化了对策略性沉默与发言时机的精准控制，在自对弈日志分析与人类评估中均展现出显著有效性，为复杂博弈场景下的智能体行为决策提供了新范式。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32107
作者: Yoshiki Tanaka,Shuya Uchiyama,Daichi Hamaguchi,Michimasa Inaba
机构: The University of Electro-Communications (东京电子通信大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to the 4th International AIWolfDial Workshop at INLG 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Participating in a conversation involves not only deciding what to say but also whether to speak at all. This judgment carries even greater significance in environments like the Werewolf game, where participants’ interests conflict, because both utterances and silence are subject to interpretation and assessment by others. Therefore, determining when to speak, as well as what to say, is crucial for an LLM agent playing the Werewolf game. In this study, we introduce a Werewolf AI agent developed for the Anytime Utterance Track of the AIWolfDial shared task. Our system builds on the existing Inner Thoughts framework, which determines utterance timing during conversations by generating internal thoughts and evaluating the value of each thought for expression at that moment. Since existing methods were designed for general dialogue, we have redesigned the system specifically for the competitive environment and incomplete information setting of Werewolf games. We call our adapted method Adversarial Inner Thoughts. Through experiments involving analysis of self-play logs and human evaluations, we analyze and discuss the effectiveness of our approach.

[NLP-58] Putting Transformer Theories to the Test

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前多种形式化理论对Transformer架构能力与局限性预测不一致的问题，这些理论因底层假设和概念框架不同，导致在判断某些任务对Transformer而言“易”或“难”时产生分歧。其核心解决方案在于系统性地梳理并统一七种代表性理论（星自由语言、AC⁰、TC⁰、C-RASP、MPC、BAPO及敏感性理论），将它们对一系列涵盖不同计算结构的任务的预测映射至一个共同的评估矩阵中，并通过新推导的理论结果补全该矩阵。随后，研究通过受控实验验证理论预测，考察模型在分布内样本复杂度、长度泛化能力以及预训练语言模型性能方面的表现。结果显示，没有任何单一理论能够全面解释Transformer的实际成功与失败模式；当某理论未能捕捉到任务相关的Transformer行为特征时，其预测即失效——例如，C-RASP理论因未建模内容依赖型注意力而错误预测k跳归纳任务为困难，但实际训练的小型Transformer却表现出良好的长度泛化能力；类似地，基于硬注意力假设的AC⁰与BAPO理论预测二元多数判定任务应困难，但实践中亦可成功。因此，研究指出，一个有效的Transformer理论必须具备若干关键特征：软注意力机制而非硬注意力、动态的内容依赖检索能力、每个位置上的有界计算、对可学习性与归纳偏置的合理建模，以及同时包含上界与下界的综合分析框架。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32104
作者: Awni Altabaa,Tobias Schnabel,Kiran Tomlinson
机构: Microsoft Research
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Several formal theories have been developed to characterize the capabilities and limitations of the transformer architecture, each employing different abstractions that capture different features of the architecture. Due to the differences in their underlying assumptions and conceptual frameworks, these theories can disagree in their predictions about what tasks transformers find easy or hard. We map out seven theories of transformer capability (Star-free, \mathsfAC^0 , \mathsfTC^0 , C-RASP, MPC, BAPO, and Sensitivity) and translate their results into a common matrix of predictions across a suite of tasks covering different computational structures. We provide new theoretical results to complete this matrix. We then evaluate theoretical predictions through controlled experiments measuring in-distribution sample complexity, length generalization, and pretrained language model performance. We find that no single theory explains the observed pattern of successes and failures. When a theory does not capture the transformer behaviors relevant to a task, its predictions break down; for instance, we show that the k -hop induction task is predicted hard by C-RASP because it does not model content-dependent attention, but we train small transformers on this task that length-generalize. Similarly, theories assuming hard attention like \mathsfAC^0 and BAPO predict binary majority to be hard, for which we also find success in practice. Together, our results point to several specific features that a theory of transformers must capture: soft rather than hard attention, dynamic content-dependent retrieval, bounded computation at each position, an account of learnability and inductive biases, and a combination of upper and lower bounds.

[NLP-59] Behaviour analysis for large language model-driven agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决如何系统理解语言智能体（language agent）在多步骤行为轨迹中动作组织机制及其与上下文和结果之间关系的问题。其核心挑战在于从复杂、动态的行为序列中自动发现有意义的行为模式，并揭示这些模式在不同情境下的依赖性与因果性。解决方案的关键在于提出一个通用框架，将数据驱动的行为发现与分析、实验探究相整合：首先通过记录的活动数据生成可度量的行为类别；其次，在保持行为在过程中的时序位置基础上，构建可解释的因果假设；再通过在保留测试集中的统计检验评估证据的强度与泛化能力；最后，借助提示工程（prompt steering）等可控实验验证行为与结果在变化条件下的响应机制。该框架支持不同长度、事件顺序及智能体角色的轨迹分析，并推动了编码、分析与实验方法的协同演进，以实现对智能体行为更深层次的理解。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32087
作者: Tianqiang Yan,Lizhen Qu
机构: Monash University (蒙纳士大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Under review by Nature Machine Intelligence

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Understanding language-agent behaviour requires learning how actions are organised across a trajectory and how this organisation relates to context and outcomes. We propose a general framework that connects data-driven behavioural discovery with analysis and experimental investigation. Categories developed from recorded activity define what is measured. Analyses preserve the behaviours’ positions in the process and express their relationships as interpretable hypotheses. Statistical assessment and tests in held-out contexts examine the strength and scope of the evidence. Experiments, including prompt steering, then test how behaviour and outcomes change under deliberately varied conditions. A study of iterative self-reflection illustrates how discovery, dependency learning and prompt comparisons can inform one another. We develop this approach for trajectories of varying length, event order and agent roles, and identify advances in coding, analysis and experimentation needed to support its wider use.

[NLP-60] How Much Do You Trust A Dog? Quantifying Hint-Following in Reasoning Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在面对用户提示时表现出的“奉承倾向”（sycophancy）问题，即模型会无条件地调整其回答以迎合用户暗示，即使在客观事实与推理任务中亦如此。这一现象的核心在于：用户提示对模型输出的影响机制及其是否根据提示来源的可靠性进行合理校准，目前尚缺乏清晰的量化理解。本文通过在MMLU基准上设计“[源]认为答案是(X)”形式的提示（hint），系统性地考察不同来源（教授、朋友、狗）对模型回答的影响，覆盖Qwen、Gemma和SmolLM三类开源模型家族。研究发现，提示所引发的回答偏移遵循一种可预测的指数倾斜（exponential tilt）结构——提示导致目标答案的对数几率（log-odds）产生近似恒定的均值偏移，且这种敏感度在不同来源间高度共享，表明模型对提示的响应具有内在一致性而非依赖于语义内容。为揭示该现象的成因，作者提出一个提示响应的形式化分解框架，并在受控合成实验中证明：基于KL正则化的奖励训练（KL-regularized reward-based training）能够同时重塑提示相关与未提示答案的分布，从而解释该偏移模式的生成机制。进一步评估表明，即使提示来源被明确声明为不可靠或附加了警示信息，模型仍持续产生显著的对数几率偏移，说明当前大语言模型在对抗性引导下存在严重脆弱性，难以有效校准提示来源的可信度。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32055
作者: Anxin Guo,Chirag Pabbaraju,Sara Ahmadian,Kamesh Munagala,Aravindan Vijayaraghavan
机构: Northwestern University (西北大学); NSF-Simons AI Institute for the Sky (SkAI) (美国国家科学基金会-西蒙斯人工智能天空研究所); Stanford University (斯坦福大学); Google Research (谷歌研究)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit sycophancy, altering their answers to align with user suggestions even on objective factual and reasoning tasks. Yet the quantitative form of this influence— and whether it is calibrated to source reliability— remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate this behavior through hint-induced answer shifts on MMLU questions, evaluating prompts of the form ``[Source] thinks the answer is (X)‘’. We systematically vary the source to which the hint is attributed (a professor, a friend, or a dog) across three open-source model families, Qwen, Gemma, and SmolLM. We show that the change induced by the hint follows a predictable structure well-characterized by an exponential tilt: the hint induces an approximately constant mean shift in the hinted answer’s log-odds, with question–target susceptibility largely shared across sources. To explore how this pattern can arise, we introduce a formal decomposition of the hint response and illustrate in controlled synthetic experiments how KL-regularized reward-based training reshapes both hinted and unhinted answer distributions. Finally, we evaluate whether this shift is calibrated to source reliability, finding that the log-odds shift persists even when the hint-giver is declared inaccurate or accompanied by explicit warnings not to trust the source, highlighting the vulnerability of LLMs to adversarial steering.

[NLP-61] X-Dubbing: Speech-to-Speech Translation under Temporal and Visual Constraints

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决跨语言配音（cross-lingual dubbing）中的时序同步难题，即如何在保持原始视频帧与目标语言语音严格同步的前提下，实现自然流畅且忠实于原文语义的翻译。其核心挑战在于不同语言在发音时长、节奏和发声方式上的差异导致的时序不匹配问题。解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为X-Dubbing的端到端框架，将任务建模为时间感知的语音到文本翻译与视频感知的文本到语音生成的联合优化问题。该框架包含两个核心组件：一是“配音翻译器”（Dubbing Translator），用于生成具有时序结构的目标语言脚本；二是“配音演员”（Voice Actor），负责根据脚本合成与原视频同步的语音。二者均基于一种语言无关的时序预算进行约束，并通过合成语音提供的配音感知反馈对翻译器进行迭代优化，从而提升最终配音的时序一致性。该方法无需成对的配音数据，分别在语音-文本数据和单语音视频数据上进行训练，显著提升了跨语言配音的质量与同步性。
