作者: Jeongsoo Choi,Ji-Hoon Kim,Junseok Ahn,Joon Son Chung
机构: KAIST(韩国科学技术院); Chung-Ang University(中央大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cross-lingual dubbing aims to convert source speech into target-language speech that remains synchronized with the original video. The key to this task is to produce a faithful translation that is naturally speakable within the source timing, which is non-trivial because languages differ in duration, rhythm, and articulation. In this paper, we propose X-Dubbing, which formulates the task as a joint problem of time-aware speech-to-text translation and video-aware text-to-speech. Specifically, our method consists of a Dubbing Translator that generates temporally structured scripts and a Voice Actor that renders them in synchrony with the source video, both grounded in a language-agnostic timing budget. We further refine the translator with dubbing-aware feedback from the synthesized speech, encouraging scripts that yield well-synchronized dubbing. This design requires no paired dubbing data, as the two components are trained on speech-text and monolingual audio-visual data respectively. Extensive experiments show that X-Dubbing outperforms recent baselines across diverse metrics, including isochrony and audio-visual correspondence.

[NLP-62] DraMaze: A Multi-Agent Pipeline with Future-Aware Memory for Diverse Microdrama Script Generation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决长篇微剧（long-form microdrama）脚本生成中面临的两大核心挑战：一是如何在生成过程中保持多样化的剧情推进，二是如何确保长距离叙事连贯性。传统方法在生成后期容易导致候选续写内容逐渐集中于少数叙事机制，且依赖的检索策略易加剧陈词滥调（trope）重复，忽视对后续情节至关重要的历史信息。其解决方案的关键在于提出DraMaze多智能体流水线框架，通过基于陈词滥调记忆引导的进化树搜索（trope memory-guided evolutionary tree search）与变异机制，探索多样化因果路径；同时构建反向叙事依赖树（Backward Narrative Dependency Tree），根据未来叙事目标组织、保留并高效检索历史记忆。此外，研究还引入MiDramaBench双语基准测试集及因果模式度量指标，用于评估脚本逻辑性与创意质量。实验结果表明，DraMaze在三种主流大语言模型（LLM）上均实现显著提升，在长达60集、总字数达6万字的剧本生成任务中，因果模式重复率降低32.1%，逻辑得分达到82.5，较最优基线提升8.5分。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32002
作者: Siyang He,Qiqi Wang,Fan Liu,Yuncheng Huang,Pengfei Xu,Xi Chen,Ziwei He,Xipeng Qiu
机构: 1. Tsinghua University (清华大学); 2. Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (北京人工智能研究院); 3. Peking University (北京大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:The rapid growth of microdramas has increased demand for high-quality script production. Long-form microdrama script generation with LLMs requires both diverse plot progression and long-range narrative coherence. Our observations reveal that candidate continuations increasingly concentrate on fewer narrative mechanisms as generation progresses, while conventional retrieval may reinforce trope reuse and overlook historical information essential to future plots. To address these challenges, we propose DraMaze, a multi-agent pipeline that explores diverse causal paths through trope memory-guided evolutionary tree search and mutation. It further constructs a Backward Narrative Dependency Tree to organize, retain, and retrieve historical memories based on future narrative goals. We also introduce MiDramaBench, a bilingual benchmark for evaluating script logic and creative quality across different script lengths, together with causal-pattern metrics for narrative repetition and diversity. Experiments show consistent improvements across three backbone LLMs. For 60-episode scripts of up to 60k words, DraMaze reduces causal-pattern repetition by 32.1% and achieves a Logic score of 82.5, outperforming the best-performing baseline by 8.5 points.

[NLP-63] AusClinBench: a deterministically scored benchmark of large language models against current Australian clinical policy

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式人工智能（Generative AI）在澳大利亚临床决策支持与病历自动生成中缺乏透明度和本地适配性的问题，尤其关注现有医学评估基准多基于其他司法管辖区、无法有效衡量模型对澳大利亚本土医疗规范（如PBS授权、MBS计费、Ahpra职责、分诊警示标志、免疫接种与筛查指南等）的准确应用。其核心解决方案是构建一个基于澳大利亚临床指南和法规的142道多领域可验证问题基准测试，通过“盲测”与“提供规则条款后测试”的对比设计，区分模型对规则的记忆错误与应用错误。研究发现，尽管部分模型盲测准确率可达92.7%，但高达86%的失败案例在提供条款后可正确回答，表明主要问题在于规则应用而非知识缺失；同时存在显著的“自信错误”现象（6.6%–47.8%），且在涉及原住民健康及无明确指引的免疫接种问题上，模型常生成不准确或非本地化内容。因此，论文提出应将模型视为临床产品中的关键组件，建立针对本地医疗规则的最低标准，并将其纳入临床产品整体评估体系，而非仅评价基础模型性能。该基准测试聚焦于基础模型，不认证任何模型用于临床实践，其核心建议依赖于全科医生的初步评审，尚未经过独立验证。

Abstract:AI models already inform clinical decisions and draft notes in Australian clinical software, usually without the practitioner being told which model is used. Existing medical benchmarks are written for other jurisdictions. We wrote 142 questions from Australian guidelines and schedules across five domains (PBS authority, MBS billing, Ahpra obligations, triage red flags, immunisation and screening), each with one verifiable answer scored by exact match. Each question ran blind and with the governing clause supplied, which separates failure to recall the current rule from failure to apply it. We tested 28 models between July and October 2026. Blind accuracy ranged from 51.5% to 92.7%, and the highest-scoring models could not be separated. Of 791 failed model-question pairs, 684 (86%) were wrong blind and right with the clause. Confident-error rates ranged from 6.6% to 47.8%. On five immunisation questions where the guideline gives no directive, 82% of answers stated one. On 20 Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health questions, models did no worse overall, but on a few the wrong answers gave the rule for the general population, an older rule or another country’s rule. We propose treating the model as an ingredient of a clinical product, with a minimum standard on local rules that sits beside product evaluation. The keys are one general practitioner’s and are not yet independently reviewed. The benchmark measures base models, not clinical products, and does not license any model for clinical use.

[NLP-64] POS-Signature Demonstration Retrieval for In-Context Dependency Parsing

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在上下文学习（in-context learning）中，基于语义相似性进行示范样本检索在结构化预测任务中可能带来的相关性偏差问题。其核心挑战在于如何更有效地选择与目标句子在语法结构上高度匹配的示范样本，以提升模型在通用依存句法分析（Universal Dependencies parsing）任务中的性能。解决方案的关键在于提出一种基于词性标注统计（POS-signature）的示范选择策略：该策略通过加权词性分布特征对句子进行表征，并从已标注训练集中检索三个长度兼容且已正确解析的示范样本。实验在英语-网页树库（English Web Treebank, EWT）测试集的全部2,077个句子上进行，对比了两种开源大语言模型在无微调条件下的表现，结果表明，基于POS签名的检索方法在两个模型上的标注附着率（labeled attachment score）分别达到72.4和73.2，显著优于基于语义相似性的三样本基线（分别高出1.9和2.7个百分点），且双侧配对bootstrap 95%置信区间均不包含零值，具有统计显著性。研究还发现，链式思维（chain-of-thought）与批判性优化（critique-refinement）等方法的效果因模型而异。整体结果支持采用基于词性统计的示范选择策略在英文依存句法分析任务中的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31966
作者: Muhammad Azam Afridi,Rajab Ali,Marco Passarotti
机构: Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Milan, Italy(天主教圣心大学, 米兰, 意大利); University of Zaragoza, Zaragoza, Spain(萨拉戈萨大学, 萨拉戈萨, 西班牙); Universidade NOVA de Lisboa, Lisbon, Portugal(里斯本新大学, 里斯本, 葡萄牙); Université libre de Bruxelles, Brussels, Belgium(布鲁塞尔自由大学, 布鲁塞尔, 比利时)

Abstract:Demonstrations for in-context learning are often retrieved by semantic similarity, which may be a poor proxy for relevance in structured prediction. We study demonstration selection for Universal Dependencies parsing with a POS-signature policy that represents sentences with weighted part-of-speech statistics and retrieves three length-compatible, gold-parsed examples from the labeled training split. We evaluate two open-weight language models without fine-tuning on all 2,077 sentences of the UD English Web Treebank test set, comparing the policy with shot- and format-matched fixed and semantic three-shot baselines, as well as zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and critique-refinement systems. POS-signature retrieval yields the highest labeled attachment score among the tested prompting systems for both models (72.4 and 73.2), outperforming semantic retrieval by 1.9 and 2.7 points; paired-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals exclude zero for both contrasts. Chain-of-thought and refinement comparisons vary across models. These exploratory results favor the tested POS-signature retrieval approach on English-EWT. We release the prompts, archived outputs, and evaluation code.

[NLP-65] Which Answer Did the Seventeen-Year-Old Write? A Behavioral Case Study of Author-Age Misattribution Miscalibrated Confidence and Non-Corrective Self-Explanation in Six Frontier Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在揭示生成式AI在识别人类文本中作者年龄与认知特征方面存在的系统性偏差问题，具体聚焦于模型对不同年龄段写作者回答同一开放性问题（“什么是幸福？你幸福吗？”）时的年龄误判现象。研究发现，尽管17岁青少年的回答表现出典型的年轻化语言特征（如措辞谨慎、形式化），但主流前沿大模型仍普遍将其错误归因于成年人，且在多项实验条件下表现出高达90%的误判率。其解决方案的关键在于识别并验证模型对年龄-语言关联的刻板印象依赖——即模型在缺乏明确上下文线索时，过度依赖社会刻板印象而非实际语言特征进行推断。研究通过操控题干框架、输出格式和受众意识指令等变量，发现仅一个模型在加入简单受众意识提示后性能提升21个百分点，而其他模型则无显著改善；更关键的是，多数模型表现出高度自信但准确性极低的现象，且其自述解释中常包含对自身偏见的反思，却无法反映真实判断质量，暴露出“高自信—低准确”之间的严重脱节。该研究并非统计性调查，而是以三篇样本为核心的机制探索，旨在揭示生成式AI在理解人类语用差异时所面临的深层认知缺陷。

作者: Brianne Lee
机构: Independent Researcher(独立研究员)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 15 pages, 6 tables. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Three students answered the same exam prompt by hand: “What is happiness? Are you happy?” Their ages, recorded at collection, are 17, 28, and 45. The 17-year-old’s answer is hedged and formally phrased. Asked to match each answer to an age and gender label, most frontier language models confidently assign it to an adult. This paper reports a structured case study of that failure across six models: Claude Fable 5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.6 Sol, Grok 4.5, GPT-4o (2024), and DeepSeek V4. We ran 1,081 API sessions and scored 3,225 responses across six experimental conditions that manipulate framing, disclosure format, and audience-awareness instruction. Three of six models perform at or near chance (1/3) on the matching task while reporting 73-88% mean confidence. The youngest writer’s answer is misattributed to an adult in up to 90% of trials. Removing the multiple-choice scaffold collapses accuracy further: three models never place within three years of the true age once open-ended estimation is required. Institutional framing (“a community-college biology final”) significantly degrades the best-performing model’s accuracy; a neutral label does not. A single audience-awareness instruction significantly improves one model (+21 points) and moves another to ceiling, with no detectable effect on the three weakest models. Stated confidence is uncorrelated or inversely correlated with correctness for five of six models. After ground truth is revealed, one model names its own stereotyping in 68 of 114 explanations, yet shows the lowest accuracy and highest confidence of any model under blind presentation: articulate retrospective diagnosis that does not track the quality of its judgments. This is a three-item, single-topic, single-language case study meant to isolate a mechanism, not to estimate a population bias rate. Data, code, and raw model outputs are publicly released.

[NLP-66] Kolibri: A Sovereign European Model on the Pareto Frontier

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大模型在特定语言（尤其是德语）及受监管领域（如公共行政、工业与航空航天）中实现主权部署与专业化应用的挑战，核心问题在于如何在保证高性能的同时，降低推理成本并确保数据与训练过程的可控性。其解决方案的关键在于构建一个基于混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）架构的开源模型Kolibri，该模型拥有781亿总参数，但每令牌仅激活34.6亿活跃参数，显著提升了计算效率。通过自研的数据管道，团队构建了超过2万亿字节的训练数据，其中德语文本占比超过20%，并利用合成生成技术补充高质量德语语料。模型采用端到端可控的全链路开发流程，涵盖从数据采集、架构设计、训练基础设施到后训练优化与评估的全流程自主控制，后训练阶段结合监督微调与强化学习，在超过120万条内部标注任务上进行优化，覆盖推理、工具使用、指令遵循、代码生成和信息检索等能力。最终，Kolibri在英德双语任务中均达到开放模型中的帕累托前沿性能-服务成本平衡，体现了其在专业化、低成本与可信赖部署方面的优势。

Abstract:This report introduces Kolibri, an English-German mixture-of-experts transformer with 78.1B total parameters and 3.46B active parameters per token, released as open weights under the Apache 2.0 licence. We built Kolibri for sovereign and specialised deployment, with a particular focus on German and on regulated domains such as public administration, industry, and aerospace. To support these settings, we control the full model-development process, including data, architecture, training infrastructure, post-training, and evaluation. We train Kolibri on 24T tokens across pre-training, mid-training, and long-context extension, with German accounting for more than 20% of the data mix by bytes. To reach this share, we complement German datasets with more than 2T German tokens that we curate from the web with our own pipeline and generate synthetically. Post-training combines supervised fine-tuning on curated German and English data with reinforcement learning on more than 1.2M internally curated tasks, which cover reasoning, tool use, instruction following, code, and retrieval. The model activates 4.4% of its parameters per token, and among the open models evaluated in this report, it lies on the Pareto frontier of quality and serving cost in English and German. Kolibri builds on Kolibri Origin, an earlier iteration that validated our full pipeline at scale. Both models come from our Model Factory, which connects data, experimentation, training, evaluation, and deployment through version-controlled workflows. [NLP-67] Agreement rather than normalisation keeps depth reusable in looped language models ICLR2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决循环语言模型（looped language models）在超出训练预算的深度下仍能保持性能可用性的关键问题，即模型深度的可重用性机制。其核心关切在于：这种可重用性是否依赖于循环步骤间的状态归一化（state-norm growth），抑或更根本地取决于训练时与推理时循环结构的一致性（agreement between training and inference loops）。研究发现，移除释放版本Ouro模型中的循环边界归一化操作，在不增加参数且读出路径比特完全一致的情况下，会导致模型在平衡二分类任务上迅速降至随机猜测水平（0.500），表明归一化并非问题根源——因为状态范数仅增长2.021倍，远未达到失效阈值。相反，在从头训练的19M参数合成任务模型中，去除归一化不仅不会损害性能，反而在超预算情况下表现出更强的外推能力（Cliff’s delta最高达0.867），且训练与推理环路的一致性是维持性能的关键。进一步分析揭示，性能退化主要源于读出头与循环块末尾层之间的耦合失配；通过冻结修改后的循环结构并仅重新拟合读出头，可恢复约三分之一的精度，而重新拟合末尾层则能完全恢复性能。最后，当控制超调量相等时，循环架构相对于堆叠深度在两个任务上的优势显著减弱甚至消失，说明此前观察到的循环优势可能由训练预算超调差异所混淆。综上，解决方案的关键在于训练与推理阶段循环结构的一致性，而非状态归一化本身。

作者: Ivan Viakhirev,Kirill Borodin,Maxim Abramov,Grach Mkrtchian
机构: lab260(雅典娜实验室), Yerevan, Armenia; BitmanagerAI(比特管理人工智能), Dubai, UAE; St. Petersburg Federal Research Center of the Russian Academy of Sciences(圣彼得堡联邦科学研究中心, 俄罗斯科学院); St. Petersburg, Russia
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Under review at ICLR 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Looped language models apply one block of layers repeatedly, and the design pays off only if depth is reusable: loop steps beyond the trained budget must remain usable at inference. We ask whether that rests on normalising the state between loop steps, as the released Ouro models do, or on agreement between the loop a model is trained with and the loop it is run with. On released weights this loop-boundary normalisation can be removed without adding parameters and with the readout path bit-identical, and the operation is an identity at one loop step, which serves as an implementation check. Removing it takes Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B to zero accuracy by the trained budget on a balanced binary task (chance 0.500). State-norm growth, the failure that prior accounts predict, is not the cause: the norm stays within a factor of 2.021 while the head commits to a single wrong token. Yet in 19M-parameter models trained from scratch on two synthetic tasks, 16 seeds per configuration, training without the normalisation is never worse than training with it and extrapolates better: the two are closest at the trained depth and separate on both sides of it (Cliff’s delta up to 0.867 beyond the budget). Both results follow if agreement, and not the normalisation itself, is what keeps depth reusable. The damage sits in the readout together with the last layer of the block: in the models trained from scratch, refitting the head over the frozen modified loop recovers a third of the lost accuracy and plateaus, while refitting the last block layer with it recovers all of it. Finally, comparing looped with stacked depth at an equal inference loop count is confounded by unequal overshoot of the trained budget; at matched overshoot the advantage of looping vanishes on one task and shrinks on the other.

[NLP-68] LazyFlash: Forward-Dense Backward-Sparse Attention for Accelerated Long-Context Fine-Tuning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在处理长序列时，注意力机制（Attention）成为主要计算瓶颈的问题。尽管稀疏注意力（Sparse Attention）在推理阶段已有所应用，但多数方法仍采用密集训练（Dense Training），或无法支持稀疏训练，且其引入的复杂性难以转化为实际的时钟时间（wall-clock）加速，导致密集注意力在实践中仍被广泛使用。针对这一问题，论文提出了一种前向密集、后向稀疏的注意力机制——LazyFlash。其核心创新在于观察到注意力训练过程主要由反向传播主导，并据此设计了基于梯度感知的块级稀疏化策略：在前向传播中保持完全密集以确保模型兼容现有系统（如vLLM）；在反向传播中，通过查询块的注意力输出梯度范数进行重要性排序，跳过对参数更新贡献可忽略的块，从而将密集反向传播转换为块稀疏形式。进一步地，引入梯度质量预算（Gradient-Mass Budget）动态调节各注意力头及训练步的跳过计算量，结合重要性采样保证稀疏梯度在期望上与密集梯度一致。该设计被集成于分块的FlashAttention反向核中，未被跳过的块从不加载或计算，真正实现了梯度稀疏带来的时钟时间加速。实验结果表明，LazyFlash在保持下游任务性能的同时，相比FlashAttention实现了高达5.7倍的注意力反向传播加速，以及1.7倍的端到端训练加速，在长上下文文本与语音大模型上均验证了有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31911
作者: Keqi Deng,Ruchao Fan,Jinyu Li
机构: Microsoft(微软)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As large language models (LLMs) process increasingly long sequences, attention becomes a major computational bottleneck. Sparse attention mostly targets inference, yet many methods still train densely or cannot support sparse training, and their added complexity makes sparsity hard to turn into wall-clock speedups, leaving dense attention widely used in practice. This paper introduces LazyFlash, a forward-dense, backward-sparse attention method built on the observation that attention training is dominated by the backward pass. LazyFlash keeps the forward pass exactly dense, so the trained model remains a standard dense model that existing systems such as vLLM can serve without any change. For the backward pass, LazyFlash proposes a gradient-aware block sparsification design that ranks query blocks by their attention-output gradient norms and skips those contributing negligibly to parameter updates, turning the dense backward into a block-sparse one. A gradient-mass budget adapts the amount of skipped computation to each head and training step, while importance sampling preserves the dense gradient in expectation. These designs are implemented inside the tiled FlashAttention backward kernel, where skipped blocks are never loaded or computed, translating gradient sparsity into real wall-clock acceleration. Experiments on long-context text and speech LLMs show that LazyFlash maintains downstream performance while achieving up to 5.7x attention-backward speedup over FlashAttention and 1.7x end-to-end training speedup.

[NLP-69] Knowing When to Stop: The Evidence-Action Gap in Coding Agents

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式智能体在任务执行过程中存在的“证据-行动鸿沟”（evidence-action gap）问题，即智能体在环境已明确表明任务无法继续推进时仍持续尝试、过度坚持、采取不当变通手段并错误声称成功，而未能及时寻求外部帮助。其核心解决方案在于构建一个名为ImpasseBench的评估基准，通过在可解的修复任务中引入12种现实环境阻塞（environment blockers），并在每条轨迹中标记出证据充分足以判断需要外部干预的步骤，从而量化智能体在恰当时机停止努力与过早放弃或过度坚持之间的行为差异。研究发现，尽管几乎所有需外部协助的任务都已积累足够证据，仍有约三分之一的智能体耗尽资源预算，且所有不安全请求均发生在证据充分之后。通过引入“升级工具”（escalation tool）或外部监控机制，可将资源耗尽率从34.0%降至6.7%，并显著提升环境恢复后的任务成功率。然而，当前的升级机制仍存在缺陷：生成的工单虽能准确识别阻塞原因，却常遗漏智能体自身的进展与验证状态。因此，论文强调必须在智能体的移交工具及其提交报告中显式支持“何时停止”的决策，以实现真正有效的协作与任务恢复。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31895
作者: Tianyu Chen,Xinran Zhao,Vijay Viswanathan,Shoubin Yu,Mingyuan Zhou,Tongshuang Wu
机构: University of Texas at Austin(德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校); Carnegie Mellon University(卡内基梅隆大学); The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill(北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校)
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Coding agents are trained to complete tasks, and they keep trying even when the environment makes completion impossible. The evidence that only outside help can restore progress usually appears within a few steps, yet agents rarely act on it: they over-persist, attempt undesired workarounds, and claim success the record does not support – a phenomenon we call evidence-action gap. To measure it, we introduce ImpasseBench, which injects twelve realistic environment blockers into otherwise solvable repair tasks and marks, in each trajectory, the step at which the collected evidence becomes sufficient. Scoring actions relative to that step separates appropriate effort from over-persistence and premature handoff. Across eight frontier models and 19,371 trajectories, we find that nearly every run that needs outside help collects sufficient evidence, yet a third still exhaust their budget, and every unsafe request we detect comes after that point. Fortunately, an escalation tool, or an external monitor for models that ignore the tool, already guards against much of this behavior: the tool cuts budget exhaustion from 34.0% to 6.7%, and the monitor nearly triples task success after environment restoration. Even then, a fired escalation is not yet a useful handoff: tickets reliably name the blocker but often omit the agent’s own progress and verification status. Taken together, we argue that knowing when to stop therefore needs explicit support, both in the tool that lets an agent hand off and in the report it leaves behind.

[NLP-70] axoSAE: Rethinking Sparse Autoencoders through Taxonomic Logic

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有稀疏自编码器（Sparse Autoencoders, SAEs）在解析大语言模型（LLMs）表征时，无法有效建模知识的层级化（即分类学）结构的问题。传统SAEs将每个特征视为独立单元，导致知识读取缺乏分类一致性，且控制粒度不足，难以精确限定编辑范围。为此，本文提出TaxoSAE，其核心创新在于显式地将“是-一种”（is-a，即上位词-下位词）关系引入SAE特征空间，通过构建分层的SAE堆栈（每层对应分类学的一个层级），并设计分类学对齐损失（taxonomic alignment loss），使每个概念在任一其下位词激活时均被触发。实验表明，TaxoSAE在两个事实问答分类体系（人物关系与动物分类）上显著提升了性能：（1）通过分类结构实现更精准的知识读取，例如对训练中未查询的抽象概念上位词的读取准确率提升31.3点；（2）控制精度更高，概念替换成功率提升25.5点，且移除某概念仅影响其自身答案（其他概念准确率维持91–100%，而对照组为0–2%）；更重要的是，实现了对未见概念的上位词推断读取，上位词读取准确率最高提升37.9点。因此，解决方案的关键在于通过分层结构与分类学对齐机制，使特征空间具备语义层级组织能力，从而实现一致、可解释且可扩展的知识读取与控制。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31894
作者: Xinyu Guo,Minglai Yang,Clayton T. Morrison,Eduardo Blanco,Mihai Surdeanu
机构: University of Arizona(亚利桑那大学); Scale AI(规模人工智能)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Recent Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) decompose the representations of large language models (LLMs) into interpretable features, enabling precise readout and control of encoded knowledge. However, existing SAEs treat each feature as a standalone unit, whereas real-world knowledge is often taxonomically organized. As a result, readout carries no guarantee of taxonomic consistency, and control lacks the granularity to specify the scope of an edit. We propose TaxoSAE, which explicitly encodes taxonomical information, built on is-a (hypernym-hyponym) relations, into the SAE feature space. TaxoSAE mirrors a taxonomy with a stack of SAEs, one per taxonomy level, and introduces a taxonomic alignment loss that trains each concept to be active whenever one of its hyponyms is. On two factual QA taxonomies, one over biographical relations and one over animals, TaxoSAE enables (1) more accurate readout through the taxonomy with concentrated activations, e.g., +31.3 points in reading out the hypernyms of abstract concepts never queried in training; (2) more precise control, with +25.5 points in swap success, while suppressing a concept removes only its own answers (0-2% accuracy vs. 91-100% on other concepts); and, more importantly, (3) readout of unseen concepts through their hypernyms, with up to +37.9 points in hypernym readout accuracy.

[NLP-71] Rewriting Scaling Laws for Synthetic Data with Compute and Data Constraints

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型在预训练数据构建中使用合成重写（synthetic rewrites）时的关键问题，包括应投入多少计算资源用于生成重写数据，以及基于重写数据训练的模型是否能够超越其重写器（rewriter）性能。其核心解决方案是提出了一种重写缩放律（rewriting scaling law），该定律能够预测模型损失（loss）与模型参数规模、训练样本数量、重写数据占比及自然数据迭代轮数之间的关系，并将生成重写数据所消耗的计算量纳入考量。研究在两种场景下验证该缩放律：在计算受限场景中，利用第三方重写器生成重写数据，发现最优重写比例随计算预算增加而上升（从3×10¹⁸ FLOPs下的不足10%增至10²² FLOPs下的32%），且预测的22B参数模型在仅需重写器十分之一训练算力的情况下，仍可在多个网络领域实现更低的比特每字符（BPB），接近预测性能；在数据受限场景中，重写器与目标模型同规模并基于相同种子数据预训练，结果表明使用自身预训练数据的重写版本进行训练，在所有模型规模（最高达3B）下均优于仅使用原始自然数据的模型。研究表明，通过缩放律视角可系统性地优化合成重写策略，且模型性能提升不必然受限于重写器的能力边界。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31867
作者: Nicholas Roberts,Ahmed Ahmed,Suhas Kotha,Percy Liang,Yu Wang,Alex Renda,Nitya Mani
机构: Princeton University (普林斯顿大学); Stanford University (斯坦福大学); Jane Street (Jane Street)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Synthetic rewrites, where a language model rewrites a natural document e.g. into a target style, are now a standard ingredient of pretraining corpora. However, critical aspects of their use remain poorly understood, such as how much compute should be spent rewriting training data and whether a model trained on rewrites can outperform the rewriter. We study these two questions by proposing a rewriting scaling law that predicts loss from model size, training tokens, the fraction of training tokens that are rewrites, and the number of epochs over the natural data, charging the compute spent generating rewrites. We fit this scaling law in two settings. In the compute-limited setting, natural data is plentiful and rewrites come from a third-party rewriter trained with more compute than our largest run. We find that the estimated optimal rewrite fraction increases with compute, from under 10% at 3\times10^18 FLOPs to 32% at 10^22 FLOPs. Our scaling forecast extrapolates 33\times in FLOPs to train a 22B-parameter model, whose final loss is within 1.1% of our prediction. This model achieves a better BPB than its rewriter on several web domains at one-tenth the rewriter’s training compute. In the data-limited setting, we assume we only have a fixed seed set of natural data and that our rewriter is a model of the same size as the target, pretrained on that seed set. Again, we find the optimal rewrite fraction increases with the compute budget. We also demonstrate that a model trained on rewrites of its own pretraining data, generated by a rewriter of the same size, beats the best run on natural data alone at every model size up to 3B. Our results show that synthetic rewriting can be studied through the scaling law lens: that optimal methodological choices are predictable and scaling does not necessarily break down beyond the rewriter’s capabilities.

[NLP-72] Aligning Large Language Models with Human Feedback: Mathematical Foundations and Algorithm Design

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）与人类意图、偏好及价值观对齐的问题，即如何使LLM的输出行为符合人类期望，避免产生有害或不符合伦理的内容。其核心挑战在于如何有效建模并优化模型以反映复杂且主观的人类偏好。解决方案的关键在于基于人类反馈的训练范式，主要包括监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning, SFT）、基于人类反馈的强化学习（Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback, RLHF）以及直接偏好优化（Direct Preference Optimization, DPO）。其中，DPO通过将偏好学习转化为一个更简洁的监督学习问题，避免了传统RLHF中复杂的策略优化与奖励建模过程，显著提升了训练效率与稳定性。此外，论文从逆强化学习（Inverse Reinforcement Learning, IRL）和离散选择模型的理论视角出发，为理解人类偏好学习提供了坚实的数学基础，从而为设计更鲁棒、可扩展的对齐算法提供了理论支撑与实践指导。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31862
作者: Siliang Zeng,Luca Viano,Chenliang Li,Jiaxiang Li,Volkan Cevher,Markus Wulfmeier,Stefano Ermon,Alfredo Garcia,Mingyi Hong
机构: University of Minnesota(明尼苏达大学); EPFL(瑞士联邦理工学院洛桑分校); Texas A&M University(德克萨斯农工大学); Google DeepMind(谷歌深脑); Stanford University(斯坦福大学)
类目: Machine Learning (cs.LG); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This article provides an introduction to the mathematical foundations and algorithmic frameworks used to align Large Language Models (LLMs) with human intentions, preferences, and values. We discuss standard alignment techniques, such as fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and direct preference optimization (DPO). We also explore the theoretical underpinnings of learning from human preferences, drawing connections to inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) and discrete choice models. We present state-of-the-art algorithms in a tutorial style, discuss their advantages and limitations, and offer insights into practical implementation. Our exposition is intended to serve as a comprehensive resource for researchers and practitioners, providing both a foundational understanding of alignment methodologies and a framework for developing more robust and scalable alignment techniques.

[NLP-73] SWE-Clar: Can Coding Agents Clarify Incomplete Client Requirements and Deliver Greenfield Software?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自由职业软件开发场景中，编码代理（coding agent）如何在客户需求不完整或难以持续反馈的情况下，准确理解并实现复杂需求的问题。核心挑战在于：客户需求往往隐含于对话上下文中，且客户无法在长周期开发过程中持续提供明确反馈，导致编码代理即使获得回应也可能存在误解。为应对这一问题，研究提出关键解决方案——将需求澄清（requirement clarification）置于代码实现之前，并通过显式测试来评估对需求的理解程度。其创新性体现在构建了SWE-Clar基准数据集，基于真实高价值的Upwork项目（每项总支付额不低于4000美元），包含100个任务，每个任务均包含多轮人机交互以模拟真实澄清过程。针对澄清效果评估，研究进一步设计了512个与真实客户-自由职业者对话匹配的问题及其参考答案，涵盖显性需求和语境推断出的隐性需求。实验采用九个前沿模型进行验证，结果显示即便最先进的GPT-6 Astra模型在独立交付任务中的通过率也仅为67%，凸显了在无持续反馈环境下实现精准需求理解与代码生成的严峻挑战。该研究通过隔离澄清与实现阶段、确保评估独立性，为衡量编码代理在真实自由职业场景下的综合能力提供了可靠基准。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31854
作者: Jialei Li,Dingxian Wang,Xiaoyan Zhao,Yimeng Bai,Xuanyi Zhu,Yang Zhang,Chao Yin,Wentao Shi,Ganesh Prabhu,Karthik Gomadam Rajagopal,Brett Levert,Darvin Yi,Andrew Rabinovich,Zhao Chen
机构: University of Science and Technology of China(中国科学技术大学); National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学); Upwork Inc.(Upwork公司)
类目: oftware Engineering (cs.SE); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 29 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Greenfield software development in freelance settings requires coding agents to turn incomplete client requests into working software. This makes requirement clarification essential, yet clients may be unable to provide continuous feedback over long development cycles, and receiving their answers does not guarantee correct understanding of complex requirements. These challenges motivate two benchmark design choices: clarification precedes code implementation, and its effectiveness is assessed through explicit tests of requirement understanding. Guided by these choices, we introduce SWE-Clar, a benchmark grounded in real, high-value client commissions to evaluate requirement clarification and code implementation in this setting. It comprises 100 tasks based on real software development jobs on Upwork, each with at least US\ 4,000 in total payments. Each task begins with multi-round interaction between a coding agent and a client agent, followed by separate runs for code implementation with acceptance testing and clarification assessment. For the latter, we construct 512 questions paired with reference answers from real client-freelancer interactions, covering both explicitly stated requirements and those inferred from the conversational context. Both runs begin from the same clarification context but remain isolated, preventing assessment questions from guiding code implementation. Experiments with nine frontier models show that even GPT-6 Astra, which has the highest observed implementation score, achieves a task pass rate of only 67%, underscoring the challenge of independent software delivery in this setting. The dataset and evaluation code are available at this https URL.

[NLP-74] Scaling cross-situational word learning on childrens naturalistic experiences

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决儿童如何习得早期词汇中大量简单、具体名词意义的问题，核心关注点在于跨情境学习（cross-situational learning）这一机制在真实自然语境下的有效性与局限性。其解决方案的关键在于利用对比视觉-语言模型，在第一人称视角视频数据（egocentric video data）上验证跨情境学习策略的可行性。研究发现，尽管模型在小规模数据上已展现出初步成功，但其性能高度依赖于视觉表征的质量：当使用互联网预训练的视觉表示时，模型在对象-标签映射任务上的表现显著优于仅从发展性视频数据中学习视觉表征的模型。此外，绝大多数学习信号来自少量明确描述可见参照物的语句。虽然模型最终习得了具有类人语义结构的词汇表征，但其学习轨迹与儿童的发展模式存在显著差异。因此，构建符合发展规律的词义学习模型，关键在于如何从自然主义的日常经验数据中有效学习高质量的视觉表征。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31842
作者: Michael C. Frank,Alvin W. M. Tan,Khai Loong Aw,Robert Z. Sparks,Victor Moreno,Grace Keene-Lee,Meesha R. Ryan,Tarun Sepuri,Jane Yang,Virginia A. Marchman,Daniel L. K. Yamins,Bria Long
机构: Stanford University (斯坦福大学); Harvard University (哈佛大学); University of Wisconsin, Madison (威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校); University of Oregon (俄勒冈大学); University of California, San Diego (加州大学圣地亚哥分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:How do children learn the meanings of the simple, concrete words that form a majority of their early vocabulary? Statistical information about many word meanings can be recovered from the gradual accumulation of information about the co-occurrence of words with their referents, a proposal known as ``cross-situational learning’'. Contrastive vision–language models allow this learning strategy to be tested on egocentric video data capturing children’s early real-life experiences with visual and linguistic inputs. Initial successes of this method on small datasets provide a proof-of-concept, but vision models struggle to learn robust visual representations when trained on these same egocentric videos. How dependent is cross-situational word learning performance on the quality of the model’s visual representations? And can cross-situational models scale to larger and more diverse datasets? To address these questions, we trained models on the BabyView corpus, including 2,441 hours of longitudinal egocentric video from 48 children. Models trained on this dataset learned object–label mappings, but performance was far higher when they used internet-pretrained visual representations as opposed to when visual representations were learned solely from the developmental video data. Further, the majority of the learning signal was carried by a small proportion of utterances that described a visible referent. Models learned lexical representations that showed recognizable human-like semantic structure, but model performance showed substantially different trajectories over training experiences than those observed in children. Cross-situational learning is a viable word learning strategy for early noun vocabulary, but constructing developmentally plausible models will require understanding how to learn high-quality visual representations from naturalistic data.

[NLP-75] SPECMEM: Accelerating Agent ic Tool Calling via Live Memory Management

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决工具调用智能体（tool-calling agents）在实际部署中因逐个自回归解码工具调用而导致的高延迟问题。现有方法虽采用推测解码（speculative decoding）提升效率，并利用历史调用作为生成草稿，但其关键缺陷在于缺乏跨会话的记忆机制——要么完全不保留记忆，要么仅构建一次静态存储且不再更新。为此，本文提出SpecMem，一种在部署期间持续维护并动态管理的工具调用记忆系统：经过验证的工具调用被实时写回基于用户维度、采用最近最少使用（LRU）淘汰策略的有限存储中；同时引入副作用门控机制（side-effect gate），将不可逆操作延迟至验证通过后才执行。在由三个开源权重模型支撑的多会话、多用户查询流上测试表明，固定存储（frozen store）随时间逐渐失效，而SpecMem保持稳定的接受率——平均接受词元数提升27%（各基准测试中提升11%至34%），且在最坏情况下实现高达1.74倍的时钟速度加速。消融实验表明，性能优势几乎全部源于维持存储的动态活性；局部用户作用域设计虽未提升接受率，但有效阻断了跨用户信息泄露通道；而基于声明式副作用而非检索置信度进行门控，是避免不可逆错误的关键所在。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31840
作者: Zihe Song,Wenting Zhao,Ye Liu,Yuanjie Zhu,Ke Xu,Shanghao Li,Philip S. Yu
机构: University of Illinois Chicago(伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校); Salesforce Research( Salesforce 研究院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Tool-calling agents are mostly optimized for accuracy; in deployment, however, their growing cost is latency: every tool call is decoded autoregressively. Speculative decoding accelerates this without changing the output, and retrieved past calls make strong drafts under real use, where each user’s behavior tends to repeat. Yet existing systems keep no cross-session memory, or build the draft store once and never update it. We propose SpecMem, a tool-call memory kept alive and managed throughout deployment: verified calls are written back online into bounded per-user stores with LRU eviction, and a side-effect gate defers irreversible calls until verification confirms. On multi-session, multi-user query streams served by three open-weight models, a frozen store steadily loses acceptance while SpecMem holds it: a 27% gap in mean accepted tokens (+11% to +34% across benchmarks, tracking how much novel work arrives after the store is built) and up to 1.74x wall-clock speedup. Ablations attribute the gain almost entirely to keeping the store live; local per-user scoping adds no acceptance but closes a measured cross-user leakage channel, and gating on declared side effects, rather than on retrieval confidence, is what eliminates irreversible mistakes.

[NLP-76] SAGE: Sense-Aligned Multimodal Grounding Evaluation with Gloss-Augmented Reasoning

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态语义接地（Multimodal Semantic Grounding）中不同基准测试（如VWSD、VerSe和WikiDiverse）之间评估标准不统一、泛化能力难以衡量以及模型对目标项（target-term）的深层语义理解不足的问题。其核心挑战在于现有方法在特定任务上表现优异时，往往无法在跨任务场景下实现一致的性能迁移，且缺乏对模型是否真正理解语义定义与上下文约束的细粒度分析。为此，论文提出SAGE（Sense-Aligned Grounding Evaluation），一个统一的10候选图像选择基准，将三类不同中心化的接地任务（名词、动词、实体为中心）整合至共享的以术语为中心（term-centric）的协议下，并引入具有混淆性难负样本（confusable hard negatives）及上下文交换诊断（context-swapped VerSe diagnostic）的机制，以更严格地检验模型对目标术语的语义接地能力。关键解决方案为Gloss-Augmented Reasoning（GAR），一种无需训练的框架，通过结合定义接地（definition grounding）与约束引导的语义验证（constraint-guided semantic verification），增强模型对词汇语义的显式推理能力。实验表明，仅使用定义增强即可提升所有子集性能，而约束引导推理在VWSD和VerSe上表现尤为突出，但在WikiDiverse上效果有限；二者联合使用时取得最优宏观平均性能，使Hits@1从65.90提升至71.22，证明SAGE不仅支持统一评估，还能实现对不同接地设置下显式语义推理能力的精细分析。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31838
作者: Sunjae Kwon,Suhaas Kiran DG,Zonghai Yao,Talha Chafekar,Deepali Singh,Hong Yu
机构: UMass Amherst(马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校); UMass Lowell(马萨诸塞大学洛厄尔分校); UMass Chan Medical School(马萨诸塞大学医学院); VA Bedford Health Care(贝德福德退伍军人健康护理中心)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:This paper introduces Sense-Aligned Grounding Evaluation (SAGE), a unified 10-candidate image-selection benchmark that reformulates VWSD, VerSe, and WikiDiverse into a shared term-centric protocol covering noun-, verb-, and entity-centered grounding. SAGE includes confusable hard negatives and a context-swapped VerSe diagnostic to probe target-term grounding beyond direct caption–image compatibility. We further propose Gloss-Augmented Reasoning (GAR), a training-free framework combining definition grounding with constraint-guided semantic verification. Experiments show that strong VWSD performance does not transfer uniformly across grounding settings. With Gemma3-12B, definition augmentation improves all three subsets, while constraint-guided reasoning improves VWSD and yields particularly strong gains on VerSe, but is less effective on WikiDiverse. Combining the two signals achieves the best macro-average performance, improving Hits@1 from 65.90 to 71.22. These results show that SAGE supports both unified evaluation and fine-grained analysis of explicit semantic reasoning across grounding settings.

[NLP-77] Latent Coherence: Do Frontier Language Models Probability Judgments Obey the Law of Total Probability?

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究当前前沿语言模型在零样本（zero-shot）情境下，其概率判断是否满足贝叶斯一致性，特别是是否符合全概率定律（law of total probability, P(X) = ∑_z P(z)P(X|z)），其中隐变量 z 需从上下文记录中推断。核心问题是：尽管这些模型未经过专门训练以逼近贝叶斯后验，它们在面对需推理隐变量的情境时，其概率估计是否存在系统性不一致。解决方案的关键在于设计一套基于精确真值的三重独立查询测试框架——分别要求模型输出 P(X)、P(z) 以及 P(X|z)，并通过计算残差（log-odds）量化不一致性。研究发现，虽然部分模型如 GPT-6.1 Sol 与 Claude Opus 5.5 展现较高一致性（平均绝对残差分别为 0.08 和 0.12 log-odds），但多数模型存在显著且特定于任务的不一致（0.27–0.35 log-odds），表明其概率推理在涉及隐变量时仍存在结构性缺陷。值得注意的是，残差与真实值误差呈显著正相关（Spearman 0.40–0.62），因此残差可作为无需依赖真值的不可靠回答预警指标。此外，推理长度无法预测一致性，而简单的一致性检查几乎总能通过，说明失败仅发生在需处理隐变量的复杂推理场景中。

作者: Peter Potash

Abstract:LawZero’s Scientist AI trains a Predictor toward the Bayesian posterior, with an objective that penalizes inconsistent probabilities among latent explanations. We ask whether current frontier language models, with no such training, are already consistent in this sense zero-shot: do their probability judgments satisfy the law of total probability, P(X)=\sum_z P(z)P(X|z) , when the latent z must be inferred from records in the context? In separate single-turn calls, models are asked for P(X) , for P(z) over the latent’s states, and for P(X|z) ; a causal family applies the same test to P(y|do(x)) and the back-door adjustment. Every query has an exact ground-truth probability, and a subset of items is asked in three wordings to separate persistent incoherence from rewording noise. Across seven models, GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 are the most coherent (mean absolute residual 0.08 and 0.12 log-odds, about 2 percentage points). Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash and DeepSeek V4-Pro show persistent incoherence (0.27-0.35 log-odds) that is mostly item-specific rather than a shared offset. Within every model, larger residuals go with larger errors against the truth (Spearman 0.40-0.62), so the residual, which needs no ground truth, flags unreliable answers. Reasoning length does not predict coherence, across models or within a model across rewordings of the same question. Simple consistency checks pass almost everywhere; the failures are specific to reasoning through a latent variable. Code and data: this https URL

[NLP-78] Free Lunch for LLM s Confidence: The RL Critic Already Knows

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在实际部署中缺乏可靠置信度估计的问题，而传统方法依赖额外的数据和计算资源进行专门的置信度训练。其核心问题是：置信度训练本质上是在解决何种预测任务？研究发现，仅基于策略行为轨迹（question, response, correctness）三元组训练的外部置信度估计器，能够以与模型自身相当的精度估计其置信度，且无需访问模型内部表示。这一现象揭示了置信度估计与强化学习中的价值函数学习（value function learning）之间存在深层等价关系——在以正确性为结果指标的前提下，置信度估计与批评者（critic）训练在数学上等价，均旨在预测策略响应正确的概率。因此，对于采用基于价值的强化学习（value-based RL）训练的LLM，其原有的批评者网络可直接作为开箱即用的置信度估计器，无需额外训练或数据。该方案保持策略不变，从而不损害任务性能，同时可在生成过程中的任意步骤（包括中间推理阶段）提供置信度输出。在涵盖数学、代码生成、工具调用及通用推理等十余个领域的实验中，复用的批评者在所有分布内测试集上均表现最优，并在16个评估场景中有14个达到最佳校准性，充分验证了其有效性与实用性。

Abstract:Reliable confidence estimation is essential for trustworthy deployment of large language models (LLMs), but dedicated confidence training stage requires additional data and compute. We ask a fundamental question: what prediction problem does confidence training actually solve? Inspired by prior work on external confidence estimation, we compare self- and external estimators of comparable capacity trained on the same (question, response, correctness) triples. We show that an external model trained solely on a policy’s behavioral traces can estimate the policy’s confidence as accurately as the policy itself, without accessing the policy’s internal representations. This points to a deeper connection with value function learning in reinforcement learning (RL): under a correctness-based outcome, we prove that confidence estimation and critic training are equivalent, both predicting the likelihood that a policy’s response will be correct from its trajectory. A simple consequence follows: for LLMs trained with value-based RL, the existing critic can be reused as an off-the-shelf confidence estimator with no additional training or data. The policy remains unchanged, so its task performance is preserved, and the critic provides confidence throughout generation, including intermediate reasoning steps. Across math, code, tool calling, and general reasoning spanning a dozen domains, the reused critic is the best confidence estimator on every in-distribution split and the best-calibrated on 14 of 16, without hurting the task performance.

Abstract:This article introduces Latin Modern BERT (LAMB), an encoder for the Latin language based on the ModernBERT architecture, pretrained in two phases on more than 74B Latin tokens using a novel morphologically informed masking regimen. We also present two corpora for the Latin language. Acervus contains 24B BERT WordPiece tokens, including over 760K samples from heavily damaged OCR transcriptions, repaired by a ByT5 model trained for Latin text repair. The second dataset, Corpus Trinum, contains a mixture of over 100M strong and weak Latin language semantic triplets. Corpus Trinum is the first Latin semantic triplet dataset, opening the door for Latin language models to be adapted to general sentence semantic similarity tasks. We construct an experimental grid using five tasks and seventeen subtasks, applying a variety of finetuning configurations and subword aggregation techniques for 15 pretrained encoders, 6 LAMB training checkpoints, and an ablation model designed to quantify the impact of different masking regimens. Using this benchmark, we rank Latin encoders and find that LAMB outperforms all other evaluated models on 16 of 17 subtasks, coming within 0.8 percentage points of state of the art on the seventeenth. We provide additional analyses relating Latin encoder performance to tokenizer behavior, syntactic structure, finetuning configuration, pretraining state, subword aggregation, and variation in source texts and domains. In these, we identify unique acquisition dynamics for Latin open class words during terminal decay phases, and establish that for some task categories, finetuning configuration selection can have a greater effect on downstream scores than additional pretraining tokens.

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）应用中安全防护机制被绕过的问题，具体表现为攻击者通过在用户输入中附加伪造指令（forged query）或伪装成提示（prompt）的干扰内容，诱导安全守卫（safety guard）对错误任务进行响应，从而实现“目标重绑定”（target rebinding）。其核心问题是：当前多数安全守卫基于对输入中最后一个完整任务的判断来决定是否放行，导致攻击者可将有害请求隐藏于一个看似无害的“诱饵”（decoy）之后，使守卫误判并忽略真实恶意请求。解决方案的关键在于重新设计守卫的评分机制——训练其对输入内容的评分不低于其中最危险部分的得分，从而确保即使存在后置伪造结构，系统仍能识别并拦截潜在危害。实验表明，该方法将攻击成功率从75%降至0.8%–1.6%，显著提升安全性；尽管在非推理性评估中性能略有下降（AUROC最多下降0.01），但整体表现未明显劣化。此外，研究还发现，部分攻击可通过将伪造结构置于请求前而非后端实现更高效绕过，说明防御策略需兼顾前后文位置敏感性。

Abstract:Safety guards check content before an LLM application acts on it, and most paste that content into a plain-text prompt. Content that imitates the prompt can append a second task, and the guard answers that one instead. We call this target rebinding. Our explanation is that the guard grades the last complete task in its input, here a harmless decoy, so the harmful request goes through unchanged. In a pre-registered test, an appended forged query and decoy clear all 75 held-out AdvBench requests that Shieldstral-1.0-3B flags. The guard is not persuaded: a directive to ignore the text above clears none of them, and in a follow-up run a harmful decoy stops the attack. On our GuardRebind benchmark, each of five guards has an attack family, chosen per guard, that clears at least 93% of its flagged items. Rebinding explains this best on Shieldstral and gpt-oss-safeguard; on ShieldGemma and Llama Guard 3, generic evasion and trailing text respectively do part of the work, and Qwen3Guard falls mainly to a forgery of its whole task. Training the guard to score content no lower than its most harmful part cuts attack success from 75% to 0.8-1.6% on attack families, decoys and forged queries held out of training. All of these attacks append the forged structure after the request, and we added the held-out-decoy evaluation after a first round of test runs. Clean AUROC falls by at most 0.01, but our test of non-inferiority is inconclusive. A score-guided search still beats this trained guard on 47 of 50 items, usually by placing forged structure before the request. On about half of the items where the search wins, the same search also finds benign text, with no forged structure, that clears the guard.

[NLP-81] Distributional Alignment of LLM s and Its Generalization Properties IJCAI2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在模拟人类行为时难以实现输出分布与人类真实分布对齐的问题，尤其关注在小样本训练条件下如何有效达成分布对齐及其泛化能力。其核心解决方案在于通过大规模基准测试验证，LLMs可通过特定训练策略实现与参考人类分布的分布对齐（distributional alignment），并在同领域未见样本上展现出一定的泛化能力。然而，跨主题泛化能力高度依赖于主题间的语义关联性（如政治类问题与对制度信任的相关性），且已对齐的LLMs可能在未预期的方面出现性能退化（如创造性能力丧失），表明其泛化特性具有内在不可预测性和不稳定性。因此，该研究的关键在于揭示分布对齐的有效性与泛化局限性之间的复杂权衡，强调了在应用中需警惕模型行为的非线性退化风险。

Abstract:Large language models are increasingly used to simulate and probe human behavior, e.g., for surveys. For these applications, a key property is that outputs satisfy distributional alignment: to match its output distribution with some reference (in this case, human) distribution. An obstacle in achieving distributional alignment is generalizing from small training data. In this work, we study (1) how to distributionally align LLMs; and (2) how aligned LLMs might generalize to unseen samples and unrelated topics and tasks. Using two large-scale benchmarks, we find that LLMs can indeed achieve distributional alignment and generalize to unseen questions of the same domain. Cross-topic generalization depends on the relationship between topics (e.g., questions about politics are related to trust in institutions). However, aligned LLMs can degrade in surprising ways (e.g., lose their creative ability), suggesting that its generalization properties are inherently unpredictable and unstable.

[NLP-82] From Target Selection to Condition Reuse: Auditing Residual Interventions in Tool-Use Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在探究在语言模型中通过激活干预（activation interventions）实现目标答案生成后，模型是否能够将所设定的条件（如时间或权限）有效应用于其他计算任务中，从而实现对条件敏感的推理与决策。其核心问题是：激活干预能否使模型不仅在特定任务中正确选择目标，还能在复杂情境下基于条件进行一致且正确的判断与行为执行。解决方案的关键在于引入两种针对特定场景的残差写入（residual-writing）变体，以修改模型内部状态，从而提升目标选择的准确性。实验结果显示，在32个新构建的任务世界中，该方法显著提升了目标选择正确率（从35/128和33/128分别提升至119/128和114/128），但当熟悉事实与标识符被重新组合时，这些性能增益消失，且模型倾向于重复选择曾被奖励的标识符，表明其行为受历史反馈驱动而非真实条件判断。此外，尽管内部状态修改可影响部分判断（如在预设的二级比较中改变50/64次判断），但这种影响并不保证完整动作的正确性。研究进一步揭示了目标选择控制、条件敏感判断与完整行为正确性之间的分离现象，强调必须评估编辑后的内部状态如何被实际使用，而不仅仅是关注其输出结果，才能准确理解模型对条件的真正响应能力。

Abstract:Activation interventions can make a language model produce a target answer, but can the model use the intended condition in other computations? We study this question in Qwen3.5-27B on tool-use tasks where time or permissions determine eligibility and selection. Across 32 fresh worlds, two case-specific residual-writing variants raise familiar target-selection correctness from 35/128 to 119/128 and from 33/128 to 114/128. Yet these gains disappear when familiar facts and identifiers are recombined within the same selection task, while selection of previously rewarded identifiers increases. The gains persist across output formats but yield little improvement in independent judgments about whether a candidate is eligible or should be selected. Internal edits can nevertheless change how a source fact affects a judgment: in a prespecified secondary comparison, an early-layer source patch changes 50/64 judgments when that source is used, with one adverse change among 64 cases where it is not. This selective effect does not ensure correct complete actions. Together, these results separate target-selection control, condition-sensitive judgments, and complete-action correctness. Evaluating how an edited state is used, rather than only its trained answer, exposes these differences.

[NLP-83] An Agent ic Approach with Evidence-Grounded Verification for Multimodal Emotion Reasoning in Conversation NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（LLM）的多模态情感推理系统在采用指令微调时计算成本高昂的问题，同时应对由冻结模型构建的智能体流水线在预测错误时难以定位故障组件的可追溯性难题。其核心解决方案是提出一种可追踪的多模态情感推理框架，并结合提示空间自适应（prompt-space adaptation）机制。该框架包含模态特定的感知智能体，分别处理视觉、听觉和语义输入，并将带有证据引用的观察结果发布至共享信息板；一个集成智能体融合这些观察与检索到的多模态示例，生成情感描述、标签集及支持性引文；此外，配备一个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的批评者智能体，允许一次修订后再定稿。当预测出错时，引入独立的基于证据验证阶段，通过确定性检查验证引用证据的有效性，并利用蕴含关系检测判断最终结论是否被证据支持。失败案例按责任组件和故障类型进行分组，转化为针对性的提示补丁，并在预留数据集上验证后才被采纳，从而实现无需更新模型权重的提示优化。实验表明，在MER2025数据集上，该方法在所有四种不同规模（2B至38B参数）的多模态大语言模型上均优于静态冻结流水线，且达到或超越无差别的反思基线，例如在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上将F-score从52.3提升至54.5，性能提升达0.6–2.2点。

Abstract:LLM-based multimodal emotion reasoning systems perform well on standard benchmarks, but improving them through instruction tuning can be computationally expensive. Agentic pipelines built from frozen models avoid this cost, but introduce a different challenge: when a prediction is wrong, the system must identify which agent or stage caused the error. We address this problem with an agentic framework for traceable multimodal emotion reasoning and prompt-space adaptation. Modality-specific perception agents analyze visual, acoustic, and lexical inputs and post evidence-cited observations to a shared board. An integration agent combines these observations with retrieved multimodal examples to produce an emotion description, label set, and supporting citations, while an MLLM critic can request one revision before the output is finalized. For incorrect predictions, a separate evidence-grounded verification stage applies deterministic checks to verify that cited evidence and references are valid, and an entailment check to determine whether the final claims are supported by that evidence. Detected failures are then grouped by the responsible component and failure type, converted into targeted prompt patches, and accepted only after validation on a held-out set. This adapts the agent prompts without updating model weights. On the MER2025 dataset, targeted prompt adaptation outperforms the frozen static pipeline on all four MLLMs, ranging from 2B to 38B parameters, and matches or outperforms undifferentiated reflection baselines on each of them: VideoLLaMA3-2B, Phi-3.5-vision-instruct, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, and InternVL2.5-38B. It improves F-score by 0.6–2.2 points depending on the backbone, including an increase from 52.3 to 54.5 on Qwen2.5-VL-7B.

Abstract:Knowledge Graphs (KGs) have been popularized during the last few decades and are increasingly constructed and consumed by Large Language Models (LLMs). Various applications therefore rely on KGs to provide concise, complete, accurate, faithful, fresh, and traceable answers. However, what is the quality of those KGs? In which cases should a KG be used, and can it be trusted to ground an LLM? How might it be evaluated? We reviewed the literature on quality assessment (QA) of data, information, linked data, KGs, and the intersection of KGs and LLMs. We extended the current state-of-the-art frameworks to a catalog of 24 quality dimensions (QDs) and various quality metrics (QMs). Furthermore, we propose a general-purpose, customizable to a domain or task, and practical QA framework for assessing the quality of KGs.

[NLP-85] he Schema Coherence Inventory: Measuring Whether an Assigned Belief Organizes a Language Models Cognition

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式语言模型在作为模拟患者或情感代理时，难以验证其行为是否由特定信念（belief）驱动，还是仅受情绪状态影响的问题。核心挑战在于区分模型行为是源于深层认知结构（如负性自我图式）的组织性作用，还是仅由临时情绪波动所引发。解决方案的关键在于提出图式一致性量表（Schema Coherence Inventory, SCI），该量表包含96个强制选择题，覆盖贝克认知模型的八个层级，每题提供六种回应选项，分别对应三个负性自我图式及其正性对立面。通过长度归一化的对数似然得分，避免了对生成内容的语法解析，确保评估聚焦于语义一致性。判别标准为“目标特异性”：针对某一信念设计的条件应显著更频繁地激活该信念，而非同极其他信念。在五个不同参数规模（1.7B–14B）的模型上开展的六项验证研究均支持此判别逻辑，临床训练评分者对关键信念的识别准确率达79.5%（远超随机水平16.7%），且信念适配器在所有模型上均表现出高度目标特异性（平均提升17.7分，30/30信念单元为正向）。此外，一个48项简版量表与完整版具有高度相关性（r = 0.73），且能有效识别自由生成文本中的信念特征。将SCI应用于六个已发表的患者模拟器，发现其均无法超越一句简洁陈述所传达的核心信念。该验证路径通过分离认知构念与伴随情绪，并结合临床专家评判，为语言模型中情感与信念的测量提供了可复用的范式，具备跨任务类型、评价者、机构及语言的扩展潜力。研究团队已公开全部题目、评分代码及简版量表。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31683
作者: Yuqi Wu,Deyang Li,Katharine Hibbard,Ron Oswald,David Sinclair,Adegboyega Sapara,Kalutota Kuruwe Arachchige Sajana Indula Samarasinghe,Abhinav Pillai,Reham Shalaby,Riffat Alam,Xin-Min Li,Yanbo Zhang,Jie Chen
机构: Fudan University (复旦大学); University of Alberta (阿尔伯塔大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Persona-conditioned language models are used as simulated patients and affective agents, but there is no validated way to ask whether a belief assigned to such a model organizes its behaviour or whether the model has merely adopted a mood. We present the Schema Coherence Inventory (SCI): 96 forced-choice items at eight levels of Beck’s cognitive model, each offering six replies keyed to three negative self-schemas and their positive counterparts, scored by length-normalized log-likelihood so that nothing is generated or parsed. Affect alone can move a model onto a default belief, so the discriminant criterion is target specificity: a condition built for one belief must select that belief more often than conditions built for the other beliefs of its pole. Six validation studies over 107 conditions on five backbones (1.7B-14B parameters) support this reading. Nine clinically trained raters recover the keyed belief at 79.5% (chance 16.7%). Belief adapters are target-specific on every backbone (+17.7 points; 30/30 belief cells positive), and a condition’s SCI profile identifies its own free generations in 24/30 cases against 5 expected by chance. A 48-item short form correlates r = 0.73 with the other 48 items. Applied to six published patient simulators, none carries its formulation’s core belief better than a one-sentence statement of it. The validation route, which separates a construct from the affect that accompanies it and checks model judges against clinicians, offers a template for affective measurement in language models; we outline its extension across task types, raters, sites and languages. We release the items, scoring code and short form.

[NLP-86] Multi modal perceived conversation success prediction for spontaneous autistic and non-autistic dyadic interactions ICASSP2027

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自闭症谱系障碍（autism spectrum disorder, ASD）个体与非自闭症个体在对话中感知对话成功度（perceived conversation success）降低的问题。现有研究多聚焦于单一模态特征（如语音声学、词汇使用或非语言行为）的预测能力，或仅用于诊断分类与群体差异分析，难以全面捕捉对话成功的复杂性。本文的关键解决方案在于整合多种互补模态的特征——包括发音动作（articulatory）、面部表情、声学-韵律特征以及轮流说话同步性，并基于三个包含自闭症与非自闭症个体的自发双人互动数据集进行建模。通过多模态融合分析，揭示了对话成功本质上是多维度的，必须采用多层面的分析框架才能有效预测。该方法显著提升了对感知对话成功度的预测性能，因其能够捕获单一模态无法提供的信息，从而为理解并改善自闭症与非自闭症个体间的沟通质量提供了新的技术路径。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31682
作者: Thanushi Withanage,Desi Jones,Noah Sasson,Elizabeth Redcay,Carol Espy-Wilson
机构: University of Maryland (马里兰大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: Submitted to ICASSP 2027

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Conversation success is important for communication, social bonds, and well-being and is often reduced in autistic-neurotypical conversations. Previous studies have predicted perceived conversation success using acoustic and lexical features in pediatric autism-enriched samples, or using nonverbal behavior in non-autistic group interactions. Other work has characterized prosodic, facial, motor, and turn-taking synchrony in autistic interactions, but has primarily targeted diagnostic classification or group differences. The present study instead predicts participant perceived conversation success from complementary articulatory, facial, acoustic-prosodic, and turn-taking measures across three spontaneous dyadic-interaction datasets including autistic and non autistic individuals. By leveraging multimodal features, we demonstrate that conversational success is inherently multidimensional and requires a multi-faceted analytical framework. Combining these complementary modalities offers the potential to improve prediction of perceived conversation success by capturing information unavailable from any single modality.

[NLP-87] Rethinking Structured Generation: Can Graph-Based Reasoning Resolve Ambiguity? NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决传统结构化生成任务中因假设输入到输出为确定性映射而带来的根本性缺陷，即忽略了自然语言固有的多义性——同一输入可能对应多个在语义上均成立但结构各异的输出。现有方法依赖单参考监督，将多重合理解释压缩为单一预测，导致在输入信息不充分时输出不稳定且不一致。其解决方案的关键在于将结构化生成重新建模为一种歧义感知推理（ambiguity-aware inference）问题，强调对一组合理结构化输出进行联合推理，而非强制选择单一结果。为此，论文提出一种多有效学习（multi-valid learning）框架，在训练过程中主动保留潜在的多种有效解，避免标准训练中对合法替代方案的抑制。具体实现上，构建结构化输出候选空间，以图结构表示每个候选输出中的实体及其关系，并通过基于语义对齐与关系一致性约束的图推理机制进行优选，从而实现超越词元级似然的、更符合人类认知的跨解释比较。实验表明，该方法在多个结构化生成基准上显著提升了准确性、稳定性和对不同歧义水平的鲁棒性，验证了显式建模歧义的重要性，并推动结构化生成从单输出预测向集合级推理范式转变。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31681
作者: Ratun Rahman,Atit Pokharel
机构: The University of Alabama in Huntsville(阿拉巴马大学亨茨维尔分校)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
备注: Accepted as NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Structured generation is typically formulated as a deterministic mapping from input to a single structured output. This assumption is fundamentally misaligned with natural language, which often admits multiple structurally distinct yet semantically valid interpretations. As a result, existing methods rely on single-reference supervision that collapses ambiguity into one prediction, leading to unstable and inconsistent outputs under underspecified inputs. We reformulate structured generation as an \textitambiguity-aware inference problem, where the objective is to reason over a set of plausible structured outputs rather than predict a single solution. We show that standard training inherently suppresses valid alternatives, and instead adopt a multi-valid learning framework that preserves ambiguity during optimization. To operationalize this formulation, we construct a candidate space of structured outputs, represent each candidate as a graph capturing entities and their relationships, and perform selection via graph-based reasoning over semantic alignment and relational consistency. This enables principled comparison across competing interpretations beyond token-level likelihoods. Experiments on structured generation benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in accuracy, stability, and robustness under varying levels of ambiguity. These results highlight the importance of modeling ambiguity explicitly and suggest a shift from single-output prediction to set-level reasoning in structured generation.

[NLP-88] MisconceptDialogue: Evaluation Criteria Shape Measured Success in LLM Math Tutoring AACL

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决两个核心问题：其一，单个大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）能否通过多轮对话有效识别学生在数学解题中的错误、诊断其潜在的认知误区（misconception），并实施针对性的补救教学；其二，当前广泛采用的基于精确匹配（exact-match）的评估指标是否可信，能否真实反映模型的教学能力。针对上述问题，论文提出MISCONCEPTDIALOGUE框架，这是一个全自动化系统，通过在五个开源权重的中等规模LLM（7B-14B）数学导师与模拟学生之间开展超过5000次对话，构建了一种受控的、可重复的评估范式。研究发现，以标准数学自然语言处理（NLP）中常见的精确匹配评分法为基准时，模型的补救成功率仅为42.1%，而由人工校准的LLM作为评判者所给出的评分则高达81.3%，两者相差达39.2个百分点，远超模型本身、教学策略及诊断信息供给等变量的综合影响。该结果并非单一评判者的偏差，经四名独立LLM评委和200份人工标注验证，评分一致性极高（kappa值最高达0.91）。此外，在能力评估方面，无论向导师提供真实的认知误区信息还是人为替换的错误诊断信息，其表现几乎无差异，表明这些导师在当前诊断-呈现格式下缺乏对诊断输入的有效依赖。因此，论文强调，未来大语言模型数学辅导的评估必须转向多准则评分、多评判者共识以及人类锚定相结合的标准流程，且评估方法本身的可靠性应与模型能力本身获得同等重视。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31679
作者: Woojin Lee,Yoonkyu Woo,Jinah Kim,Hyeok-Min Gwon,Jin-Xia Huang
机构: Electronics and Telecommunications Research Institute, Republic of Korea(韩国电子通信研究院); Department of Artificial Intelligence, University of Science and Technology, Republic of Korea(韩国科学技术大学人工智能系)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: Accepted to the AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference. 20 pages, 1 figure, 16 tables

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models are increasingly used as math tutors, raising two questions: can a single LLM detect a student’s error, diagnose the underlying misconception, and remediate it through multi-turn dialogue - and can we trust the numbers that report how well it does? We address both with MISCONCEPTDIALOGUE, a fully automated framework that runs the full pipeline on five open-weight LLM tutors (7B-14B) interacting with LLM-simulated students over 5,000+ dialogues - a deliberately simulated protocol (paired conditions, a wrong-diagnosis control unsafe with real learners, scale) whose results do not establish real-student learning. On measurement, our headline finding is uncomfortable for the field: benchmark-style exact-match scoring common in standard math NLP - a lower-bound stress test - reports 42.1% measured Remediation Success Rate on identical dialogues where a human-calibrated LLM-as-judge reports 81.3%, a 39.2 percentage-point spread larger than the combined effects of tutor model, teaching strategy, and supplied diagnostic information. This is not a single-judge artifact: four independent LLM judges and 200 human annotations converge to within a few points (kappa up to 0.91). On capability, the verdict is equally striking: the score barely changes whether we tell the tutor the student’s actual misconception or a deliberately swapped one - under the tested diagnosis-presentation format, these tutors show little evidence of reliably conditioning on the diagnostic information they are handed. For LLM tutoring evaluation to mature, multi-criterion scoring with multi-judge convergence and human anchoring should become standard practice - and the measurement question deserves as much scrutiny as the capability question it claims to answer.

[NLP-89] he Butterfly Defects: Tracing Cooperation in LLM Agent Networks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在大型语言模型（LLMs）作为互联智能体协同运作的背景下，个体合作行为是否能够转化为集体合作这一核心问题。其关键在于揭示合作并非模型固有的稳定属性，而是高度依赖于模型组成、交互伙伴、网络结构位置以及决策语言表述方式的动态过程。研究通过将迭代囚徒困境（IPD）从双人互动扩展至同质与异质的开放权重LLM网络，发现即使模型对相同同伴表现出合作，一旦进入混合群体则可能转向背叛；微小的语言变化（如动作标签顺序或不确定性提示）可显著影响合作水平，并通过网络传播至未直接暴露的远端代理，导致成本重新分配和行为剧变。这表明，合作行为本质上是情境依赖的，其策略性表现受制于语境框架、网络拓扑及交互环境，从而挑战了将合作视为单一模型层面特性的传统认知。

作者: Maria Sampani,Maria Lymperaiou,Angeliki Dimitriou,Giorgos Filandrianos,Chrysoula Zerva,Giorgos Stamou
机构: National Technical University of Athens(雅典国立技术大学)
类目: Physics and Society (physics.soc-ph); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:As large language models (LLMs) increasingly operate as interconnected agents, a fundamental question emerges: does individual cooperation translate into collective cooperation? We investigate this question through the Iterated Prisoner’s Dilemma (IPD), moving from dyadic interactions to homogeneous and heterogeneous networks of open-weight LLMs. Our findings reveal that cooperation is highly sensitive to model composition and seemingly minor linguistic changes. Models that cooperate with identical peers can shift toward defection in mixed populations. A simple uncertainty cue can increase or decrease cooperation, redistribute costs, and affect unexposed agents several hops away. Even reversing action-label order can dramatically alter behavior, with uncertainty framing sometimes amplifying this sensitivity. Together, these findings challenge the notion of cooperation as a stable model-level property, revealing how strategic behavior depends on interaction partners, network positions, and the language used to frame decisions.

[NLP-90] Concentrated Causal Influence Distributed Diagnostic Information: Cognitive Impairment Decisions in Large Audio-Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大音频语言模型（Large Audio-Language Models, LALMs）在认知障碍（Cognitive Impairment, CI）检测任务中“黑箱”决策机制的问题，即模型的预测结果缺乏可解释性，无法明确识别哪些内部组件控制决策过程，以及其表征中究竟包含多少可用于CI诊断的信息。解决方案的关键在于提出并验证“认知障碍对比神经元”（CI-contrast neurons, CICNs），这些神经元通过解码器前馈网络（MLP）中类别对比激活频率进行筛选。研究通过因果消融实验，在八个开放LALM模型与两个数据集（Pitt和PROCESS-2）上，对小规模的CICN集合进行干预，结果显示：在五项符合条件的模型中，三个模型的少量CICN消融即可引发显著且方向明确的预测偏移；同时，基于语音特征提取的掩码仍能控制仅依赖转录文本的决策，且多数核心Pitt模型的CICN在PROCESS-2上保持特异性。位置受限干预表明，这些神经元的影响主要集中在最终答案生成之前，尤其是在字母标记选项下语音或转录证据之后的位置，表现为决策方向的调控。此外，对冻结的CICN激活值进行监督线性读出，在Pitt数据集上达到0.92–0.97 AUC，显著优于模型直接输出的0.67–0.84 AUC，而随机掩码与全神经元读出性能相当，表明高阶诊断信息集中于少数关键神经元，而非广泛分布。该研究揭示了大模型中存在集中式的因果控制机制，与广泛分布的诊断信息之间的重要区分。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32061
作者: Xiutian Zhao,Luqi Sun,Björn Schuller,Berrak Sisman
机构: Johns Hopkins University (约翰霍普金斯大学); Imperial College London (帝国理工学院)
类目: Audio and Speech Processing (eess.AS); Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large audio-language models (LALMs) can assess cognitive impairment (CI) from speech, yet their answers reveal neither which internal components control the decision nor how much CI information is accessible in their representations. We investigate both questions through CI-contrast neurons (CICNs), selected by class-contrastive activation frequency in decoder MLPs. Across eight open LALMs and two corpora (Pitt and PROCESS-2), we causally test CICNs against size- and layer-matched random masks and activity-matched controls. In three of the five models that meet our eligibility criteria, ablation of small CICN sets causes large, class-directed prediction shifts; speech-identified masks also control transcript-only decisions, and three of four primary Pitt masks retain specificity on PROCESS-2. Position-restricted interventions locate the influence before the final answer position, most strongly after the speech or transcript evidence under letter-labeled options, largely as a decision-direction shift. Beyond causal localization, supervised linear readouts of frozen CICN activations achieve 0.92–0.97 AUC within Pitt, versus 0.67–0.84 for the models’ direct answers. Matched random and all-neuron readouts reach comparable performance; top-ranked CICNs show only an exploratory advantage at very small unit budgets. These results distinguish concentrated causal control over output decisions from broadly distributed diagnostic information for CI detection in LALMs.

[IR-0] Separating Thinking from Spelling for Efficient Generative Recommendation

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32980
作者: Danil Gusak,Anna Volodkevich,Ivan Oseledets,Evgeny Frolov
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative recommenders retrieve items by writing their semantic IDs (SIDs) code by code under trie-constrained beam search, an approach now deployed on large web platforms. Standard autoregressive interfaces pay for the SID length K twice: a history of T items enters the backbone as TK code tokens, and every beam-search step runs through the backbone, so returning B candidates costs O(BK) backbone decode tokens per user. The second cost often dominates, and it grows with the backbone, the SID depth and the candidate budget. We introduce Deco (decoding from concepts), which separates reading the history from writing the identifier. The backbone reads each history item as one fused token and condenses the history once into a compact next-item concept; a light KV-cached decoder conditioned on the concept and the generated prefix runs the entire beam search, while the identifiers, the trie and the autoregressive factorization stay unchanged. The decoder approaches full-backbone accuracy with cross-entropy alone, and distillation improves it further. On seven datasets from e-commerce, movies and music streaming, Deco achieves comparable or better accuracy than both a standard generative recommender and the full-backbone teacher with fused inputs, while delivering 3.2–8.6 \times their throughput under a 50 ms p95 latency budget in a production-style serving pipeline. Delegating beam search makes larger candidate pools and models practical: Deco generates 1000 candidates faster than its teacher generates 100, and with a 1.5B-parameter LLM backbone, it matches the 69M-parameter teacher’s throughput while achieving higher accuracy. [IR-1] Knowledge Distillation across Item and Code Spaces for Parallel Generative Recommendation

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32943
作者: Yixuan Xu,Hailin Liu,Linxiang Peng,Can Yang
类目: Information Retrieval (cs.IR); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: 12 pages, 2 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Generative recommendation with semantic IDs represents each item as a sequence of discrete codes derived from its semantic representation and predicts these codes to generate recommendations. Existing semantic-ID recommenders are typically trained with hard labels for the observed next item. Although such supervision identifies the target, it provides no explicit distributional information about alternative items conditioned on the same user history. Sequential recommenders can supply this item-level predictive knowledge, but transferring it to semantic-ID generation is challenging because the teacher and student operate in item and code spaces, respectively. We propose two complementary knowledge-distillation objectives for parallel semantic-ID recommenders, which predict all code positions simultaneously without autoregressive prefix conditioning. Item Distribution Matching (IDM) reconstructs a catalogue-level item distribution from the student’s parallel code predictions and aligns it with the teacher’s item distribution. Code Marginal Matching (CMM) projects the teacher’s item probabilities onto each code position using fixed item-to-code assignments, then matches the resulting code marginals to the corresponding student heads. Both objectives transfer the teacher’s soft distributional knowledge while preserving the student’s parallel prediction structure. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that both methods consistently outperform existing state-of-the-art approaches. On average, IDM improves Recall@10 by 15.39%, while CMM improves NDCG@10 by 8.28%. These results demonstrate that distillation in either reconstructed item space or code-marginal space can substantially strengthen hard-label supervision for parallel generative recommendation.

[IR-2] Every Edge Needs a Quote: Building a Quote-Grounded Knowledge Graph of Healthcare Software Adoption with Language-Model Agents ALT

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.32781
作者: Juan Felipe Duran,Arthur Tobler,Martin Vallières
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Information Retrieval (cs.IR)
备注: 19 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Code: this https URL

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Hospitals regularly buy software that clinicians and patients depend on. Because these purchases are costly, hard to reverse and can affect patient care, buyers look for evidence of which peer institutions already use a product and which systems it connects to. This evidence is public but scattered across vendor websites, press releases and third-party pages. Language-model agents can now collect it at low cost, but the correctness of the extracted claims is difficult to establish, and a wrongly listed customer can mislead buyers and misrepresent an organisation. We present a pipeline that builds a knowledge graph of customer and integration relations from the open web under one rule: every edge must be supported by a verbatim quote from its source page. Pages come from a deterministic crawl of each vendor’s site and a budgeted ReAct agent that searches the rest of the web. A permissive extractor proposes relations with quotes, and a layered grounding stage decides which to keep, using a referent step that reads the whole page when a quote names only one side, deterministic checks, and a panel of five model calls voting on nine criteria. On 61 vendors, the pipeline reaches 0.94 precision and 0.71 recall against a page-level key covering the 6,428 candidate relations proposed by its extractor, whose verdicts were drafted by one model and re-checked with a second. Against the golden reference, the marketplace’s own curated list, it scores lower, but 89% of the relations it keeps that the reference lacks are stated on a page. A confidence score built from the panel’s votes keeps more correct relations than the fixed rule at the same precision, and reaches 0.90 precision at 0.90 recall. We also discuss how narrow, bounded model calls, string-matched evidence and voting address long-context degradation and run-to-run variance.

作者: C. H. Vieira-Vieira,I. Schneider Chernov,A. Serra,M. Correa Marrero,P. L. Bhavani Mohan,G. Duchateau-Nguyen,T. Y. Doktorova,A. Kreuchwig

Abstract:Pharmaceutical companies maintain vast archives of legacy preclinical study reports that contain study-context details, such as fasting, anesthesia, and laboratory instrumentation, that are rarely captured in structured data formats, yet they can correlate with clinical pathology parameters values and limit the reuse of historical data. This work demonstrates practical, scalable solutions to recover such descriptors from heterogeneous report texts using large language model (LLM)-based extraction pipelines developed independently by two industry teams. The pipelines identify and normalize metadata fields and return verbatim evidence with page and section reference, hasting human verification and iterative refinement. Evaluation of over 400 documents against expert-curated reference values showed high agreement across a broad set of metadata fields. Performance was strongest for consistently reported items and lower for descriptors subject to linguistic or report structure variability. Extraction time has shrunk from 25 minutes in the manual benchmark to 1.6 minutes. As a concrete biological demonstration, we show that fasting status extracted from report text was associated with species- and analyte-specific shifts in clinical chemistry parameters, illustrating how recovered metadata can improve selection of historical controls. Key strengths of the approach are scalability, traceability, and the ability to recover information missing from current industry standards. Main limitations are dependence on source-report quality and initial expert effort to define and refine schemas. These results establish how LLMs can convert heterogeneous, unstructured legacy reports into evidence-grounded, reusable and structured metadata, leading to better experimental comparability, and thus enabling reliable data pooling or informed virtual control selection.

Abstract:Information retrieval has long been focusing on connecting people with information they need to complete their tasks. Recently, the meaning of this has changed dramatically as more and more AI agents now consume, retain, and act on information on a user’s behalf. Consequently, information management now also takes place \emphinside the agent in the form of memory management. In this perspective paper, we argue that \emphagentic memory management (AMM), which studies the structure, analysis, organization, storage, searching, retrieval, and \emphuse of information in an intelligent agent’s memory, is a natural extension of IR research and an area in which the IR community can make distinctive contributions. Specifically, we first present a system-level framework for AMM and introduce a computational taxonomy of memory objects as \emphconstants, \emphfunctions, and \emphoperators, each with distinct retrieval semantics. Then, we compare AMM with established IR research and identify their difference and connections. Last but not least, we outline a research agenda covering benchmarks, candidate principles of memory utility, optimization procedures that mix parametric and non-parametric updates, and more. We hope this paper could attract more people, both inside and outside the IR communities, to think more about AMM problems and research from IR perspectives.

Abstract:Emerging e-commerce platforms, such as live-streaming and Online-to-Offline (O2O) services, inherently operate under a “Container-based” display paradigm. Extensive experiments on large-scale industrial datasets demonstrate that HGE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a +0.63% lift in XAUC offline and a +1.42% increase in Revenue Per Search (RPS) in online A/B tests. Abstract:Existing personalized information retrieval methods mainly model differences in user needs through user preferences and query intent, while paying little attention to the personalized expression differences that arise when different users express the same retrieval need. Abstract:Generative recommenders using semantic identifiers predict items through successive token decisions, but beam search may irreversibly prune promising item paths. Abstract:Short-term building load forecasting remains challenging because load patterns can change rapidly with weather and operating conditions. Abstract:Personal email agents decide, for every message, what it is, whether it is urgent, whether to draft a reply, create a task, or ignore it. With ~200 labels, logistic regression has the highest accuracy on every field (type 0.79, urgency 0.74, needs-reply 0.83, is-noise 0.90), though it never predicts the two rarest classes and is statistically tied with Gemma 4 on type; few-shot prompting does not close the gap. Our interviews and survey show people selectively verify AI responses using external and AI-provided evidence, moderated by contextual factors. Although confidence-indicators affected trust and accuracy perceptions, people hold diverse, ambiguous interpretations of AI confidence. Sources were viewed as crucial, yet users raised concerns about source reliability and verification effort. Our experiment showed that confidence and source-based indicators influenced initial perceptions, but effects disappeared once participants learned the response’s correctness. Medical queries elicited skepticism regardless of indicator. 作者: Qiwei Zhao,Oriana Pansardi,James W. Strachan,Eugenio Scaliti,Guido Manzi,Giulia Borghini,Fabio Manzi,Alessandro Rufo,Frédérique de Vignemont,Michael S. A. Graziano,Stefano Panzeri,Cristina Becchio
